StrawFeminist.name: Straw Feminist
StrawFeminist.def: A feminist who follows the stereotype of feminists being misandrists.

StrawHypocrite.name: Straw Hypocrite
StrawHypocrite.def: Someone who promotes a cause they don't actually believe in as a cover to some other end.

StrawNihilist.name: Straw Nihilist
StrawNihilist.def: A nihilist is stereotyped as a person who believes that life is bleak, therefore doing anything good is a waste.

StrawVegetarian.name: Straw Vegetarian
StrawVegetarian.def: Vegetarians and vegans are stereotyped as being antagonistic to anyone who eats meat or uses animal products.

SuddenlySpeaking.name: Suddenly Speaking
SuddenlySpeaking.def: A silent character suddenly starts speaking.

SupremeChef.name: Supreme Chef
SupremeChef.def: A chef who is skilled enough to make all sorts of delicious food.

SurferDude.name: Surfer Dude
SurferDude.def: A character whose lingo, accent, and/or dress sense is based off a stereotypical Californian surfer.

TankTopTomboy.name: Tank-Top Tomboy
TankTopTomboy.def: A tomboyish girl who wears a tank top.

TargetedToHurtTheHero.name: Targeted to Hurt the Hero
TargetedToHurtTheHero.def: A character who is hurt or killed off to torment another character who cares about them.

TheTeamWannabe.name: The Team Wannabe
TheTeamWannabe.def: A character who wants to be a member of the group, but is only ignored by the team because they find him annoying.

TeenGenius.name: Teen Genius
TeenGenius.def: An adolescent who is incredibly smart.

TeenHater.name: Teen Hater
TeenHater.def: A character who despises teenagers to extensive degrees.

TheTeetotaler.name: The Teetotaler
TheTeetotaler.def: A character who never drinks alcohol.

TemporaryScrappy.name: Temporary Scrappy
TemporaryScrappy.def: A character whose purpose is to annoy the audience before they're eventually eliminated.

TerritorialSmurfette.name: Territorial Smurfette
TerritorialSmurfette.def: The sole female character will get antagonistic toward any new female who tries to join the group.

TheyKilledKennyAgain.name: They Killed Kenny Again
TheyKilledKennyAgain.def: A character repeatedly dies and comes back to life to ludicrous levels.

ThirdPersonPerson.name: Third-Person Person
ThirdPersonPerson.def: A character who tends to address themselves in third person.

ThisLoserIsYou.name: This Loser Is You
ThisLoserIsYou.def: The unsuccessful character is supposed to represent the audience.

TinyHeadedBehemoth.name: Tiny-Headed Behemoth
TinyHeadedBehemoth.def: A large brute with a disproportionately small head.

TokenBlackFriend.name: Token Black Friend
TokenBlackFriend.def: The white main character's best friend is a black Satellite Character who seems to exist mainly to make the show seem more inclusive.

TokenEnemyMinority.name: Token Enemy Minority
TokenEnemyMinority.def: A member of the group who belongs to a species the group is usually against.

TokenEvilTeammate.name: Token Evil Teammate
TokenEvilTeammate.def: The one member of a hero team who is evil.

TokenGoodTeammate.name: Token Good Teammate
TokenGoodTeammate.def: The one member of a villain team who is good or at least less evil than the other villains.

TokenHeroicOrc.name: Token Heroic Orc
TokenHeroicOrc.def: The sole member of a villainous race who isn't evil.

TokenHuman.name: Token Human
TokenHuman.def: The one human in a group of nonhumans.

TokenNonhuman.name: Token Non-Human
TokenNonhuman.def: The one nonhuman in a group of humans.

TooDumbToFool.name: Too Dumb to Fool
TooDumbToFool.def: A character is so dumb that they can't be deceived due to being too stupid to understand the lies being told to them.

TooDumbToLive.name: Too Dumb to Live
TooDumbToLive.def: A dumb character who ends up endangering or killing themself because of their stupidity.

ToxicFamilyInfluence.name: Toxic Family Influence
ToxicFamilyInfluence.def: A character who influences their family members to do bad.

ToxicFriendInfluence.name: Toxic Friend Influence
ToxicFriendInfluence.def: A character who influences their friends to do bad.

ToxicLoverInfluence.name: Toxic Lover Influence
ToxicLoverInfluence.def: A character who influences their lover to do bad.

TranslatorBuddy.name: Translator Buddy
TranslatorBuddy.def: An associate of a character who serves to explain what that person was saying.

Tsundere.name: Tsundere
Tsundere.def: Acts mean towards the person they secretly have a crush on.

UltimateAuthorityMayor.name: Ultimate Authority Mayor
UltimateAuthorityMayor.def: A mayor has more power than a mayor would have in real life.

UltimateJobSecurity.name: Ultimate Job Security
UltimateJobSecurity.def: A character who slacks off their duties and/or violates protocol enough times that they realistically would've been fired a long time ago.

UnclePennybags.name: Uncle Pennybags
UnclePennybags.def: A rich character who uses their wealth to give the middle-class and the poor a good time.

TheUnfavourite.name: The Un-Favourite
TheUnfavourite.def: A child who is liked less by their parents than their siblings.

TheUnfettered.name: The Unfettered
TheUnfettered.def: A character who will stoop to any low to get what they want.

TheUnintelligible.name: The Unintelligible
TheUnintelligible.def: A character who is only capable of speaking in gibberish.

UnreliableNarrator.name: Unreliable Narrator
UnreliableNarrator.def: The narrator is hinted to be lying about what happened in their story.

UnseenNoMore.name: Unseen No More
UnseenNoMore.def: A character who initially is only mentioned or has their face obscured finally makes a full physical appearance.

UnsympatheticComedyProtagonist.name: Unsympathetic Comedy Protagonist
UnsympatheticComedyProtagonist.def: The main character of a comedy is a jerk.

UnwittingInstigatorOfDoom.name: Unwitting Instigator of Doom
UnwittingInstigatorOfDoom.def: A single character's actions end up unintentionally causing the conflict.

UnwittingPawn.name: Unwitting Pawn
UnwittingPawn.def: A character is unaware they're helping their enemies further their goal.

TheVamp.name: The Vamp
TheVamp.def: A woman who acts seductive to manipulate men into doing what they want them to.

VanillaProtagonist.name: Vanilla Protagonist
VanillaProtagonist.def: The main character is seen by the audience as not being as interesting as the rest of the cast.

VeryPunchableMan.name: Very Punchable Man
VeryPunchableMan.def: A character whom other characters feel an urge to punch (or otherwise inflict physical harm on).

VillainOfAnotherStory.name: Villain of Another Story
VillainOfAnotherStory.def: A villain who isn't relevant to the main story's plot. May be the adversary faced by a heroic character hinted to have their own adventures that the story isn't focused on .

VillainousGlutton.name: Villainous Glutton
VillainousGlutton.def: A villain who tends to overeat.

TheVoice.name: The Voice
TheVoice.def: A character who is heard, but never physically seen.

VoiceForTheVoiceless.name: Voice for the Voiceless
VoiceForTheVoiceless.def: A character who speaks on behalf of another character.

TheVoiceless.name: The Voiceless
TheVoiceless.def: A character who never speaks but might be able to talk.

WeirdnessMagnet.name: Weirdness Magnet
WeirdnessMagnet.def: A character who ends up encountering all kinds of strange phenomenon no matter where they are.

WeJustNeedToWaitForRescue.name: We Just Need to Wait for Rescue

WellIntentionedExtremist.name: Well-Intentioned Extremist
WellIntentionedExtremist.def: A character resorts to extreme methods to ensure a noble goal.

WholesomeCrossdresser.name: Wholesome Crossdresser
WholesomeCrossdresser.def: A crossdresser who isn’t portrayed as creepy or sinister.

TheWonka.name: The Wonka
TheWonka.def: A character in charge of a business who is considerably efficient in spite of being eccentric as hell.

TheWoobie.name: The Woobie
TheWoobie.def: A character who suffers so much that the audience can't help but feel sorry for them.

WoobieDestroyerOfWorlds.name: Woobie, Destroyer of Worlds
WoobieDestroyerOfWorlds.def: A character who causes mass destruction has a sympathetic backstory.

TheWorfEffect.name: The Worf Effect
TheWorfEffect.def: It's established how powerful a character is by having them easily defeat a strong character as if they were a weakling.

Yandere.name: Yandere
Yandere.def: Someone who will murder for their crush.

YesMan.name: Yes-Man
YesMan.def: A subordinate who blindly agrees with everything their boss says.

YourTerroristsAreOurFreedomFighters.name: Your Terrorists Are Our Freedom Fighters

AbstractApotheosis.name: Abstract Apotheosis
AbstractApotheosis.def: Character becomes an abstract concept, often done after their death.

AdoptedMannerisms.name: Adopted Mannerisms
AdoptedMannerisms.def: A character adopts another's mannerisms or gestures.

AMFMCharacterization.name: AM/FM Characterization
AMFMCharacterization.def: Character's personality is introduced through their taste in music.

AnimalMetaphor.name: Animal Metaphor
AnimalMetaphor.def: Character's personality is reflected by their animal companion.

ArtReflectsPersonality.name: Art Reflects Personality
ArtReflectsPersonality.def: An artist's work shows what's going on in their head and/or heart.

BackportedDevelopment.name: Backported Development
BackportedDevelopment.def: Character has the development they gain over the course of the story in flashbacks.

BornInTheWrongCentury.name: Born in the Wrong Century
BornInTheWrongCentury.def: Character wishes they lived in a different period.

CampfireCharacterExploration.name: Campfire Character Exploration
CampfireCharacterExploration.def: Characters are explored while talking around a campfire.

CharacterCheck.name: Character Check
CharacterCheck.def: Character who has been hit with Characterization Marches On briefly lapses back into their original characterization.

CharacterDepth.name: Character Depth
CharacterDepth.def: A measure of how "deep" a character is.

CharacterDevelopment.name: Character Development
CharacterDevelopment.def: A character changes and grows as they progress through the story.

CharacterRerailment.name: Character Rerailment
CharacterRerailment.def: Character has their original characterization restored after having previously been derailed beyond recognition.

CharacterisationClickMoment.name: Characterisation Click Moment
CharacterisationClickMoment.def: A previously undeveloped character shows the starting signs of their finalised personality and role.

CharacterizationByFlavorText.name: Characterization By Flavor Text
CharacterizationByFlavorText.def: Flavor text provides information about a character's personality.

CharacterizationMarchesOn.name: Characterization Marches On
CharacterizationMarchesOn.def: A character's personality is different in later episodes than it was in the beginning.

Chickification.name: Chickification
Chickification.def: A previously competent female character is made weaker either over time or in between adaptations.

ChoreCharacterExploration.name: Chore Character Exploration
ChoreCharacterExploration.def: Characters (and the audience) learn about each other while doing chores together.

CircularCharacterArc.name: Circular Character Arc
CircularCharacterArc.def: A character develops across a story, but by the end their characterisation is similar to what it was at the start.

CloserToEarth.name: Closer to Earth
CloserToEarth.def: A minority character is portrayed as wiser and more level-headed than the majority protagonist.

ContractualGenreBlindness.name: Contractual Genre Blindness
ContractualGenreBlindness.def: A character who maintains their role because of their Genre Savviness.

CrowdPleaser.name: Crowd Pleaser
CrowdPleaser.def: Character motivated by praise and attention.

CutenessOverload.name: Cuteness Overload
CutenessOverload.def: Character turns into a bowl of mush at the sight of something cute.

DependingOnTheWriter.name: Depending on the Writer
DependingOnTheWriter.def: The way a character behaves or is treated changes depending on who is writing at the moment.

DiscoDan.name: Disco Dan
DiscoDan.def: A character holds into a fad that everyone else has abandoned.

DivergentCharacterEvolution.name: Divergent Character Evolution
DivergentCharacterEvolution.def: Two or more identical characters are redesigned and developed so that they're better distinguished.

DrinkBasedCharacterization.name: Drink-Based Characterization
DrinkBasedCharacterization.def: Someone is characterized by the alcohol they consume.

DrugBasedCharacterization.name: Drug-Based Characterization
DrugBasedCharacterization.def: A character's needs and motivations are reflected by the drugs they take.

DynamicCharacter.name: Dynamic Character
DynamicCharacter.def: A character who becomes more layered as the story progresses.

EarthyBarefootCharacter.name: Earthy Barefoot Character
EarthyBarefootCharacter.def: Character who is close to nature wears no shoes.

ElectiveMute.name: Elective Mute
ElectiveMute.def: A character who chooses not to speak.

ElectiveUnintelligible.name: Elective Unintelligible
ElectiveUnintelligible.def: A character who chooses to be impossible to understand.

ElementalPersonalities.name: Elemental Personalities
ElementalPersonalities.def: Personality types stereotypically associated with certain elements.

EliteSchoolMeansEliteBrain.name: Elite School Means Elite Brain
EliteSchoolMeansEliteBrain.def: A character is characterized by where they went to school.

EstablishingCharacterMusic.name: Establishing Character Music
EstablishingCharacterMusic.def: A character's personality is established through music.

EveryoneHasStandards.name: Everyone Has Standards
EveryoneHasStandards.def: Every character, regardless of moral alignment or clique, has at least some level of decency.

ExperiencedProtagonist.name: Experienced Protagonist
ExperiencedProtagonist.def: The main character is already an expert when the story begins.

FashionDisaster.name: Fashion Disaster
FashionDisaster.def: A character struggles with picking out clothes that look presentable to most people.

FieryStoic.name: Fiery Stoic
FieryStoic.def: A character with Playing with Fire powers is calm and gentle rather than Hot-Blooded .

FlatCharacter.name: Flat Character
FlatCharacter.def: Character who has barely if any characterization.

ForgotFlandersCouldDoThat.name: Forgot Flanders Could Do That
ForgotFlandersCouldDoThat.def: Character that's been hit by Flanderization shows signs of their previous characterization.

FriendToBugs.name: Friend to Bugs
FriendToBugs.def: A character who enjoys creepy crawlies.

FunctionalAddict.name: Functional Addict
FunctionalAddict.def: A character who doesn't let their addictions affect their ability to live their lives.

GenreBlindness.name: Genre Blindness
GenreBlindness.def: Character doesn't seem to know how certain genres work.

GenreRefugee.name: Genre Refugee
GenreRefugee.def: A character who looks like they don't belong in this setting at all... yet is here nonetheless.

GenreSavvy.name: Genre Savvy
GenreSavvy.def: Character is knowledgeable about how certain genres work.

GrassIsGreener.name: Grass Is Greener
GrassIsGreener.def: A character who longs to leave their terrible life behind to go somewhere they think is better.

HandwritingAsCharacterization.name: Handwriting as Characterization
HandwritingAsCharacterization.def: A character's handwriting provides an insight into their personality.

HeartOfAWriter.name: Heart of a Writer
HeartOfAWriter.def: A character is a writer, which influences their characterization/motives.

HeartTrauma.name: Heart Trauma
HeartTrauma.def: A character has something physically happen to their heart, which affects their personality in drastic ways.

HeavenSeeker.name: Heaven Seeker
HeavenSeeker.def: A character whose motivation is to earn a pleasant afterlife.

HellSeeker.name: Hell Seeker
HellSeeker.def: A character who tries to get themselves into hell.

InformedWrongness.name: Informed Wrongness
InformedWrongness.def: What this character did is supposed to be seen as wrong despite there being nothing to back it up.

InHarmonyWithNature.name: In Harmony with Nature
InHarmonyWithNature.def: A character who understands the resources and rhythms of nature.

InsistsOnPaying.name: Insists on Paying
InsistsOnPaying.def: A character who, even when offered a freebie, insists on using their money to pay for it.

InterpretativeCharacter.name: Interpretative Character
InterpretativeCharacter.def: A character that can be depicted in any number of ways as long as they retain a few defining traits.

InTheOriginalKlingon.name: In the Original Klingon
InTheOriginalKlingon.def: An ethnic character who claims an invention or artwork for their own culture.

IThoughtEveryoneCouldDoThat.name: I Thought Everyone Could Do That
IThoughtEveryoneCouldDoThat.def: A character has a special talent that they think everyone else is capable of doing.

JackOfAllTrades.name: Jack of All Trades
JackOfAllTrades.def: A character with all the basic skills and who is able to do a little bit of everything.

LiteralTransformativeExperience.name: Literal Transformative Experience
LiteralTransformativeExperience.def: A character develops as a result of a physical transformation and the experiences therein.

LoonyFriendsImproveYourPersonality.name: Loony Friends Improve Your Personality
LoonyFriendsImproveYourPersonality.def: A stiff character grows in personality from hanging around annoying and eccentric people.

MischievousBodyLanguage.name: Mischievous Body Language
MischievousBodyLanguage.def: A character's body language shows that they're up to something.

MiseryBuildsCharacter.name: Misery Builds Character
MiseryBuildsCharacter.def: Having a character go through absolute hell as a way to strengthen them.

MonsAsCharacterization.name: Mons as Characterization
MonsAsCharacterization.def: A character's choice of mons has deeper implications about their character.

TheMovieBuff.name: The Movie Buff
TheMovieBuff.def: A character whose defining trait is their knowledge of film lore.

NatureLover.name: Nature Lover
NatureLover.def: A character with a love of the great outdoors.

NegativesAsAPositive.name: Negatives as a Positive
NegativesAsAPositive.def: Negative traits are portrayed in a positive light

OfficeGolf.name: Office Golf
OfficeGolf.def: A high-powered boss plays golf in the office.

OnlyCleanMouth.name: Only Clean Mouth
OnlyCleanMouth.def: The one member of an ensemble who never swears.

OnlyOnePersonalityWillWork.name: Only One Personality Will Work
OnlyOnePersonalityWillWork.def: A challenge requires a very specific personality to complete successfully.

OOCIsSeriousBusiness.name: OOC Is Serious Business
OOCIsSeriousBusiness.def: If a character is behaving outside his usual characterization, the situation must be serious.

OutOfCharacterMoment.name: Out-of-Character Moment
OutOfCharacterMoment.def: Character does something outside his usual characterization.

Pacifist.name: Pacifist
Pacifist.def: A character who is opposed to the use of violence to resolve disputes or gain advantages.

ParodyAce.name: Parody Ace
ParodyAce.def: A character is portrayed as more impressive than he really is.

PastimesProvePersonality.name: Pastimes Prove Personality
PastimesProvePersonality.def: A character's personality can be defined based on their favorite pastime.

PersonalityMechanic.name: Personality Mechanic
PersonalityMechanic.def: In-universe personality traits have an effect on gameplay.

PersonalityPowers.name: Personality Powers
PersonalityPowers.def: Superpowers that align with the characters' personalities.

PiecesOfFlair.name: Pieces of Flair
PiecesOfFlair.def: Displaying personality and values through accessories.

PlayingCatchWithTheOldMan.name: Playing Catch with the Old Man
PlayingCatchWithTheOldMan.def: A simple game of catch establishes a parent, their child, and their relationship.

PowerStereotypeFlip.name: Power Stereotype Flip
PowerStereotypeFlip.def: A character's personality is different from what is expected from their superpowers.

ProfuseThanking.name: Profuse Thanking
ProfuseThanking.def: Characters who don't seem able to stop thanking their benefactors.

PuttingOnMyThinkingCap.name: Putting On My Thinking Cap
PuttingOnMyThinkingCap.def: A character has something they do that helps them think.

RealAwardFictionalCharacter.name: Real Award, Fictional Character
RealAwardFictionalCharacter.def: A Non- Historical Domain Character is given a Real Life award or military decoration.

RidiculouslySuccessfulFutureSelf.name: Ridiculously Successful Future Self
RidiculouslySuccessfulFutureSelf.def: A character travels through time and finds out that they will eventually become very successful.

RoundedCharacter.name: Rounded Character
RoundedCharacter.def: A detailed character, complete with depth and complexity.

RulesLawyer.name: Rules Lawyer
RulesLawyer.def: A character who knows all the rules — backwards, forwards, sideways, and upside down — and uses that to their advantage.

SelfAppliedNickname.name: Self-Applied Nickname
SelfAppliedNickname.def: A character adopts a nickname and insists that others refer to them by it.

TheShameless.name: The Shameless
TheShameless.def: A character has no sense of shame.

TheSilentBob.name: The Silent Bob
TheSilentBob.def: A character who never talks, but can hold an entire conversation without saying a word.

SomethingAboutARose.name: Something about a Rose
SomethingAboutARose.def: A character who associates themselves with roses.

StaticCharacter.name: Static Character
StaticCharacter.def: A character who doesn't go through Character Development .

SurvivalMantra.name: Survival Mantra
SurvivalMantra.def: A reassuring phrase that a character speaks to gain confidence.

SweetBaker.name: Sweet Baker
SweetBaker.def: Character with goodly qualities associated with food, such as sweet temper.

TemporarilyExaggeratedTrait.name: Temporarily Exaggerated Trait
TemporarilyExaggeratedTrait.def: An individual character trait is highlighted for one episode.

Thememobile.name: Thememobile
Thememobile.def: A vehicle based on a character's theme.

TooMuchAlike.name: Too Much Alike
TooMuchAlike.def: Two characters don't get along because of their similarities.

TheTragicRose.name: The Tragic Rose
TheTragicRose.def: Character who is a rose-themed Woobie .

TransformationConventions.name: Transformation Conventions
TransformationConventions.def: The object or being a character transforms into fits their personality.

TheTroublemaker.name: The Troublemaker
TheTroublemaker.def: A character regularly causes problems for their friends and family.

Ukefication.name: Ukefication
Ukefication.def: A previously competent male character is made more emotional and effeminate in a fanfic, often to play as "the bottom half" of a same-sex pairing.

TheUnwittingComedian.name: The Unwitting Comedian
TheUnwittingComedian.def: A character who is the funniest person around even though they aren't trying to be funny.

WakeUpCall.name: Wake-Up Call
WakeUpCall.def: A character gets put through some event that forces them to grow or otherwise get their act together.

WorkHardPlayHard.name: Work Hard, Play Hard
WorkHardPlayHard.def: A character who is serious and hard working at their job, but loves to party and have fun when at home.

WoundedHeroWeakerHelper.name: Wounded Hero, Weaker Helper
WoundedHeroWeakerHelper.def: A character is injured and must be healed by a weaker or more inexperienced character.

WriteWhoYouHate.name: Write Who You Hate
WriteWhoYouHate.def: A character is based off a Real Life person the author hates or hated.

WriteWhoYouKnow.name: Write Who You Know
WriteWhoYouKnow.def: A character is based off a Real Life person the author knows or knew.

WrongGenreSavvy.name: Wrong Genre Savvy
WrongGenreSavvy.def: Genre Savvy character doesn't realize the story they're a part of isn't in the genre they thought it was.

AnthropomorphicPersonification.name: Anthropomorphic Personification
AnthropomorphicPersonification.def: Living, roughly hominoid embodiments of abstract concepts.

AntiHero.name: Anti-Hero
AntiHero.def: A morally questionable hero who lacks conventional heroic qualities.

BarefootLoon.name: Barefoot Loon
BarefootLoon.def: A character who doesn't wear shoes to indicate that they've gone off their rails or just don't care about social conventions.

BarefootSage.name: Barefoot Sage
BarefootSage.def: A wise person that is usually barefoot.

AChatWithSatan.name: A Chat with Satan
AChatWithSatan.def: A character tests whether the hero would enact their darker desires if tempted.

TheChosenOne.name: The Chosen One
TheChosenOne.def: The ancient prophecy says that only a certain person can save the world.

ClassicalHunter.name: Classical Hunter
ClassicalHunter.def: A character whose life and personality is built around game-hunting

ClassicVillain.name: Classic Villain
ClassicVillain.def: A villain who acts as an evil foil to the hero's personality and is a main block to his journey towards his destiny.

TheCorrupter.name: The Corrupter
TheCorrupter.def: A villain who tempts people into doing evil things.

DemiurgeArchetype.name: Demiurge Archetype
DemiurgeArchetype.def: Someone evil pretending to be the setting's Top God .

TheDrunkenSailor.name: The Drunken Sailor
TheDrunkenSailor.def: A sailor who is always seen drinking.

EccentricMentor.name: Eccentric Mentor
EccentricMentor.def: A mentor who is quirky, yet still wise and skilled.

EvilOverlord.name: Evil Overlord
EvilOverlord.def: An incredibly powerful , highly influential despot who is usually the Big Bad of the story.

TheFerryman.name: The Ferryman
TheFerryman.def: A mythical figure whose boat is used as a vehicle to transport people to Other Worlds .

TheFool.name: The Fool
TheFool.def: An uncannily lucky , fundamentally kind-hearted Ditz .

FoolForLove.name: Fool for Love
FoolForLove.def: Tough, and possibly cynical, but still a sucker for love.

TheGoodKing.name: The Good King
TheGoodKing.def: A king who is good at his job and beloved by the people.

GrannyClassic.name: Granny Classic
GrannyClassic.def: A wise, nurturing, and reliable grandmother.

TheGrotesque.name: The Grotesque
TheGrotesque.def: A character's ugliness is so extreme that it elicits pity instead of disgust.

TheIdealist.name: The Idealist
TheIdealist.def: A character defined by their hopefulness in the present and the future.

IneffectualLoner.name: Ineffectual Loner
IneffectualLoner.def: A capable but solitary character whose efficiency is limited by their lack of friends.

JeanneDArchetype.name: Jeanne d'Archétype
JeanneDArchetype.def: A young, soldier woman who is seen as her cause's symbol.

TheKlutz.name: The Klutz
TheKlutz.def: A character whose defining trait is clumsiness.

LadyAndKnight.name: Lady and Knight
LadyAndKnight.def: An honourable and courageous character is sworn to defend a high-ranking lady.

LoserArchetype.name: Loser Archetype
LoserArchetype.def: A character whose disgrace comes from their lack of talent/skill.

MadonnaArchetype.name: Madonna Archetype
MadonnaArchetype.def: Humble mother figure modeled after the Virgin Mary.

MagicalBarefooter.name: Magical Barefooter
MagicalBarefooter.def: Casting magic is easier if you don't wear shoes.

MentorArchetype.name: Mentor Archetype
MentorArchetype.def: Someone whose role is to ensure The Hero 's Character Development .

MessianicArchetype.name: Messianic Archetype
MessianicArchetype.def: Someone who endures great sacrifices to save others.

ModernMajorGeneral.name: Modern Major General
ModernMajorGeneral.def: Can do anything well except their actual job.

MosesArchetype.name: Moses Archetype
MosesArchetype.def: A character who frees his people to lead them to a promised land.

MyGirlBackHome.name: My Girl Back Home
MyGirlBackHome.def: The loved one who The Hero leaves when going on an adventure.

NakedNutter.name: Naked Nutter
NakedNutter.def: A character who appears naked in public because they're out of their mind.

ThePaladin.name: The Paladin
ThePaladin.def: Holy knight with healing and defensive powers and light based magic .

ThePatriarch.name: The Patriarch
ThePatriarch.def: A male elder with the highest authority in his family.

PersonOfMassDestruction.name: Person of Mass Destruction
PersonOfMassDestruction.def: A person with massively devastating abilities.

PrincessClassic.name: Princess Classic
PrincessClassic.def: An innocent , good and kind princess.

TheProtagonist.name: The Protagonist
TheProtagonist.def: The character whom the story is about.

RebelliousSpirit.name: Rebellious Spirit
RebelliousSpirit.def: A character who doesn't abide by the rules.

ReluctantMonster.name: Reluctant Monster
ReluctantMonster.def: An Always Chaotic Evil species is oblivious/reluctant to their deeds.

SeekerArchetype.name: Seeker Archetype
SeekerArchetype.def: A character whose main motivation is to learn a certain truth.

ShadowArchetype.name: Shadow Archetype
ShadowArchetype.def: A character embodies another character's rejected facets.

StarCrossedLovers.name: Star-Crossed Lovers
StarCrossedLovers.def: Lovers doomed to be kept apart.

ThresholdGuardians.name: Threshold Guardians
ThresholdGuardians.def: A character who tests The Hero 's resolve before the latter's journey starts.

TheTrickster.name: The Trickster
TheTrickster.def: A cunning character who disregards the rules.

WickedWitch.name: Wicked Witch
WickedWitch.def: Ugly, Obviously Evil version of the Witch Classic .

TheWiseWoman.name: The Wise Woman
TheWiseWoman.def: An usually a solitary older woman who possesses both deep mystical knowledge and strong connection to nature.

WitchClassic.name: Witch Classic
WitchClassic.def: Witches as wise, old women whose magic is associated with nature and have an animal companion.

WizardClassic.name: Wizard Classic
WizardClassic.def: Wizards as wise, old males who use magic, wear robes, and wield staffs.

WorldsBestWarrior.name: World's Best Warrior
WorldsBestWarrior.def: Someone who, through skill and reputation, is the setting's best fighter.

WorldsMostBeautifulWoman.name: World's Most Beautiful Woman
WorldsMostBeautifulWoman.def: Someone who is noted In-Universe to be the setting's most attractive person.

WorldsStrongestMan.name: World's Strongest Man
WorldsStrongestMan.def: Someone who is the setting's physically strongest person.

TwentyMinutesIntoTheFuture.name: 20 Minutes into the Future
TwentyMinutesIntoTheFuture.def: In the near future everyone is a robot and speaks 10 languages.

TwentyMinutesIntoThePast.name: 20 Minutes into the Past
TwentyMinutesIntoThePast.def: Not a Period Piece , but not quite the present, either.

AfterTheEnd.name: After the End
AfterTheEnd.def: A catastrophe — man-made or natural — has wiped out a large portion of the human civilization and/or population . The survivors fight for survival in a post-apocalyptic world.

AgeOfReptiles.name: Age of Reptiles
AgeOfReptiles.def: A primordial period where reptiles ruled the Earth.

AgriWorld.name: Agri World
AgriWorld.def: A planet, often depicted as a Single-Biome Planet , dedicated to agriculture.

AlternativeCalendar.name: Alternative Calendar
AlternativeCalendar.def: If the end of World War II were used as the start of an era, the current would be 81 instead of 2026.

AnachronismStew.name: Anachronism Stew
AnachronismStew.def: Is that man wearing a toga, wielding a Katana and listening to an iPod?

AnachronisticOrphanage.name: Anachronistic Orphanage
AnachronisticOrphanage.def: A traditional orphanage in a first-world setting.

AnimalIsTheNewMan.name: Animal Is the New Man
AnimalIsTheNewMan.def: Animals take over after humanity falls.

TheApunkalypse.name: The Apunkalypse
TheApunkalypse.def: Punks usher in the collapse of civilization; the apocalypse ushers in the age of the punks. It's all the same song and dance, and the punks are here to stay.

BibleTimes.name: Bible Times
BibleTimes.def: The historical eras wherein The Bible is set.

BigFatFuture.name: Big, Fat Future
BigFatFuture.def: Obese is slim in the future.

CassetteFuturism.name: Cassette Futurism
CassetteFuturism.def: The early digital era of the 20th century's last quarter extrapolated into the future. The grungier post-microchip, pre- iPod successor to Raygun Gothic .

ChandlerAmericanTime.name: Chandler American Time
ChandlerAmericanTime.def: A nastier relative of Genteel Interbellum Setting

CockroachesWillRuleTheEarth.name: Cockroaches Will Rule the Earth
CockroachesWillRuleTheEarth.def: Little vermin become the dominant life form.

TheDarkTimes.name: The Dark Times
TheDarkTimes.def: Between the dinosaurs and early human civilization there were dragons, wizards and evil beyond imagination.

DawnOfTheWildWest.name: Dawn of the Wild West
DawnOfTheWildWest.def: Just before and the beginning of the Wild West .

EarthIsYoung.name: Earth Is Young
EarthIsYoung.def: Though events take place on Earth during the recorded period of human history, the age of the planet is merely thousands rather than billions of years.

TheEdwardianEra.name: The Edwardian Era
TheEdwardianEra.def: 1901 - 1910, from Queen Victoria 's death to the outbreak of World War I .

EnforcedTechnologyLevels.name: Enforced Technology Levels
EnforcedTechnologyLevels.def: Only certain kinds of technology, or a certain level of technology, is allowed. By law, manmade or natural.

FantasticNatureReserve.name: Fantastic Nature Reserve
FantasticNatureReserve.def: A zoo, wildlife reserve, or other home for supposedly extinct or mythical creatures.

FantasyAmericana.name: Fantasy Americana
FantasyAmericana.def: Magic, fantastic creatures, and figures of folklore lie in the wilds of North America, just beyond the reaches of civilization.

FantasyFuture.name: Fantasy Future
FantasyFuture.def: A scenario of humanity's future that involves magic and fantasy creatures.

FeudalFuture.name: Feudal Future
FeudalFuture.def: Sub-category of Days of Future Past.

FloodedFutureWorld.name: Flooded Future World
FloodedFutureWorld.def: In the future, the world becomes mostly or entirely covered by water.

TheFuture.name: The Future
TheFuture.def: 100 — 200 years into the future. Think of how every house in The Jetsons looks .

TheFutureIsNoir.name: The Future Is Noir
TheFutureIsNoir.def: We do not use sufficient lighting in the future.

TheGreatDepression.name: The Great Depression
TheGreatDepression.def: The 1930s, a time of worldwide economic and political crisis that led directly to World War II .

HeavenlyConcentricCircles.name: Heavenly Concentric Circles
HeavenlyConcentricCircles.def: Heavenly planes or beings are depicted as concentric circles in the sky.

HereThereWereDragons.name: Here There Were Dragons
HereThereWereDragons.def: Once upon a time, Kings had wizards as courtiers and knights slew dragons.

HollywoodPrehistory.name: Hollywood Prehistory
HollywoodPrehistory.def: Hollywood Stone Age. All cavemen look Neanderthalish and live in harmony with dinosaurs.

JustBeforeTheEnd.name: Just Before the End
JustBeforeTheEnd.def: We are a few days from extermination.

JustOneSecondOutOfSync.name: Just One Second Out of Sync

ALongTimeAgoInAGalaxyFarFarAway.name: A Long Time Ago, in a Galaxy Far, Far Away
ALongTimeAgoInAGalaxyFarFarAway.def: Far distant in space, time or both. They've probably never even heard of Earth.

MedievalPrehistory.name: Medieval Prehistory
MedievalPrehistory.def: Pre-industrial human society set against a prehistoric backdrop.

NextSundayAD.name: Next Sunday A.D.
NextSundayAD.def: Just ahead of the present. That's why you haven't noticed the Alien Invasion .

OverpopulationCrisis.name: Overpopulation Crisis
OverpopulationCrisis.def: Wherever you are, there are too many other people for it to be sustainable.

PopularHistory.name: Popular History
PopularHistory.def: When movies set in 1968 look like they are set in 1968.

PresentDay.name: Present Day
PresentDay.def: When a show is set in the same year it is produced in.

PresentDayPast.name: Present-Day Past
PresentDayPast.def: The city wouldn't let the production close down streets so our movie set five years ago is full of recent car models and billboards.

RaygunGothic.name: Raygun Gothic
RaygunGothic.def: Shiny spaceships, artistically designed ray guns, Tin Can Robots , and jet packs, all done in an Art Deco style. The chief setting of futuristic stories from the the Golden Age of Science Fiction.

ReclaimedByNature.name: Reclaimed by Nature
ReclaimedByNature.def: Nature grows over the remains of Mankind's infrastructure.

RuinsOfTheModernAge.name: Ruins of the Modern Age
RuinsOfTheModernAge.def: The Empire State Building is growing moss and most of its concrete is fading away.

ScavengerWorld.name: Scavenger World
ScavengerWorld.def: The world has been ruined, and people rely on what they can salvage from the old world to survive.

SpaceAgeStasis.name: Space Age Stasis
SpaceAgeStasis.def: You have the jet packs, but they're the same as the ones made a thousand years ago.

StandardPostApocalypticSetting.name: Standard Post-Apocalyptic Setting
StandardPostApocalypticSetting.def: A post-apocalyptic featuring a lot of mutants, ruined cities, and brown palettes.

StandardSciFiHistory.name: Standard Sci-Fi History
StandardSciFiHistory.def: The Far Future, the Really Far Future of Space Opera.

TheTimeOfMyths.name: The Time of Myths
TheTimeOfMyths.def: Ancient Myths (Bronze Age, Greek, what-have-you) are not only real, they are mashed together into one time period.

TwilightOfTheOldWest.name: Twilight of the Old West
TwilightOfTheOldWest.def: The Wild West gradually gives way to the New Old West .

KneeHighPerspective.name: Knee-High Perspective
KneeHighPerspective.def: The characters are children, babies, small or tiny animals, small fey beings, or toys, and adults are viewed from the waist, knee, or ankle down.

AlternateWorldMap.name: Alternate World Map
AlternateWorldMap.def: When an RPG has alternate worlds.

Heaven.name: Heaven
Heaven.def: Fluffy Cloud Heaven : The common Heaven.

WarriorHeaven.name: Warrior Heaven
WarriorHeaven.def: Where Proud Warrior Race Guys go when they die.

HellIsWar.name: Hell Is War
HellIsWar.def: Hell is dedicated to the aspects of war.

WorldOfChaos.name: World of Chaos
WorldOfChaos.def: A world where physical laws have been thrown to the wind and nothing makes sense.

WorldOfHam.name: World of Ham
WorldOfHam.def: Where a simple conversation is spoken in ALL CAPS and PUNCTUATED! FOR! EMPHASIS!

CrapsaccharineWorld.name: Crapsaccharine World
CrapsaccharineWorld.def: A world that looks fun and delightful, but is actually horrible.

CrapsackWorld.name: Crapsack World
CrapsackWorld.def: A horrible world to live in.

FisherKing.name: Fisher King
FisherKing.def: A world that changes based on the state of a person.

FisherKingdom.name: Fisher Kingdom
FisherKingdom.def: A world that changes its inhabitants.

PastRightNow.name: Past Right Now
PastRightNow.def: When something very much like the past is found in present day, either recreated or preserved.

SchizoTech.name: Schizo Tech
SchizoTech.def: Technology from various time periods coexisting randomly.

SingleBiomePlanet.name: Single-Biome Planet
SingleBiomePlanet.def: A desert planet, ice planet, ocean planet.

SlidingScaleOfShinyVersusGritty.name: Sliding Scale of Shiny Versus Gritty

TheUnmasquedWorld.name: The Unmasqued World
TheUnmasquedWorld.def: A world where supernatural things are no longer hidden from the mundane populace.

WainscotSociety.name: Wainscot Society
WainscotSociety.def: The setting may look like our world to most of its inhabitants — but there's a whole secondary society in hiding.

WeWillUseLasersInTheFuture.name: We Will Use Lasers in the Future
WeWillUseLasersInTheFuture.def: Setting where Energy Weapons are portrayed as superior to kinetic weapons.

TheWonderland.name: The Wonderland
TheWonderland.def: A strange, fantastical place that follows rules we aren't used to.

AWorldHalfFull.name: A World Half Full
AWorldHalfFull.def: A flawed world that still has hope of improvement.

WorldOfDumbass.name: World of Dumbass
WorldOfDumbass.def: Everyone is ignorant or lacks common sense.

WorldOfMasks.name: World of Masks
WorldOfMasks.def: A setting in which masks are commonplace, if not universal.

WorldOfWeirdness.name: World of Weirdness
WorldOfWeirdness.def: The mundane world is mixed with the supernatural and nobody bats an eye.

WorldTour.name: World Tour
WorldTour.def: When the story is set across multiple different locations around the Earth.

YouWouldNotWantToLiveInDex.name: You Would Not Want to Live in Dex

AbsurdlySpaciousSewer.name: Absurdly Spacious Sewer
AbsurdlySpaciousSewer.def: Sewers with high enough ceilings for people to walk around comfortably and enough space to hold an entire castle.

AbusiveWorkplace.name: Abusive Workplace
AbusiveWorkplace.def: A place of employment that is detrimental to those who work there.

AcademyOfAdventure.name: Academy of Adventure
AcademyOfAdventure.def: In class, you learn to fly and shoot laser beams out of your eyes.

Adminisphere.name: Adminisphere
Adminisphere.def: The back office that administers the organisation. Likely to be out of touch with the sharp end of the business.

AdvancedAncientAcropolis.name: Advanced Ancient Acropolis
AdvancedAncientAcropolis.def: Exactly what it says on the tin. Often found in the darkest jungle. May overlap with City of Gold .

AdventurersClub.name: Adventurer's Club
AdventurersClub.def: When the globe-trotting hero isn't about his exciting business, he can relax at the club and swap stories with the like-minded.

AdventureTowns.name: Adventure Towns
AdventureTowns.def: Travel between towns for new quests.

Afrofuturism.name: Afrofuturism
Afrofuturism.def: Africa as a place of technological wonder and modernity, rather than a primitive, savage land or a collection of impoverished third-world countries.

AirstripOne.name: Airstrip One
AirstripOne.def: The Empire strips a conquered nation of its identity and assigns it a number.

TheAlcatraz.name: The Alcatraz
TheAlcatraz.def: A high-security prison where there's lava instead of the ocean and the guards are huge robots.

AliensInCardiff.name: Aliens in Cardiff
AliensInCardiff.def: Unusually, the Alien Invasion has gone off the Tokyo - New York - Los Angeles - London tourist route to land in Plymouth.

AllGhoulsSchool.name: All-Ghouls School
AllGhoulsSchool.def: Faculty for the freaky and fanged.

AmusementParkOfDoom.name: Amusement Park of Doom
AmusementParkOfDoom.def: No one has entered in ages and because of that, the place is riddled with traps that kill you.

AncientTomb.name: Ancient Tomb
AncientTomb.def: Tombs, burial chambers, sepulchers, mausoleums, charnel houses, ossuaries, catacombs, crypts, sometimes even dungeons.

ApartmentComplexOfHorrors.name: Apartment Complex of Horrors
ApartmentComplexOfHorrors.def: Awful apartments, infested by horrors from awful neighbors to rats and ghosts.

Area51.name: Area 51
Area51.def: A top-secret research facility in the desert.

AsceticAesthetic.name: Ascetic Aesthetic
AsceticAesthetic.def: In this setting, less is more.

AthleticArenaLevel.name: Athletic Arena Level
AthleticArenaLevel.def: Football and Baseball and Hockey, OH MY! And all of them are trying to play at once.

AtTheCrossroads.name: At the Crossroads
AtTheCrossroads.def: Where the paths of two fates cross.

AwesomeUnderwaterWorld.name: Awesome Underwater World
AwesomeUnderwaterWorld.def: The bottom of the ocean is an interesting place.

BadGuyBar.name: Bad Guy Bar
BadGuyBar.def: Everyone inside is a macho wrestler with an evil look on his face.

TheBadKingdom.name: The Bad Kingdom
TheBadKingdom.def: Everything is terrible and Aristocrats Are Evil ; in short, a standard Dark Fantasy setting. Alternatively, the place a wandering Barbarian Hero shows up to fix, with violence.

BarFullOfAliens.name: Bar Full of Aliens
BarFullOfAliens.def: The clientele of this place is kind of... alien.

Barsetshire.name: Barsetshire
Barsetshire.def: A bucolic, often English countryside in which tales of ordinary personal comedy and drama take place.

BaseOnWheels.name: Base on Wheels
BaseOnWheels.def: How is it possible to keep an entire city on wheels that can drive anywhere, even submerge? Beats me.

BazaarOfTheBizarre.name: Bazaar of the Bizarre
BazaarOfTheBizarre.def: A marketplace in the Middle East. You'll find all sorts of this and that in there.

BBCQuarry.name: BBC Quarry
BBCQuarry.def: The ISO Standard alien planet set. A disused or rented quarry full of interestingly dull rocks and fascinatingly monotonous scenery; the perfect alien-landscape-on-a-budget.

TheBermudaTriangle.name: The Bermuda Triangle
TheBermudaTriangle.def: Where planes and ships go to enter inter-dimensional rifts (maybe).

BigApplesauce.name: Big Applesauce
BigApplesauce.def: Because New York is the only city aliens and monsters like to destroy.

BigFancyCastle.name: Big Fancy Castle
BigFancyCastle.def: Much like Big Fancy House, but with more towers. And secret passages. And dungeons.

BigFancyHouse.name: Big Fancy House
BigFancyHouse.def: A house on a hill. It's not dirty. It has more rooms than any other house around.

BiggerOnTheInside.name: Bigger on the Inside
BiggerOnTheInside.def: A building that looks small - possibly ridiculously small - but opens up into a giant mansion or other area.

BigLabyrinthineBuilding.name: Big Labyrinthine Building
BigLabyrinthineBuilding.def: A huge building consisting of nothing but a maze.

TheBigRottenApple.name: The Big Rotten Apple
TheBigRottenApple.def: Where New York is a squalid decaying crime-ridden Hell on Earth.

BleakBorderBase.name: Bleak Border Base
BleakBorderBase.def: A fortress at the furthest corner of the country.

BoardingSchoolOfHorrors.name: Boarding School of Horrors
BoardingSchoolOfHorrors.def: The breeding ground of Sadist Teachers and cutthroat battles for social dominance.

BoomTown.name: Boom Town
BoomTown.def: Whoa, these guys build and breed fast.

TheBridge.name: The Bridge
TheBridge.def: Where sci-fi guys go to get to know each other .

BronsonCanyonAndCaves.name: Bronson Canyon and Caves
BronsonCanyonAndCaves.def: A rocky area in Los Angeles' Griffith Park, whose relatively convenient location and desolate, remote appearance have made it a very popular filming location, particularly for works in the Science Fiction and Western genres.

BuildingOfAdventure.name: Building of Adventure
BuildingOfAdventure.def: A single building is the setting.

CaliforniaUniversity.name: California University
CaliforniaUniversity.def: When kids in a High School drama get too old to be believable, expect most of them to go here.

CanadaDoesNotExist.name: Canada Does Not Exist
CanadaDoesNotExist.def: What do you do when you're ashamed to be shooting your show in Canada, but can't set it in America?

CardboardPrison.name: Cardboard Prison
CardboardPrison.def: A prison that is way too easy to escape, so that villains can be reused.

ChezRestaurant.name: Chez Restaurant
ChezRestaurant.def: Expect snails, frog legs, temperamental chefs, and snotty waiters with funny accents .

ChristmasTown.name: Christmas Town
ChristmasTown.def: Home of Santa Claus , the Christmas Elves and Christmas Magic!

CircleOfStandingStones.name: Circle of Standing Stones
CircleOfStandingStones.def: A ring of giant stones where important events often occur.

CityInABottle.name: City in a Bottle
CityInABottle.def: There has never been anything outside The City . Beyond its well-policed walls is unknown darkness.

TheCityNarrows.name: The City Narrows
TheCityNarrows.def: Basically, your typical city slum , but even more dangerous .

CityNoir.name: City Noir
CityNoir.def: Like a city, except it's always dark and rainy, crime is everywhere, and the Police Are Useless (or even worse ).

CityOfAdventure.name: City of Adventure
CityOfAdventure.def: All the adventure and excitement you could possibly crave conveniently rolled up into a single city.

CityOfCanals.name: City of Canals
CityOfCanals.def: A city where waterways are used as streets. Usually mirrors Venice.

CityOfEverywhere.name: City of Everywhere
CityOfEverywhere.def: Lady Liberty 's just a few blocks from the Louvre.

CityOfGold.name: City of Gold
CityOfGold.def: A country chock full of wealth and splendor.

CityWithNoName.name: City with No Name
CityWithNoName.def: The writers were lazy when thinking about the location, or wanted it to be anywhere.

ClimbingTheCliffsOfInsanity.name: Climbing the Cliffs of Insanity
ClimbingTheCliffsOfInsanity.def: Tall walls of rock keeping you from your destination.

ClockTower.name: Clock Tower
ClockTower.def: The town clock, the one that everybody sets their clocks to. May be a bell tower you have to ascend .

CloseKnitCommunity.name: Close-Knit Community
CloseKnitCommunity.def: Whether rural, urban, or suburban, a place where everyone knows each other and looks out for each other.

CobwebJungle.name: Cobweb Jungle
CobwebJungle.def: A spooky, abandoned location where cobwebs are as thick as jungle undergrowth.

Commune.name: Commune
Commune.def: A place where everybody lives together in a self-sustaining community. May or may not be part of a Free-Love Future , may or may not include the New-Age Retro Hippie .

CompanyTown.name: Company Town
CompanyTown.def: A town created by a company for its employees, where they're the law for all practical purposes.

ContainerMaze.name: Container Maze
ContainerMaze.def: A labyrinth of crates or containers in a warehouse, storeroom or dock.

ContemplationLocation.name: Contemplation Location
ContemplationLocation.def: A place where a character goes to think or meditate.

CoolestClubEver.name: Coolest Club Ever
CoolestClubEver.def: So great, it's always packed. (If it plays techno, it may even have lasers!)

CoolShip.name: Cool Ship
CoolShip.def: Anything that's called a ship and has lasers.

CoolStarship.name: Cool Starship
CoolStarship.def: A starship, but with even more lasers than usual.

CorpseLand.name: Corpse Land
CorpseLand.def: A devastated location where no one has cleaned up the bodies of the fallen (and maybe never will).

TheCouch.name: The Couch
TheCouch.def: It's very soft, and is always center stage.

CrappyCarnival.name: Crappy Carnival
CrappyCarnival.def: Like Disneyland, if Mickey was a grubby Con Man .

CreatorProvincialism.name: Creator Provincialism
CreatorProvincialism.def: If the creator lives in X, the setting in the work they created will be X.

CreepyBasement.name: Creepy Basement
CreepyBasement.def: Like a regular basement, but with more spiders.

CreepyCathedral.name: Creepy Cathedral
CreepyCathedral.def: The bells are haunting at midnight.

CreepyCave.name: Creepy Cave
CreepyCave.def: Watch out for vampire bats ! And for regular vampires.

CreepyCemetery.name: Creepy Cemetery
CreepyCemetery.def: The place with the reputation for mass-producing the undead.

CrystalLandscape.name: Crystal Landscape
CrystalLandscape.def: A setting filled with or completely composed of crystals, gemstones and jewels.

CultColony.name: Cult Colony
CultColony.def: An isolated group of religious settlers.

CutAndPasteSuburb.name: Cut-and-Paste Suburb
CutAndPasteSuburb.def: Hey, I think I saw that house before. And that one too!

DangerInTheGalacticCore.name: Danger in the Galactic Core
DangerInTheGalacticCore.def: The wild center of the galaxy.

DangerousWorkplace.name: Dangerous Workplace
DangerousWorkplace.def: Drinking from the water cooler will burn down the building.

DarkestAfrica.name: Darkest Africa
DarkestAfrica.def: Everyone in Africa has a bone in their nose and hair, dances around a bonfire, and lives in a straw hut. Tarzan and his pals may be present

DaycareNightmare.name: Daycare Nightmare
DaycareNightmare.def: A daycare (US) or nursery school (UK) where you really wouldn't want to send your kids.

DecadentCourt.name: Decadent Court
DecadentCourt.def: The entourage of the leaders conduct warfare in an ostensibly polite and civilized social battlefield.

DeepSouth.name: Deep South
DeepSouth.def: Rednecks, moonshiners, KKK and all that

DenOfIniquity.name: Den of Iniquity
DenOfIniquity.def: Where the Mooks and Minions unwind.

DesertedIsland.name: Deserted Island
DesertedIsland.def: No one lives there. Good place to be marooned. Full of Jungle Japes .

DomedHometown.name: Domed Hometown
DomedHometown.def: City in a dome. Underwater optional.

DownInTheDumps.name: Down in the Dumps
DownInTheDumps.def: Is that a skyscraper of wrecked cars?

DownLADrain.name: Down L.A. Drain
DownLADrain.def: The LA storm drain system is used as the setting in a film/TV show, usually a car chase.

DriveInTheater.name: Drive-In Theater
DriveInTheater.def: Sit in your car and enjoy the show.

DungeonBasedEconomy.name: Dungeon-Based Economy
DungeonBasedEconomy.def: Dungeon delving is the major local industry.

DyingTown.name: Dying Town
DyingTown.def: Having lost its reason to exist, the town is largely shuttered and abandoned, home to only those who couldn't move elsewhere.

EerieArcticResearchStation.name: Eerie Arctic Research Station
EerieArcticResearchStation.def: A remote lab in an icy cold location as a tension-filled setting.

ElaborateUndergroundBase.name: Elaborate Underground Base
ElaborateUndergroundBase.def: A base that has a hangar, silo and laboratory.

EldritchLocation.name: Eldritch Location
EldritchLocation.def: Because Euclidean designs are for morons!

ElephantGraveyard.name: Elephant Graveyard
ElephantGraveyard.def: A secret place where elephants go to die.

EnchantedForest.name: Enchanted Forest
EnchantedForest.def: A large, old-growth forest in which nature (and often magic) are supreme.

EvilTaintedThePlace.name: Evil Tainted the Place
EvilTaintedThePlace.def: A location that has been corrupted forever because it was once home to an evil presence.

EvilTowerOfOminousness.name: Evil Tower of Ominousness
EvilTowerOfOminousness.def: That tower that's larger than the mountains? Definitely not the Evil Overlord's lair!

TheExactCenterOfEverything.name: The Exact Center of Everything
TheExactCenterOfEverything.def: The galactic core or center of the universe is a MacGuffin Location .

ExclusiveCliqueClubhouse.name: Exclusive Clique Clubhouse
ExclusiveCliqueClubhouse.def: Certain student groups get their own hideouts and housing.

ExtranormalInstitute.name: Extranormal Institute
ExtranormalInstitute.def: Super-trope of all your schools for people with weird powers or abilities.

ExtremelyDustyHome.name: Extremely Dusty Home
ExtremelyDustyHome.def: A abandoned house with layer upon layer of dust and cobwebs.

FakeTown.name: Fake Town
FakeTown.def: A fake town or city built to look like a real one.

FanConvention.name: Fan Convention
FanConvention.def: Places where fans gather to engage in their hobbies.

FantasticUnderworld.name: Fantastic Underworld
FantasticUnderworld.def: A place underground with lots of interesting stuff.

FarSideIsland.name: "Far Side" Island
FarSideIsland.def: A tiny island in the middle of nowhere housing a single palm tree.

FatCamp.name: Fat Camp
FatCamp.def: A summer camp where parents send overweight kids to diet and to get off their butts and go outside.

FictionalCountry.name: Fictional Country
FictionalCountry.def: See also Fictional Culture and Nation Tropes

FictionalProvince.name: Fictional Province
FictionalProvince.def: A fictional subset of a real country.

FloatingContinent.name: Floating Continent
FloatingContinent.def: A floating chunk of land as an exotic locale.

FlyoverCountry.name: Flyover Country
FlyoverCountry.def: The middle of America, where no one from New York or California seems to want to film.

ForbiddenZone.name: Forbidden Zone
ForbiddenZone.def: A dangerous place no one wants to go (except the heroes, of course).

FriendlyLocalChinatown.name: Friendly Local Chinatown
FriendlyLocalChinatown.def: Sections of large American cities where Chinese culture can be found close at hand.

GadgeteersHouse.name: Gadgeteer's House
GadgeteersHouse.def: An inventor lives here, so nearly everything is automated.

GardenOfEvil.name: Garden of Evil
GardenOfEvil.def: A place where most or all of the plants are poisonous, carnivorous, or otherwise dangerous.

Gayborhood.name: Gayborhood
Gayborhood.def: A neighborhood where the population is predominantly openly LGBT in a city where most people aren't.

GeographicFlexibility.name: Geographic Flexibility
GeographicFlexibility.def: When the setting grows, shrinks, adds, and loses features as the plot demands.

GhibliHills.name: Ghibli Hills
GhibliHills.def: Pristine, untouched wilderness, often within easy reach of civilization.

GiantCorpseWorld.name: Giant Corpse World
GiantCorpseWorld.def: A setting where people live in or on a giant decaying corpse.

GildedCage.name: Gilded Cage
GildedCage.def: A comfortable place that keeps a character isolated from the real world.

GingerbreadHouse.name: Gingerbread House
GingerbreadHouse.def: A house or other building made of food, usually candy and sweets. Usually a fairy-tale setting.

GoodGuyBar.name: Good-Guy Bar
GoodGuyBar.def: Where the heroes hang out after hours. Villains are welcome if they behave.

TheGoodKingdom.name: The Good Kingdom
TheGoodKingdom.def: Where good monarchs reign. Usually small, pleasant, and an underdog against The Empire .

GreasySpoon.name: Greasy Spoon
GreasySpoon.def: A roadside diner, often stuck perpetually in the American 1950s and serving anti-diet food.

GreatBigLibraryOfEverything.name: Great Big Library of Everything
GreatBigLibraryOfEverything.def: An absurdly large and well-stocked library.

HackerCave.name: Hacker Cave
HackerCave.def: A room filled with an over-the-top mess of computers and monitors and other bits of geekery, where hackers somehow get work done.

Halloweentown.name: Halloweentown
Halloweentown.def: A setting with a very stylized creepy, gothic, Halloween theme.

HauntedCastle.name: Haunted Castle
HauntedCastle.def: A spooky castle where there be monsters.

HauntedHeadquarters.name: Haunted Headquarters
HauntedHeadquarters.def: A spooky place where there be monsters, and you're stuck living or working there.

HauntedHouse.name: Haunted House
HauntedHouse.def: A spooky house where there be monsters.

HedgeMaze.name: Hedge Maze
HedgeMaze.def: A maze made up of hedgerows, usually found somewhere fancy and rich.

TheHedgeOfThorns.name: The Hedge of Thorns
TheHedgeOfThorns.def: A large bramble of nasty thorns, usually where faeries or evil sorcerers want to block your way.

HeelFaceTown.name: Heel–Face Town
HeelFaceTown.def: A Wretched Hive that became a better place to live.

HellHotel.name: Hell Hotel
HellHotel.def: A creepy hotel where bad things happen.

HellOfAHeaven.name: Hell of a Heaven
HellOfAHeaven.def: When Heaven sucks just for you.

HiddenElfVillage.name: Hidden Elf Village
HiddenElfVillage.def: A secret, safe place far from the eyes of those other meddling nations.

HideawayInTheDangerZone.name: Hideaway in the Danger Zone
HideawayInTheDangerZone.def: A home base intentionally established in an extremely hostile environment.

HolyGround.name: Holy Ground
HolyGround.def: Not full of holes. Or divine coffee.

HomeOfMonsters.name: Home of Monsters
HomeOfMonsters.def: Any place monsters call home, whether it be a lair, a whole dimension, a Monster Town or Island of Mystery .

HouseOfBrokenMirrors.name: House of Broken Mirrors
HouseOfBrokenMirrors.def: Where someone who went mad from loathing their appearance has smashed all their mirrors and left them.

HungryJungle.name: Hungry Jungle
HungryJungle.def: Jungles are out to kill you.

IcePalace.name: Ice Palace
IcePalace.def: A castle made of ice or one that's completely frozen over.

IDontLikeTheSoundOfThatPlace.name: I Don't Like the Sound of That Place
IDontLikeTheSoundOfThatPlace.def: A place with a sinister name.

IdyllicEnglishVillage.name: Idyllic English Village
IdyllicEnglishVillage.def: A quintessentially English village full of dainty cottages with thatched roofs.

ImmortalityField.name: Immortality Field
ImmortalityField.def: A place that functions as an Immortality Inducer .

IncompetenceInc.name: Incompetence, Inc.
IncompetenceInc.def: An office culture where nothing of value gets done, and where it's a mystery how they stay in business.

IndianBurialGround.name: Indian Burial Ground
IndianBurialGround.def: A place where someone desecrated the graves of Native Americans by building something on it. Expect ghosts.

IndustrialGhetto.name: Industrial Ghetto
IndustrialGhetto.def: A slum near or inside an industrial area, often made of scrap and filled with crime and pollution.

IndustrializedMercury.name: Industrialized Mercury
IndustrializedMercury.def: The planet Mercury is used as an industrial hub for a Colonized Solar System .

IndustrialWorld.name: Industrial World
IndustrialWorld.def: A One-Product Planet specifically dedicated to material production.

InformedLocation.name: Informed Location
InformedLocation.def: The location of the setting is specified despite it being not relevant to the story.

InjunCountry.name: Injun Country
InjunCountry.def: The North American lands filled with folks who were there before the settlers arrived.

InnBetweenTheWorlds.name: Inn Between the Worlds
InnBetweenTheWorlds.def: A pub that connects to multiple worlds, where people of all types can relax and swap stories.

InnerCitySchool.name: Inner City School
InnerCitySchool.def: An impoverished city school where the teachers have given up, and students are on the fast track to prison.

InnOfNoReturn.name: Inn of No Return
InnOfNoReturn.def: An inn or hotel where the owners kill and then rob or eat their customers. Often a Hell Hotel .

InsideAComputerSystem.name: Inside a Computer System
InsideAComputerSystem.def: Inside a self-contained virtual world (unlike Cyberspace , in which locations correspond to the real world).

InTheDoldrums.name: In the Doldrums
InTheDoldrums.def: A featureless location, often an empty plane or void. More than just somewhere boring.

IslandBase.name: Island Base
IslandBase.def: A Supervillain Lair on an isolated island.

IsleOfGiantHorrors.name: Isle of Giant Horrors
IsleOfGiantHorrors.def: An island inhabited by giant creatures.

IslandOfMisfitEverything.name: Island of Misfit Everything
IslandOfMisfitEverything.def: A haven for the misfits, rejects and forlorn.

IslandOfMystery.name: Island of Mystery
IslandOfMystery.def: An island with any one of a number of unusual things on it.

ItCameFromBeverlyHills.name: It Came from Beverly Hills
ItCameFromBeverlyHills.def: Takes place in Beverly Hills, California.

KirksRock.name: Kirk's Rock
KirksRock.def: A distinctive set of striated sandstone slabs, sharply-angled and pointed at their tops, conveniently located about 30 miles north of Hollywood.

KnownByThePostalAddress.name: Known by the Postal Address
KnownByThePostalAddress.def: The exact address of a place is often referred to in a work.

KookyCascadia.name: Kooky Cascadia
KookyCascadia.def: The Pacific Northwest is depicted as a land of quirky people, offbeat subcultures, and supernatural occurrences.

LadyLand.name: Lady Land
LadyLand.def: Where women rule, and men are either subservient or absent.

LandmarkingTheHiddenBase.name: Landmarking the Hidden Base
LandmarkingTheHiddenBase.def: A secret base hidden under or in some famous landmark.

LastFertileRegion.name: Last Fertile Region
LastFertileRegion.def: The last bit of nature and greenery in a wasteland dystopia.

TheLavaCavesOfNewYork.name: The Lava Caves of New York
TheLavaCavesOfNewYork.def: Lava or magma in locales that normally don't support volcanic activity.

LayeredMetropolis.name: Layered Metropolis
LayeredMetropolis.def: A city with multiple, vertically-separated levels, usually with the rich on top.

LayeredWorld.name: Layered World
LayeredWorld.def: A world with multiple dimensions, where locations in each dimension map to each other, creating "layers" of reality.

LegalizedEvil.name: Legalized Evil
LegalizedEvil.def: Where acts of wrongdoing among the populace are legally allowed by the setting's ruling authority.

LethalEatery.name: Lethal Eatery
LethalEatery.def: A restaurant that violates health codes in staggering ways. Usually played for comedy.

LevelAte.name: Level Ate
LevelAte.def: A Video Game location made entirely of food.

LevelInTheClouds.name: Level in the Clouds
LevelInTheClouds.def: A Video Game world set in the skies.

LifeGivingOasis.name: Life-Giving Oasis
LifeGivingOasis.def: An area of green in an otherwise barren desert.

TheLittleShopThatWasntThereYesterday.name: The Little Shop That Wasn't There Yesterday
TheLittleShopThatWasntThereYesterday.def: A magical shop that appears out of nowhere to sell a MacGuffin and then disappears when it causes trouble.

LocalHangout.name: Local Hangout
LocalHangout.def: Where the cast spends most of their time hanging out. Brits may use My Local (pub) instead.

LockedInTheDungeon.name: Locked in the Dungeon
LockedInTheDungeon.def: A medieval-style underground prison / torture chamber.

LocomotiveLevel.name: Locomotive Level
LocomotiveLevel.def: A Video Game level that takes place on a train.

LostWorld.name: Lost World
LostWorld.def: A mysterious, isolated place not found on any maps where exotic adventures can occur.

LovecraftCountry.name: Lovecraft Country
LovecraftCountry.def: A creepy, horror version of rural New England , where corrupt hicks conspire with dark forces.

LoversLedge.name: Lover's Ledge
LoversLedge.def: An outside window ledge where The Casanova must hide to avoid being caught during Interrupted Intimacy .

LowLiteracySetting.name: Low-Literacy Setting
LowLiteracySetting.def: A setting where most people can't read or write.

MacGuffinLocation.name: MacGuffin Location
MacGuffinLocation.def: When the MacGuffin everyone is competing over is a place.

MadScienceFair.name: Mad Science Fair
MadScienceFair.def: A contest or convention involving mad scientists and their mad experiments.

MageTower.name: Mage Tower
MageTower.def: The Tower where a wizard does his research (or plotting) above and away from the people. Often contains telescopes, orreries, hidden artifacts , secret passages , tomes of eldritch lore , etc.

MagicalLibrary.name: Magical Library
MagicalLibrary.def: A library of magic books, often itself enchanted and often safekeeping magical artifacts.

MajorWorldCities.name: Major World Cities
MajorWorldCities.def: An index of the largest and most important real world cities used in fiction.

MakeOutPoint.name: Make-Out Point
MakeOutPoint.def: A secluded place, often with a good view, where teens go for Auto Erotica . Bad things often happen there .

TheMall.name: The Mall
TheMall.def: A modern, indoor, shopping complex, peaking in The '80s . Home of the Valley Girl and the Mall Santa .

MaltShop.name: Malt Shop
MaltShop.def: A popular teen Local Hangout in The '50s where burgers, hot dogs, and malted milkshakes are served while the jukebox plays.

MartyrdomCulture.name: Martyrdom Culture
MartyrdomCulture.def: A culture that glorifies death in the name of some cause or belief.

MasqueradeBall.name: Masquerade Ball
MasqueradeBall.def: An elaborate, period dance where all the attendees wear masks. Duplicity often occurs.

MechanicalEcosystem.name: Mechanical Ecosystem
MechanicalEcosystem.def: A mechanical replica of a natural environment.

MegaCity.name: Mega City
MegaCity.def: A city with the size or population of a country.

MegaDungeon.name: Mega Dungeon
MegaDungeon.def: A dungeon-like environment that's big enough to spend the whole story there.

MenacingMuseum.name: Menacing Museum
MenacingMuseum.def: A museum portrayed as ominous, dangerous or just plain evil.

MerchantCity.name: Merchant City
MerchantCity.def: A trade city, ruled or mostly populated by merchants, bankers, and traders.

MercurialBase.name: Mercurial Base
MercurialBase.def: A base on a planet close to a star that stays out of the sun by following the night around the planet.

MetalPoorPlanet.name: Metal-Poor Planet
MetalPoorPlanet.def: A planet where the key ingredients for technological civilization are missing.

MicroMonarchy.name: Micro Monarchy
MicroMonarchy.def: A modern, very tiny nation ruled by a royal family. Usually an eclectic mix of tradition and modernity.

MiddleOfNowhereStreet.name: Middle-of-Nowhere Street
MiddleOfNowhereStreet.def: A very small location that is a Weirdness Magnet , and no one outside notices or minds.

MishmashMuseum.name: Mishmash Museum
MishmashMuseum.def: A museum with no apparent rhyme or reason to the ways its exhibits are laid out.

MisplacedWildlife.name: Misplaced Wildlife
MisplacedWildlife.def: A place where animals that don't belong are present, usually due to creator error .

MissingFloor.name: Missing Floor
MissingFloor.def: A secret floor in a multilevel building. Often skipped by the buttons in an elevator.

MobileMaze.name: Mobile Maze
MobileMaze.def: A maze which changes ( itself ) to make it hard or impossible to escape.

MonsterMenagerie.name: Monster Menagerie
MonsterMenagerie.def: A facility where unusual creatures are contained, imprisoned, or studied.

MonsterShapedMountain.name: Monster-Shaped Mountain
MonsterShapedMountain.def: A rocky terrain feature resembles, or is, a giant creature or portion thereof.

MonsterTown.name: Monster Town
MonsterTown.def: A town entirely populated by monsters. May have a twisted, alien culture or similar to ours.

MonumentalBattle.name: Monumental Battle
MonumentalBattle.def: Dramatic battles always seem to take place around major landmarks.

MonumentalView.name: Monumental View
MonumentalView.def: A place with an impossible cool view (often of a landmark) that is way beyond the means of its owner.

Mordor.name: Mordor
Mordor.def: A Shadowland where the Big Bad 's Fisher King-ness poisons the land and makes it utterly inhospitable and Obviously Evil .

MountaintopHealthcare.name: Mountaintop Healthcare
MountaintopHealthcare.def: Specialized medical facilities built on a picturesque, inaccessible mountain.

MuseumOfBoredom.name: Museum of Boredom
MuseumOfBoredom.def: A boring, often extremely niche museum in which (almost) none of the cast is interested.

MuseumOfTheStrangeAndUnusual.name: Museum of the Strange and Unusual
MuseumOfTheStrangeAndUnusual.def: An awesomely eclectic museum with a collection of impossibly cool and downright bizarre stuff.

MyLocal.name: My Local
MyLocal.def: A pub, where the main cast usually hangs out. A British-specific Local Hangout .

MysteriousAntarctica.name: Mysterious Antarctica
MysteriousAntarctica.def: One of the last explored places on Earth's surface. Popular location of lost civilizations and hidden Nazi bases .

MysticalHollywood.name: Mystical Hollywood
MysticalHollywood.def: Hollywood presented as an Eldritch Location or as a place of supernatural activity.

NativeAmericanCasino.name: Native American Casino
NativeAmericanCasino.def: All movie Indian reservations have casinos.

NeglectedRez.name: Neglected Rez
NeglectedRez.def: Indigineous American and First Nation communities that were created via forced relocation by settlers and the government, whose policies have led them to fall into poverty disrepair.

TheNeutralZone.name: The Neutral Zone
TheNeutralZone.def: Territory in between nations in a Cold War that is off-limits to keep a war from restarting. Opposite of Truce Zone .

NeverLand.name: Never Land
NeverLand.def: A setting whose entire population is in eternal childhood .

NewNeighboursAsThePlotDemands.name: New Neighbours as the Plot Demands
NewNeighboursAsThePlotDemands.def: Remember the New Guy? as applied to a small town setting.

NightmarishNursery.name: Nightmarish Nursery
NightmarishNursery.def: A childish setting such as a nursery or playground played for horror or suspense.

NoCommunitiesWereHarmed.name: No Communities Were Harmed
NoCommunitiesWereHarmed.def: The geographic equivalent of a Bland-Name Product or Captain Ersatz .

NonHeteronormativeSociety.name: Non-Heteronormative Society
NonHeteronormativeSociety.def: Where being queer is seen as normal.

NonResidentialResidence.name: Non-Residential Residence
NonResidentialResidence.def: A building or location someone is living in that was not intended to be a residence.

NonSequiturEnvironment.name: Non Sequitur Environment
NonSequiturEnvironment.def: A setting that suddenly appears out of nowhere with no logical explanation or transition.

NoTellMotel.name: No-Tell Motel
NoTellMotel.def: A sleazy motel that caters to a low-class clientele.

NothingExcitingEverHappensHere.name: Nothing Exciting Ever Happens Here
NothingExcitingEverHappensHere.def: The setting is so normal, it's boring... until something new comes in that upends that normality.

NotSoSafeHarbor.name: Not-So-Safe Harbor
NotSoSafeHarbor.def: A Wretched Hive of seaside villainy.

OceanPunk.name: Ocean Punk
OceanPunk.def: Take your standard dystopian Punk setting and Just Add Water .

OhLookMoreRooms.name: Oh Look, More Rooms!
OhLookMoreRooms.def: A place looks fairly normal from the outside, but every door leads to more rooms than there should be given the size of the place.

OldDarkHouse.name: Old, Dark House
OldDarkHouse.def: The classic setting for Ten Little Murder Victims . A Haunted House without the actual haunting.

YeOldeNuclearSilo.name: Ye Olde Nuclear Silo
YeOldeNuclearSilo.def: In the future, abandoned nuclear silos are ready-made Elaborate Underground Bases .

OldFashionedFarm.name: Old-Fashioned Farm
OldFashionedFarm.def: A farm that still resembles farmhouses from the 19th/early 20th century.

OneGenderSchool.name: One-Gender School
OneGenderSchool.def: Single-sex education. In modern works , expect Situational Sexuality .

OneNeighborNeighborhood.name: One-Neighbor Neighborhood
OneNeighborNeighborhood.def: Conservation of Detail applied to a TV neighborhood, usually to save budget on actors and sets.

OneProductPlanet.name: One-Product Planet
OneProductPlanet.def: For simplicity's sake, a planet in SF is only ever famous for a single good or service.

OnlyShopInTown.name: Only Shop in Town
OnlyShopInTown.def: Small towns (or towns of any size in most Video Games ) only have a single store run by the town's shopkeeper.

OpiumDen.name: Opium Den
OpiumDen.def: A 19th century drug house, often far more romanticized than modern equivalents. Associated mostly with the British Empire and China.

OppressiveStatesOfAmerica.name: Oppressive States of America
OppressiveStatesOfAmerica.def: A fictional United States in which democracy doesn't exist anymore.

OutcastRefuge.name: Outcast Refuge
OutcastRefuge.def: A location where oppressed/outcast peoples can live in relative safety.

OutlawTown.name: Outlaw Town
OutlawTown.def: A town run for the benefit of criminals or one entirely populated by criminals.

OverlaidSocieties.name: Overlaid Societies
OverlaidSocieties.def: Two or more communities that occupy the same space. They may interact with each other, or not be aware of each other's existence.

ThePampas.name: The Pampas
ThePampas.def: The endless grasslands of South America, and home of the gauchos. Very common in Latin American Literature , specially Argentine Literature

ParadisePlanet.name: Paradise Planet
ParadisePlanet.def: The most beautiful and most desirable world in the galaxy.

ParkingGarage.name: Parking Garage
ParkingGarage.def: Nothing good ever happens in a parking garage.

PatchworkWorld.name: Patchwork World
PatchworkWorld.def: A world assembled from multiple other worlds or sources. If done haphazardly, may result in a Patchwork Map .

PenalColony.name: Penal Colony
PenalColony.def: A remote land to exile criminals to to make sure they can't escape (in theory). Populated only by crooks & guards. Sometimes used to dump off the poor and other undesirables too.

PeopleZoo.name: People Zoo
PeopleZoo.def: An alien zoo containing humans and other intelligent life as part of the exhibits.

PlanetEngland.name: Planet England
PlanetEngland.def: A series that starts in a small, named region of a greater world will use that name for the greater world once you are introduced to it.

PlanetOfCopyhats.name: Planet of Copyhats
PlanetOfCopyhats.def: Writers use the quirks of a single character as the "hat" for their entire people. (e.g. When you visit the drunk guy's homeland, everyone else is an alcoholic too.)

PleasurePlanet.name: Pleasure Planet
PleasurePlanet.def: An entire planet is dedicated to being a perfect leisure spot. May or may not be a trap .

PollutedWasteland.name: Polluted Wasteland
PollutedWasteland.def: A land destroyed by pollution. SF and modern equivalent of Mordor , but don't expect quick fixes .

PortalCrossroadWorld.name: Portal Crossroad World
PortalCrossroadWorld.def: A world where one can easily travel to many other worlds.

PossessiveParadise.name: Possessive Paradise
PossessiveParadise.def: A paradise setting with an unfortunate tendency towards the yandere .

POWCamp.name: P.O.W. Camp
POWCamp.def: Populated by soldiers captured on the field of battle by their enemies.

Premiseville.name: Premiseville
Premiseville.def: The name of the place establishes the premise of the setting.

PrivatelyOwnedSociety.name: Privately Owned Society
PrivatelyOwnedSociety.def: Everything is owned by individuals, nothing is run by the government (at least not effectively).

ThePromisedLand.name: The Promised Land
ThePromisedLand.def: The place that promises to be better than where we are. Where the Grass Is Greener .

QuirkyTown.name: Quirky Town
QuirkyTown.def: A small town filled with quirky and adorable characters.

RailroadToHorizon.name: Railroad to Horizon
RailroadToHorizon.def: A railroad disappearing into the distance is used as a metaphor for the journey ahead.

RecordingStudioScene.name: Recording Studio Scene
RecordingStudioScene.def: A plot or scene is set in a recording studio showing the musicians making music or interacting in that perspective.

RedLightDistrict.name: Red-Light District
RedLightDistrict.def: The part of town where all the brothels, bars, and other places of seedy night-time enjoyment can be found.

RichReclusesRealm.name: Rich Recluse's Realm
RichReclusesRealm.def: A private domain bought and/or built by a super-rich recluse.

RidiculouslyDifficultRoute.name: Ridiculously Difficult Route
RidiculouslyDifficultRoute.def: When a route is usually never used because it's just too difficult and/or there are other, easier ways.

RiverOfInsanity.name: River of Insanity
RiverOfInsanity.def: People who go on a journey down a river into the unknown will not make it back unchanged.

RoguePlanet.name: Rogue Planet
RoguePlanet.def: A planet which travels through space, with no home star.

SapientShip.name: Sapient Ship
SapientShip.def: Your spaceship has a mind of its own and often flies itself.

ScavengedPunk.name: Scavenged Punk
ScavengedPunk.def: People rely on junk and other "found" technology rather than manufacturing their own, either due to it being After the End or due to living the shadow of human society.

SceneryBasedSocietalBarometer.name: Scenery-Based Societal Barometer
SceneryBasedSocietalBarometer.def: A single recurring location is used to measure the condition of a larger setting.

SchoolIsMurder.name: School is Murder
SchoolIsMurder.def: A school with a Weirdness Magnet that results in a high student mortality rate

Scienceville.name: Scienceville
Scienceville.def: A town, district or city well-known for its professional thinkers.

SeaSinkhole.name: Sea Sinkhole
SeaSinkhole.def: Just when you thought falling off the edge of a flat earth wouldn't be a problem.

SeaStories.name: Sea Stories
SeaStories.def: Any story taking place with the ocean as its primary setting.

SecretGovernmentWarehouse.name: Secret Government Warehouse
