SecretGovernmentWarehouse.def: Where the government hides all the stuff the people are better off not knowing about.

SecretHistory.name: Secret History
SecretHistory.def: The work claims that it took place in Real Life , but the audience never heard of its events because In-Universe actors kept it secret .

SecretRoom.name: Secret Room
SecretRoom.def: A hidden room in a building.

SecretShop.name: Secret Shop
SecretShop.def: A shop whose business model somehow revolves around having great stuff and telling next to no one about it.

SelfInflictedHell.name: Self-Inflicted Hell
SelfInflictedHell.def: A character suffers in the afterlife only because they believe they deserve it.

SettingAsACharacter.name: Setting as a Character
SettingAsACharacter.def: The setting is as important a driver of the story as any character but is not truly an intelligent person in its own right like a Sapient Ship or Genius Loci .

SettlingTheFrontier.name: Settling the Frontier
SettlingTheFrontier.def: Can serve as either a setting for a story or as a Plot .

SeverelySpecializedStore.name: Severely Specialized Store
SeverelySpecializedStore.def: We sell one thing, and one thing only.

TheShangriLa.name: The Shangri-La
TheShangriLa.def: A paradise high up in the mountains.

ShapedLikeWhatItSells.name: Shaped Like What It Sells
ShapedLikeWhatItSells.def: A shop's storefront or whole building is shaped to advertise the product it sells.

ShatteredWorld.name: Shattered World
ShatteredWorld.def: A planet broken into pieces and floating in space/the void but still inhabited.

ShiningCity.name: Shining City
ShiningCity.def: The greatest and most beautiful city in the world. The home of righteousness, justice, and civilization.

ShrineToSelf.name: Shrine to Self
ShrineToSelf.def: When a narcissist exaggerates the trope.

SinisterSouthwest.name: Sinister Southwest
SinisterSouthwest.def: The American Southwest is basically a death trap.

SinisterSubway.name: Sinister Subway
SinisterSubway.def: The Absurdly Spacious Sewer 's more realistic and spooky counterpart.

SkyscraperCity.name: Skyscraper City
SkyscraperCity.def: In the future, skyscrapers will be tall . An entire city of Star Scrapers .

SmallTownBigHell.name: Small Town, Big Hell
SmallTownBigHell.def: A small town with literally no secrets between their inhabitants. If something happens to you there, everyone will know about it.

SmallTownRivalry.name: Small Town Rivalry
SmallTownRivalry.def: Two small towns close by, but that hate each other intensely.

SmartHouse.name: Smart House
SmartHouse.def: A Cool House with a built-in AI. Hope luck is on your side.

SmokyGentlemensClub.name: Smoky Gentlemen's Club
SmokyGentlemensClub.def: Where stereotypical rich men hang out away from wives, servants, and other common people.

SoapboxSquare.name: Soapbox Square
SoapboxSquare.def: A public park or square where rabble-rousers can make impassioned speeches to cheering or booing crowds.

SoiledCityOnAHill.name: Soiled City on a Hill
SoiledCityOnAHill.def: The ruins of a failed Shining City .

SolidClouds.name: Solid Clouds
SolidClouds.def: Clouds that you can walk or even build on top of. Commonly seen in Fluffy Cloud Heaven .

SoulCrushingDeskJob.name: Soul-Crushing Desk Job
SoulCrushingDeskJob.def: Office work place that is boring and stultifying.

SoullessBedroom.name: Soulless Bedroom
SoullessBedroom.def: Someone who lacks emotions has an unnaturally clean bedroom with few or no personal possessions.

SoulSuckingRetailJob.name: Soul-Sucking Retail Job
SoulSuckingRetailJob.def: Stock Parody of Walmart and other big box retailers.

SoulSuckingSuburbia.name: Soul-Sucking Suburbia
SoulSuckingSuburbia.def: Depictions of suburbia as being a birthplace of sadness, malaise, and existential despair.

SouthernGothic.name: Southern Gothic
SouthernGothic.def: Creepy, gothic Lovecraft Country in the Deep South .

SouvenirLand.name: Souvenir Land
SouvenirLand.def: A disappointing, cheap Theme Parks that tries (and fails) to ride on the coattails of A-list parks like Disneyland .

SpaceAmish.name: Space Amish
SpaceAmish.def: A space colony that gives up use of advanced technology after making the initial trip.

SpaceBrasilia.name: Space Brasília
SpaceBrasilia.def: Everything looks like identical whitewashed concrete towers with the same odd angles.

SpaceCadetAcademy.name: Space Cadet Academy
SpaceCadetAcademy.def: The Sci-Fi equivalent of a Wizarding School .

SpaceSector.name: Space Sector
SpaceSector.def: Specific regions in space are described as "the Something Sector" or "Sector Something".

StandardRoyalCourt.name: Standard Royal Court
StandardRoyalCourt.def: An explanation of the structure of a typical fictional royal court.

StarScraper.name: Star Scraper
StarScraper.def: A sky scraper taller than modern technology can build.

SteelMill.name: Steel Mill
SteelMill.def: Lots of large machinery, fiery furnaces, molten metal and heavy objects falling from heights. Often has No OSHA Compliance .

StepfordSuburbia.name: Stepford Suburbia
StepfordSuburbia.def: When the Cut-and-Paste Suburb meets the Town with a Dark Secret and everyone has a Stepford Smile .

StockStarSystems.name: Stock Star Systems
StockStarSystems.def: Star systems (such as Betelgeuse, Arcturus, or Alpha Centuari) which are well known by audiences and authors alike.

StrawmanU.name: Strawman U
StrawmanU.def: College stereotypes. You're either a hedonistic liberal la-la-land or a fascist and higher-stakes redux of all the worst, bullying cliques of High School .

StrugglingShop.name: Struggling Shop
StrugglingShop.def: A shop is failing, lacking customers and stock, and may be facing closure.

StuckAtTheAirportPlot.name: "Stuck at the Airport" Plot
StuckAtTheAirportPlot.def: The characters are Snowed-In or otherwise unable to leave a transportation hub/terminal

SubStory.name: Sub Story
SubStory.def: A story that takes place on a submarine (not a minor plot in a larger work).

SuburbanGothic.name: Suburban Gothic
SuburbanGothic.def: Something sinister is happening in the suburbs.

Suburbia.name: Suburbia
Suburbia.def: Useful notes on the sprawling residential areas surrounding larger US cities, post WWII.

SuckECheeses.name: Suck E. Cheese's
SuckECheeses.def: A Stock Parody of The '80s wave of family restaurants with arcades and animatronic puppet shows, most of which were pretty run-down by The '90s .

SuckySalonVisit.name: Sucky Salon Visit
SuckySalonVisit.def: Going to the hairdresser or barbershop makes for a miserable experience.

SuddenlySignificantCity.name: Suddenly Significant City
SuddenlySignificantCity.def: A real-world city becomes significantly more important in the story. (e.g. Chicago becomes capital of Earth.)

SuperheroSchool.name: Superhero School
SuperheroSchool.def: Where kids with superpowers go to learn to be superheroes (and maybe math and stuff).

SuperheroTrophyShelf.name: Superhero Trophy Shelf

ThinkUnsexyThoughts.def: A man tries to think nonsexual thoughts to avoid having an erection.

AThreesomeIsHot.name: A Threesome Is Hot
AThreesomeIsHot.def: A Double Standard where, in three-way polyamory, it's cool to have two women and one man, but disgusting to have two men and one woman.

TooKinkyToTorture.name: Too Kinky to Torture
TooKinkyToTorture.def: A character enjoys something intended to torture them, sometimes for sexual reasons.

TransChaser.name: Trans Chaser
TransChaser.def: A cis character has a fetish for transgender or gender-nonconforming people.

TransEqualsHypersexual.name: Trans Equals Hypersexual
TransEqualsHypersexual.def: Transgender or gender-nonconforming characters are depicted as having an Extreme Libido , no sexual boundaries, bizarre kinks , or otherwise over-the-top sexual proclivities.

TransformationExhilaration.name: Transformation Exhilaration
TransformationExhilaration.def: A transforming character finds the experience enjoyable - even sexually pleasurable.

TrojanGauntlet.name: Trojan Gauntlet
TrojanGauntlet.def: A character gets all embarrassed about having to buy condoms.

TrueLoveIsAKink.name: True Love Is a Kink
TrueLoveIsAKink.def: When "flirt with monogamy" is an euphemism.

Twincest.name: Twincest
Twincest.def: Twins that do it with each other.

TwinThreesomeFantasy.name: Twin Threesome Fantasy
TwinThreesomeFantasy.def: Someone imagines having sex with their crush and a copy of their crush at the same time.

UnexpectedlyPrudish.name: Unexpectedly Prudish
UnexpectedlyPrudish.def: A character turns out to be prudish when other aspects of their personality suggest they wouldn't be.

UnexpectedVirgin.name: Unexpected Virgin
UnexpectedVirgin.def: Someone who's revealed as a virgin and it comes as a surprise.

UnfocusedDuringIntimacy.name: Unfocused During Intimacy
UnfocusedDuringIntimacy.def: One or both sexual partners aren't really "in the moment."

UnfortunateCharacterDesign.name: Unfortunate Character Design
UnfortunateCharacterDesign.def: A character is unintentionally designed in a way that they look risque.

VampiresHarem.name: Vampire's Harem
VampiresHarem.def: A vampire is accompanied by consorts that he had turned and he is after more.

VictorySex.name: Victory Sex
VictorySex.def: Characters celebrate their victory with sex.

VigorousBull.name: Vigorous Bull
VigorousBull.def: Bulls are a symbol of fertility, masculine pride, power, and virility.

VirginityFlag.name: Virginity Flag
VirginityFlag.def: There's a way to tell (besides asking them) whether or not someone has had sex.

VirginSacrifice.name: Virgin Sacrifice
VirginSacrifice.def: A Human Sacrifice needs to be a virgin.

VirginTension.name: Virgin Tension
VirginTension.def: A woman losing her virginity is seen as tragic.

VirileStallion.name: Virile Stallion
VirileStallion.def: Horses are associated with virility, sexual prowess, and masculinity.

VisualInnuendo.name: Visual Innuendo
VisualInnuendo.def: An image that's innocent but can be seen as looking dirty.

WalkOfShame.name: Walk of Shame
WalkOfShame.def: Everyone knows what you did, just keep on walking.

YouNeedToGetLaid.name: You Need to Get Laid
YouNeedToGetLaid.def: Someone strongly suggests that someone else go have sex.

YouSexyBeast.name: You Sexy Beast
YouSexyBeast.def: Someone has sex with/a crush on/a romantic relationship with a dangerous monster.

DeathTropes.name: Death Tropes
DeathTropes.def: , an index of tropes pertaining to the phenomenon of death.

TheGrimReaper.name: The Grim Reaper
TheGrimReaper.def: , a trope for the Anthropomorphic Personification of death.

AllArtIsAutobiographical.name: All Art Is Autobiographical
AllArtIsAutobiographical.def: Art tells the "truth" even when it's supposedly fictional.

AwfulTruth.name: Awful Truth
AwfulTruth.def: Something is true, but the truth is so bad that people keep it secret out of fear that other people will go mad.

BasedOnATrueStory.name: Based on a True Story
BasedOnATrueStory.def: A work which is, or claims to be, based upon something which really happened.

BewareTheHonestOnes.name: Beware the Honest Ones
BewareTheHonestOnes.def: Shifty characters distrust an honest one.

BluffWorkedTooWell.name: Bluff Worked Too Well
BluffWorkedTooWell.def: A character's lie works too well, causing unintended consequences.

BluntNo.name: Blunt "No"
BluntNo.def: Someone says "no" in a blunt tone as a response to a inquiry.

BluntYes.name: Blunt "Yes"
BluntYes.def: Someone says, "yes" in a blunt tone as a response to a yes-or-no question.

BrutalHonesty.name: Brutal Honesty
BrutalHonesty.def: You'd expect a character to lie, but they just tell the truth.

CardCarryingJerkass.name: Card-Carrying Jerkass
CardCarryingJerkass.def: A character will not lie about being a jerk.

CannotTellALie.name: Cannot Tell a Lie
CannotTellALie.def: Someone is literally unable to lie.

CassandraBystander.name: Cassandra Bystander
CassandraBystander.def: Someone confesses a truth, but relies on Refuge in Audacity so it won't be believed.

CassandraTruth.name: Cassandra Truth
CassandraTruth.def: Someone tells the truth, but nobody believes them.

ContagiousCassandraTruth.name: Contagious Cassandra Truth
ContagiousCassandraTruth.def: Somebody cannot get anybody to believe something they know is true, but they manage to convince one, but nobody else.

DeceptionNoncompliance.name: Deception Non-Compliance
DeceptionNoncompliance.def: Somebody has to deceive, but they deliberately mess it up.

DidItOnPurposeAccusation.name: "Did It on Purpose" Accusation
DidItOnPurposeAccusation.def: A person accidentally harms another person, who accuses them of doing it deliberately and won't let it go for reasons unrelated to them.

ADogAteMyHomework.name: A Dog Ate My Homework
ADogAteMyHomework.def: A student doesn't bring their homework and claims that a dog ate it, which is either a lie or a Cassandra Truth.

DreamingTheTruth.name: Dreaming the Truth
DreamingTheTruth.def: Somebody has a dream that makes them realise the truth.

EmbarrassingAlibi.name: Embarrassing Alibi
EmbarrassingAlibi.def: Humiliating yourself or Confess to a Lesser Crime to establish your alibi.

EyeContactAsProof.name: Eye Contact as Proof
EyeContactAsProof.def: Having someone look you in the eyes while making a claim is the best way to verify the claim.

FacadeDrop.name: Façade Drop
FacadeDrop.def: A character lets go of their mask to show who they really are.

FalseFlirtingStratagem.name: False Flirting Stratagem
FalseFlirtingStratagem.def: A character flirts with someone with whom they have no romantic interest to get something from them.

FalseReassurance.name: False Reassurance
FalseReassurance.def: Someone tells the absolute truth, but makes it seem like they mean something else.

FoodInterrogation.name: Food Interrogation
FoodInterrogation.def: Food is used as a way to get the truth in an interrogation.

GreatAccomplishmentWeakCredibility.name: Great Accomplishment, Weak Credibility
GreatAccomplishmentWeakCredibility.def: Someone does something amazing, but there's one person who doesn't believe them.

HelpfulHallucination.name: Helpful Hallucination
HelpfulHallucination.def: A hallucinated person tells the truth and helps an actual character.

HeroicVow.name: Heroic Vow
HeroicVow.def: A hero makes a promise they will not break .

HonestAxe.name: Honest Axe
HonestAxe.def: Telling the truth earns a reward.

HonestyAesop.name: Honesty Aesop
HonestyAesop.def: An Aesop about telling the truth.

HonestyIsTheBestPolicy.name: Honesty Is the Best Policy
HonestyIsTheBestPolicy.def: Somebody tells the truth, because they feel they do not need to lie.

IGaveMyWord.name: I Gave My Word
IGaveMyWord.def: Dialogue which basically means "I promised to do or not do something, you can't make me do otherwise", which often turns out to be irrational.

ItWasHereISwear.name: It Was Here, I Swear!
ItWasHereISwear.def: Someone finds something, goes to show somebody else, but by the time they come to see, it's gone.

LieDetector.name: Lie Detector
LieDetector.def: Something which can tell whether or not somebody is lying.

LiteralMetaphor.name: Literal Metaphor
LiteralMetaphor.def: The simple truth, mistaken for a metaphor. Often a part of the Prophecy Twist .

LyingHeroesHonestVillains.name: Lying Heroes, Honest Villains
LyingHeroesHonestVillains.def: A good guy lies, while a villain tells the truth.

LyingLieDetector.name: Lying Lie Detector
LyingLieDetector.def: It takes a liar to know a liar.

MistakenForBluff.name: Mistaken for Bluff
MistakenForBluff.def: When a character mistakes someone else's threat as mere bluffing.

MistakenForChildishFantasy.name: Mistaken for Childish Fantasy
MistakenForChildishFantasy.def: A kid mentions something crazy that happened, and they're telling the truth but people mistake it for a made-up game or story.

MistakenForHallucination.name: Mistaken for Hallucination
MistakenForHallucination.def: A character sees something unusual and mistakes it for a hallucination.

NoManOfWomanBorn.name: No Man of Woman Born
NoManOfWomanBorn.def: Some sort of prophecy or something says that something cannot happen until something else, which sounds impossible but somehow isn't, does.

NoMoreLies.name: No More Lies
NoMoreLies.def: A lie that was useful no longer is.

NoPokerFace.name: No Poker Face
NoPokerFace.def: A character can not hide their emotions, including when they're bluffing.

NotEvenBotheringWithAnExcuse.name: Not Even Bothering with an Excuse
NotEvenBotheringWithAnExcuse.def: Somebody doesn't want to help a character but doesn't make an excuse.

NotMakingThisUpDisclaimer.name: "Not Making This Up" Disclaimer
NotMakingThisUpDisclaimer.def: Immediately after the work gives information that sounds like made-up nonsense, the characters or the creator say something to the effect of "We didn't make that detail up, it's actually accurate".

ProphecyTwist.name: Prophecy Twist
ProphecyTwist.def: A prophecy comes true, but not in the expected way.

RecordedSplicedConversation.name: Recorded Spliced Conversation
RecordedSplicedConversation.def: Trying to pretend that a recording of another person is the actual person speaking.

SoCrazyItMustBeTrue.name: So Crazy, It Must Be True
SoCrazyItMustBeTrue.def: Believing a true, but really weird-sounding, story.

SupernaturallyValidatedTransPerson.name: Supernaturally Validated Trans Person
SupernaturallyValidatedTransPerson.def: Supernatural happenings confirm that a transgender person is the gender they identify with, beyond all reasonable doubt.

ThrowingOutTheScript.name: Throwing Out the Script
ThrowingOutTheScript.def: Casting aside your pre-prepared speech to say what you're really thinking.

TruthInTelevision.name: Truth in Television
TruthInTelevision.def: A trope which happens in real life.

TruthSerums.name: Truth Serums
TruthSerums.def: A drug which makes the taker be honest.

TruthTellingSession.name: Truth-Telling Session
TruthTellingSession.def: Many truths being confessed during a crowd argument.

VillainsNeverLie.name: Villains Never Lie
VillainsNeverLie.def: A villain tells the truth in a manipulative way.

VillainRevealsTheSecret.name: Villain Reveals the Secret
VillainRevealsTheSecret.def: Sometimes, they're telling the truth and it usually isn't good for our heroes.

WillNotTellALie.name: Will Not Tell a Lie
WillNotTellALie.def: Someone who technically can lie, but chooses not to.

TwoPlusTortureMakesFive.name: 2 + Torture = 5
TwoPlusTortureMakesFive.def: The villain tortures the hero by trying to make them believe something that's obviously not true.

BathroomSearchExcuse.name: Bathroom Search Excuse
BathroomSearchExcuse.def: Lying about looking for the bathroom.

BluffingTheAdvanceScout.name: Bluffing the Advance Scout
BluffingTheAdvanceScout.def: Aliens want to do something bad to Earth, but the humans trick the aliens' advance scouts into thinking all humans are too nasty to deal with.

BluffingTheAuthorities.name: Bluffing the Authorities
BluffingTheAuthorities.def: An authority figure thinks someone did something suspicious, but the suspected character comes up with an innocent explanation.

BluffTheEavesdropper.name: Bluff the Eavesdropper
BluffTheEavesdropper.def: Somebody discovers they are being watched and starts acting to trick the watcher.

BluffTheImpostor.name: Bluff the Impostor
BluffTheImpostor.def: Tricking an impostor into exposing themselves by making an obvious mistake.

BluffingTheMurderer.name: Bluffing the Murderer
BluffingTheMurderer.def: Somebody is pretty sure who dunnit, but doesn't know for sure so tries to trick the suspect into confessing.

BookedFullOfMooks.name: Booked Full of Mooks
BookedFullOfMooks.def: A character in a public space discovers that all the bystanders around them are actually another character's employees or co-conspirators.

BreakThemWithLies.name: Break Them With Lies
BreakThemWithLies.def: A person lies in order to break someone's spirit.

CassandraGambit.name: Cassandra Gambit
CassandraGambit.def: Invoking a Cassandra Truth to hide something.

ConfessToALesserCrime.name: Confess to a Lesser Crime
ConfessToALesserCrime.def: When the authorities come asking, the perpetrator will happily confess to being guilty of a minor indiscretion, in order to keep the more serious crime(s) from being brought up.

ConfusingMultipleNegatives.name: Confusing Multiple Negatives
ConfusingMultipleNegatives.def: Multiple negatives deliberately used to throw the listener off-track.

ConfrontingYourImposter.name: Confronting Your Imposter
ConfrontingYourImposter.def: An impersonator is exposed by the person they're impersonating.

TheCoronerDothProtestTooMuch.name: The Coroner Doth Protest Too Much
TheCoronerDothProtestTooMuch.def: When someone in authority claims a suspicious death is due to an accident, suicide, or natural causes.

CoverIdentityAnomaly.name: Cover Identity Anomaly
CoverIdentityAnomaly.def: Missing some basic piece of information about someone you're pretending to be, often forcing you to make up something on the spot.

CrocodileTears.name: Crocodile Tears
CrocodileTears.def: Pretending to cry to gain other people's sympathy.

DecoyBackstory.name: Decoy Backstory
DecoyBackstory.def: The backstory we were initially given for a character turns out to be untrue.

DeliberatelyCuteChild.name: Deliberately Cute Child
DeliberatelyCuteChild.def: Using a cute façade to get what one wants.

DestinationRuse.name: Destination Ruse
DestinationRuse.def: A character lies to a subordinate (usually a parent to a child) about where they are going.

DidNotDieThatWay.name: Did Not Die That Way
DidNotDieThatWay.def: A character finds out they have been lied to about a loved one's death.

DrPsychPatient.name: Dr. Psych Patient
DrPsychPatient.def: An apparent authority figure such as a doctor is exposed as a mentally-unwell person adopting the role.

EmbarrassingCoverUp.name: Embarrassing Cover-Up
EmbarrassingCoverUp.def: Where the cover story goes into territory that makes the questioner regret asking.

EnabledDelusion.name: Enabled Delusion
EnabledDelusion.def: A character's delusions or wrong beliefs are enabled or encouraged by other people.

ExactWords.name: Exact Words
ExactWords.def: Everything the speaker says is true — but you must pay careful attention to exactly what they are saying to avoid misleading implications.

FabricatedEvidence.name: Fabricated Evidence
FabricatedEvidence.def: Fake evidence that's meant to mislead.

FacadeOfStrength.name: Façade of Strength
FacadeOfStrength.def: Characters act tough to hide their insecurities and weaknesses.

FakeAlibi.name: Fake Alibi
FakeAlibi.def: A suspect claims to have an alibi , witnesses confirm, yet the suspect is actually guilty.

FakeAssistedSuicide.name: Fake Assisted Suicide
FakeAssistedSuicide.def: A character pretends to be helping another character commit suicide.

FakeLieBeliever.name: Fake Lie Believer
FakeLieBeliever.def: A character pretends to believe that they are fooled by someone's lies.

FakePregnancy.name: Fake Pregnancy
FakePregnancy.def: A character pretends to be pregnant.

FakeRelationship.name: Fake Relationship
FakeRelationship.def: Two characters pretend to be in a romantic relationship.

FakeTexting.name: Fake Texting
FakeTexting.def: Someone pretends to be texting or checking social media on their phone.

FakedGiftAcceptance.name: Faked Gift Acceptance
FakedGiftAcceptance.def: Pretending to accept a gift but then destroying it or throwing it away when no one's watching.

FalseAbuseAccusation.name: False Abuse Accusation
FalseAbuseAccusation.def: A character falsely accuses someone else of abuse.

FalseCause.name: False Cause
FalseCause.def: Correlation does not imply causation, but here that is ignored.

FauxAffablyEvil.name: Faux Affably Evil
FauxAffablyEvil.def: A villain pretends to be polite to others to throw them off.

FauxFinalLine.name: Faux Final Line
FauxFinalLine.def: To give an illusion of normalcy, a character pretends that they have been talking to another character.

FeigningIntelligence.name: Feigning Intelligence
FeigningIntelligence.def: A character tries to appear more intelligent than they really are.

FictionAsCoverup.name: Fiction as Cover-Up
FictionAsCoverup.def: Hiding the truth in plain sight by calling it fictional.

FlyingUnderTheGaydar.name: Flying Under the Gaydar
FlyingUnderTheGaydar.def: A queer character pretending to be cisgender or straight because they don't want others finding out.

ForgedMessage.name: Forged Message
ForgedMessage.def: Writing a message but making it look like someone else wrote it.

Gaslighting.name: Gaslighting
Gaslighting.def: Using deceit to intentionally convince someone that they are insane.

GasLeakCoverup.name: Gas Leak Cover-Up
GasLeakCoverup.def: A simple, dull, believable excuse for something that is none of those.

GideonPloy.name: Gideon Ploy
GideonPloy.def: Tricking your enemies into believing you have more people on your side than you do

GirlfriendInCanada.name: Girlfriend in Canada
GirlfriendInCanada.def: Pretending to be in a long-distance relationship. Has a chance to be a real long-distance relationship despite others accusing otherwise.

IdentityImpersonator.name: Identity Impersonator
IdentityImpersonator.def: A ruse to protect a character's Secret Identity by showing both character's identities in the same place together at the same time.

INeverSaidItWasPoison.name: I Never Said It Was Poison
INeverSaidItWasPoison.def: Tricking a suspect into revealing something only the perpetrator would know.

InfractionDistraction.name: Infraction Distraction
InfractionDistraction.def: When someone confesses to or commits a small crime in order to cover for a bigger one.

IntentionalHeartbreaker.name: Intentional Heartbreaker
IntentionalHeartbreaker.def: A character pretends to love someone, only to dump them later.

InsidiousRumorMill.name: Insidious Rumor Mill
InsidiousRumorMill.def: A character lies or manipulates the friends, family members, and colleagues they share with someone they're in conflict with to turn their backs on that person.

ISurrenderSuckers.name: I Surrender, Suckers!
ISurrenderSuckers.def: A character pretends to surrender but attacks once the opponent lowers his guard. If this is done by a soldier, it is called "Perfidy" and is a war crime .

JustSmileAndNod.name: Just Smile and Nod
JustSmileAndNod.def: A character acts like they want to listen to someone they don't want to talk to by smiling and nodding as the other character speaks.

LanguageFluencyDenial.name: Language Fluency Denial
LanguageFluencyDenial.def: Pretending not to speak a language fluently when one in fact can.

LiarsParadox.name: Liar's Paradox
LiarsParadox.def: A stock technique where a paradox is formed from statements where truth and lie simultaneously occur.

ManipulativeEditing.name: Manipulative Editing
ManipulativeEditing.def: Editing a video out of context to make it look like something else.

MetaphoricallyTrue.name: Metaphorically True
MetaphoricallyTrue.def: A statement that is technically true, but extremely misleading without all the facts.

MinionManipulatedIntoVillainy.name: Minion Manipulated into Villainy
MinionManipulatedIntoVillainy.def: The loyal minion learns that their helpful dark master who was there for them after their life fell apart was actually the one who engineered the tragedy.

MinorWithFakeID.name: Minor with Fake I.D.
MinorWithFakeID.def: An underage character uses a forged identity document to buy alcohol or something they're otherwise too young to access.

MistakenForFakedDisability.name: Mistaken for Faked Disability
MistakenForFakedDisability.def: When a character wrongly assumes someone is faking their disability .

MostDefinitelyNotAWar.name: Most Definitely Not a War
MostDefinitelyNotAWar.def: Calling a war something other than a war so that people will be OK with it.

MoveAlongNothingToSeeHere.name: Move Along, Nothing to See Here
MoveAlongNothingToSeeHere.def: A Stock Phrase for authority figures wanting to prevent people from seeing something.

MultipleIdentityIDs.name: Multiple Identity IDs
MultipleIdentityIDs.def: When someone has several fake IDs for several fake identities.

NewEraSpeech.name: New Era Speech
NewEraSpeech.def: A villain who wants to take over gives a speech that is true, but is ambiguous enough to sound like they want to do something good when really they want to do something bad.

NotSoInnocentWhistle.name: Not-So-Innocent Whistle
NotSoInnocentWhistle.def: A guilty character whistles in an attempt to look innocent.

ObfuscatingDisability.name: Obfuscating Disability
ObfuscatingDisability.def: Faking a disability to mislead onlookers or throw off suspicion.

ObfuscatingInsanity.name: Obfuscating Insanity
ObfuscatingInsanity.def: Likewise a character could fake insanity...

OfCorpseHesAlive.name: Of Corpse He's Alive
OfCorpseHesAlive.def: Pretending a corpse is a living person.

PhoneyCall.name: Phoney Call
PhoneyCall.def: Pretending to make or accept a phone call.

PhoningThePhantom.name: Phoning the Phantom
PhoningThePhantom.def: Pretending to be on a phone call so people don't think you're crazy when you talk to the mysterious person only you can hear.

PlayingSick.name: Playing Sick
PlayingSick.def: Pretending to be ill to avoid responsibilities or consequences.

PretendPrejudice.name: Pretend Prejudice
PretendPrejudice.def: A character pretending to be prejudiced against certain groups despite lacking said prejudices.

PropagandaHero.name: Propaganda Hero
PropagandaHero.def: A hero is either embellished or made up out of whole cloth for propaganda purposes.

PropagandaMachine.name: Propaganda Machine
PropagandaMachine.def: A program or agency that exists to promulgate an official (and often misleading) version of the truth.

PropagandaPiece.name: Propaganda Piece
PropagandaPiece.def: Publications geared to influence the public first and foremost, with journalistic integrity as an afterthought or completely absent.

ReactionSeekingFeint.name: Reaction-Seeking Feint
ReactionSeekingFeint.def: Character fakes an attack on another to make a point out of their reaction (or lack thereof).

RealStitchesForFakeSnitches.name: Real Stitches for Fake Snitches
RealStitchesForFakeSnitches.def: Deceptively making it look like a criminal has tattled on their employer or associates, especially when they could be hurt or killed for doing so.

ReversePsycho.name: Reverse Psycho
ReversePsycho.def: An ad begs you to buy the product by telling you not to.

ReversePsychology.name: Reverse Psychology
ReversePsychology.def: Getting someone to do something by telling them to do the opposite.

SarcasticConfession.name: Sarcastic Confession
SarcasticConfession.def: Telling the truth in a way that comes off as a lie. Often used to support the masquerade , this both deflects attention from the truth now and makes one less willing to accept the truth later.

ScoobyDooHoax.name: "Scooby-Doo" Hoax
ScoobyDooHoax.def: Using supernatural myths and Urban Legends to scare someone for whatever reason.

SeamlessSpontaneousLie.name: Seamless Spontaneous Lie
SeamlessSpontaneousLie.def: A quick, incredibly detailed, and not easily disproved lie.

SelectiveStupidity.name: Selective Stupidity
SelectiveStupidity.def: Cherry-picking a survey's responses to make a certain demographic look stupid.

SelfServingApology.name: Self-Serving Apology
SelfServingApology.def: Apologizing out of convenience rather than remorse.

ShamWedding.name: Sham Wedding
ShamWedding.def: A fake wedding that's not legally valid.

SickCaptiveScam.name: Sick Captive Scam
SickCaptiveScam.def: A captive fakes illness or injury to get the drop on his captor.

SocialEngineering.name: Social Engineering
SocialEngineering.def: Convincing someone that you're someone else, or convincing someone to do something they don't want to do.

SlumberPartyPloy.name: Slumber Party Ploy
SlumberPartyPloy.def: In order to do something or go somewhere they were prohibited from, kids lie to their parents that they are staying over at each other's houses.

StagingTheEavesdrop.name: Staging the Eavesdrop
StagingTheEavesdrop.def: Intentionally saying something loudly with the explicit intent of getting someone to eavesdrop on it.

StandInParents.name: Stand-In Parents
StandInParents.def: A child or teenager has someone else pretend to be their parents for an important event

SureLetsGoWithThat.name: Sure, Let's Go with That
SureLetsGoWithThat.def: Alice confronts Bob, who is obviously hiding something, and she concludes something wildly different than the secret Bob is actually sitting on, but Bob confesses to Alice's accusation only because he's covering up something darker or just embarrassing.

TrojanCellmatePloy.name: Trojan Cellmate Ploy
TrojanCellmatePloy.def: Getting information from a prisoner by giving them a cellmate who is in fact an agent.

TrojanVeggies.name: Trojan Veggies
TrojanVeggies.def: Tricking a child into eating vegetables by hiding them in a different food.

UnusuallyUninterestingName.name: Unusually Uninteresting Name
UnusuallyUninterestingName.def: This innocent-sounding group are not a secret organisation of any sort. You won't even question their involvement or even notice their existence. The name is likely to be technically correct, though.

WickedPretentious.name: Wicked Pretentious
WickedPretentious.def: An evil character puts on a facade of being intelligent and cultured, but deep down, they're really crude and uncivilized.

WontGetFooledAgain.name: Won't Get Fooled Again
WontGetFooledAgain.def: In which the deception only works once.

WoundedGazelleGambit.name: Wounded Gazelle Gambit
WoundedGazelleGambit.def: A guilty person acts innocent and manages to fool everyone.

YouDidntAsk.name: You Didn't Ask
YouDidntAsk.def: When a character simply doesn't tell/mention something that's particularly large, hard to avoid in conversation, or just really should have been mentioned.

YouSaidYouWouldLetThemGo.name: You Said You Would Let Them Go
YouSaidYouWouldLetThemGo.def: A villain lies to someone to get them to go along with a plan that will ultimately hurt those that they care about, or otherwise makes a promise that he has no intention of keeping. Often involves use of loopholes.

AccidentalTruth.name: Accidental Truth
AccidentalTruth.def: Someone intends to lie, but their "lie" was actually true.

AccidentallyRealFakeAddress.name: Accidentally-Real Fake Address
AccidentallyRealFakeAddress.def: Someone makes up a false address (or similar) that happens to be a real one.

AcquaintanceDenial.name: Acquaintance Denial
AcquaintanceDenial.def: A character pretends they don't know someone to avoid judgment or embarrassment.

ActingUnnatural.name: Acting Unnatural
ActingUnnatural.def: People try to act innocent, but fail intensely.

AffairPartnerDenial.name: Affair Partner Denial
AffairPartnerDenial.def: An adulterer claims their affair partner is someone other than an affair partner.

AmalgamatedIndividual.name: Amalgamated Individual
AmalgamatedIndividual.def: Multiple individual actions are thought to be committed by a single person.

AmnesiacLiar.name: Amnesiac Liar
AmnesiacLiar.def: Somebody lies, gets amnesia, and then is told their lies because the person they lied to thinks they're true, and now the liar does too.

AnachronisticClue.name: Anachronistic Clue
AnachronisticClue.def: An item that cannot come from the time period it supposedly came from, which is a clue.

BackupBluff.name: Backup Bluff
BackupBluff.def: A character uses a lie as a last resort for when their plans fail.

BadActorGoodLiar.name: Bad Actor, Good Liar
BadActorGoodLiar.def: A character makes for a very good liar or con artist despite being terrible at professional acting.

BasedOnAGreatBigLie.name: Based on a Great Big Lie
BasedOnAGreatBigLie.def: A work says that it's Based on a True Story , but it actually isn't.

BecomingTheBoast.name: Becoming the Boast
BecomingTheBoast.def: Someone lies that they possess a skill, then is forced to actually gain that skill.

BelievingTheirOwnLies.name: Believing Their Own Lies
BelievingTheirOwnLies.def: Somebody tells something that isn't true but they believe it.

BetterToLookEvilThanALoser.name: Better to Look Evil than a Loser
BetterToLookEvilThanALoser.def: Someone lies about doing something bad because they'd rather be seen as evil than foolish or incompetent.

BlatantLies.name: Blatant Lies
BlatantLies.def: A lie that's obviously a lie , even if you don't know the details.

CelebrityLie.name: Celebrity Lie
CelebrityLie.def: A character claims to be friends with a celebrity. Hilarity Ensues .

CompulsiveLiar.name: Compulsive Liar
CompulsiveLiar.def: Someone feels a need to lie even when it's not the most reasonable thing to do.

ConfessionDeferred.name: Confession Deferred
ConfessionDeferred.def: Lying until either threatened or assured no harm would come from telling the truth.

ContrivedClumsiness.name: Contrived Clumsiness
ContrivedClumsiness.def: Somebody does something mean and pretends it was an accident.

CryingWolf.name: Crying Wolf
CryingWolf.def: Lying so often that nobody believes you when you actually tell the truth.

CutHimselfShaving.name: Cut Himself Shaving
CutHimselfShaving.def: Making up a lame excuse for injuries received from your secret life.

DarkSecret.name: Dark Secret
DarkSecret.def: Someone has a negative secret, which almost always leads to lying.

DeceptiveLegacy.name: Deceptive Legacy
DeceptiveLegacy.def: A child is lied to about their missing parent(s).

DeliberatelyAcceptingTheLie.name: Deliberately Accepting the Lie
DeliberatelyAcceptingTheLie.def: People decide to accept lies as the truth, sometimes for the greater good.

DogGotSentToAFarm.name: Dog Got Sent to a Farm
DogGotSentToAFarm.def: Telling a child someone has gone somewhere else when they've really died.

DreamDeception.name: Dream Deception
DreamDeception.def: A character lies to another that they're dreaming.

EmptyPromise.name: Empty Promise
EmptyPromise.def: Someone makes a promise they cannot keep/don't believe.

EngineeredHeroics.name: Engineered Heroics
EngineeredHeroics.def: A character fakes being a hero.

EverybodyKnewAlready.name: Everybody Knew Already
EverybodyKnewAlready.def: Something you think is a secret, but really isn't.

ExerciseExcuse.name: Exercise Excuse
ExerciseExcuse.def: A character lies about their strange behaviour by claiming they were exercising or dancing.

EyesNeverLie.name: Eyes Never Lie
EyesNeverLie.def: Looking in somebody's eyes is a surefire way of telling whether or not they're lying.

FabricatedBlackmail.name: Fabricated Blackmail
FabricatedBlackmail.def: Blackmailing someone by threatening to spread lies about them.

FakeStatic.name: Fake Static
FakeStatic.def: A character makes noises over the phone and pretends that it's a bad connection.

FakeWizardry.name: Fake Wizardry
FakeWizardry.def: Magic is real...but you're not actually using it.

FakingAmnesia.name: Faking Amnesia
FakingAmnesia.def: Just what it sounds like, a character pretends they have amnesia.

FakingTheWeather.name: Faking the Weather
FakingTheWeather.def: Character uses special effects to fool someone into believing fake weather conditions.

FalseWidow.name: False Widow
FalseWidow.def: A woman who claims she has a dead husband when really she doesn't.

FawltyTowersPlot.name: "Fawlty Towers" Plot
FawltyTowersPlot.def: Someone tells a lie, then other lies must be told to convince people the lie is true, but then it's revealed as false as it becomes too ridiculous.

FriendshipDenial.name: Friendship Denial
FriendshipDenial.def: Somebody denies they're another character's friend, when they clearly are.

FrustratingLie.name: Frustrating Lie
FrustratingLie.def: A character reacts with frustration when they either hear a lie instead of the truth, a really bad lie, or a lie that complicates their situation.

Glamour.name: Glamour
Glamour.def: The Fair Folk pretend to be an old friend of the hero/es.

GodNeverSaidThat.name: God Never Said That
GodNeverSaidThat.def: Lying about what the writers said about the work.

HandBehindHead.name: Hand Behind Head
HandBehindHead.def: A character puts their hand behind their head, sometimes as a tell that they're lying.

HesitationEqualsDishonesty.name: Hesitation Equals Dishonesty
HesitationEqualsDishonesty.def: If someone hesitates, they must be lying.

HowDidYouGetIt.name: How Did You Get It?
HowDidYouGetIt.def: A character lies about how they got a valuable or contraband item.

IAmOneOfThoseToo.name: I Am One of Those, Too
IAmOneOfThoseToo.def: When you are caught in a lie by someone who just happens to have that ability / nationality for real.

IHaveABoyfriendExcuse.name: "I Have a Boyfriend" Excuse
IHaveABoyfriendExcuse.def: Saying you already have a partner to get someone to leave you alone.

ILied.name: I Lied
ILied.def: A character outright admits to having previously lied.

ImpersonatingAGangster.name: Impersonating a Gangster
ImpersonatingAGangster.def: A person lies about being a gangster in order to intimidate others.

ImplausibleDeniability.name: Implausible Deniability
ImplausibleDeniability.def: Denying something when evidence to the contrary is right in front of the denier.

InflationaryDialogue.name: Inflationary Dialogue
InflationaryDialogue.def: A lie involving a number, that changes every time the lie is told.

InstantlyProvenWrong.name: Instantly Proven Wrong
InstantlyProvenWrong.def: When your lie offends the universe so badly that it exposes you on the spot.

InternalRetcon.name: Internal Retcon
InternalRetcon.def: Pretending something happened a different way from reality, because the truth would be dangerous.

InternalReveal.name: Internal Reveal
InternalReveal.def: The characters find something out that the audience already knew.

InventedIndividual.name: Invented Individual
InventedIndividual.def: Somebody makes someone up and eventually has to give up the made-up person by "killing" them or in some other way.

InventedInvalid.name: Invented Invalid
InventedInvalid.def: Someone lies about visiting a sick relative as an excuse to escape their duties.

InventionPretension.name: Invention Pretension
InventionPretension.def: Someone pretends they invented something which has already been invented.

ItsForABook.name: It's for a Book
ItsForABook.def: Claiming that a dodgy question is asked because you are writing a book, which is usually a lie.

IWasNeverHere.name: I Was Never Here
IWasNeverHere.def: A character claims they never came.

KeepingSecretsSucks.name: Keeping Secrets Sucks
KeepingSecretsSucks.def: Because it involves lying a whole lot.

LameRhymeDodge.name: Lame Rhyme Dodge
LameRhymeDodge.def: A character denies saying a phrase or insult, instead claiming they said something else that sounds like what they really said .

LanguageOfTruth.name: Language of Truth
LanguageOfTruth.def: A language that cannot be lied in.

LazinessExcuse.name: Laziness Excuse
LazinessExcuse.def: A lazy person makes excuses for it.

LetThemDieHappy.name: Let Them Die Happy
LetThemDieHappy.def: Lying that a dying character will be OK in order to let them be happy before they die.

LiarRevealed.name: Liar Revealed
LiarRevealed.def: The protagonists learn that somebody else has been lying.

LiesToChildren.name: Lies to Children
LiesToChildren.def: An analogy told to a kid is essentially a lie because they take it too literally.

LiteralMoneyMetaphor.name: Literal Money Metaphor
LiteralMoneyMetaphor.def: A person thinks they were promised money, when really it was something else.

LivingLie.name: Living Lie
LivingLie.def: A person or thing someone lied about or told a story about comes to life.

LuridTalesOfDoom.name: Lurid Tales of Doom
LuridTalesOfDoom.def: A newspaper or magazine story of, at the best, extremely questionable truth, or at the worst, total fabrication.

LyingByOmission.name: Lying by Omission
LyingByOmission.def: Deliberately leaving out part(s) of a true statement in order to deceive somebody.

LyingCreator.name: Lying Creator
LyingCreator.def: Something a creator says about a work turns out not to be true.

LyingFingerCross.name: Lying Finger Cross
LyingFingerCross.def: Someone crosses their fingers while making a promise they don't plan on keeping.

LyingToProtectYourFeelings.name: Lying to Protect Your Feelings
LyingToProtectYourFeelings.def: Lying to avoid making the person being lied to sad/angry.

LyingToThePerp.name: Lying to the Perp
LyingToThePerp.def: A detective lies to a suspected perpetrator in order to get them to make a mistake.

MaintainTheLie.name: Maintain the Lie
MaintainTheLie.def: Someone lies about their life and their friends have to help them carry it on.

MemoryGambit.name: Memory Gambit
MemoryGambit.def: Making yourself believe your lies just to regain memory after everyone else starts believing them.

MotivationalLie.name: Motivational Lie
MotivationalLie.def: Somebody tells a lie to motivate another person.

MunchausenSyndrome.name: Münchausen Syndrome
MunchausenSyndrome.def: Faking illness for attention as part of a psychological condition.

NarrativeBackpedaling.name: Narrative Backpedaling
NarrativeBackpedaling.def: The narrative tells a story, then admits it didn't happen.

NeverTrustATitle.name: Never Trust a Title
NeverTrustATitle.def: Misleading and lying title that has nothing to do with the work's plot.

NoTrueScotsman.name: No True Scotsman
NoTrueScotsman.def: Saying that if somebody is an X, they can't have been/done Y.

TheOldestTricksInTheBook.name: The Oldest Tricks in the Book

ObstructiveVigilantism.name: Obstructive Vigilantism
ObstructiveVigilantism.def: Lying to the cops for the greater good. Or not.

ObviouslyFakeSignature.name: Obviously Fake Signature
ObviouslyFakeSignature.def: A blatant forgery of a signature.

ObviouslyNotFine.name: Obviously Not Fine
ObviouslyNotFine.def: A character claims to be fine when anyone can see that they're not.

OpenSecret.name: Open Secret
OpenSecret.def: When everyone acts like something is supposed to be a secret, but everybody knows about it anyway.

ParentalDenial.name: Parental Denial
ParentalDenial.def: Character denies being a child's parent, usually because the child is biologically theirs and they want to lie about it.

PhonyRelative.name: Phony Relative
PhonyRelative.def: A character lies about who their family is.

PhonyRules.name: Phony Rules
PhonyRules.def: A character lies about what the rules are in order to trick somebody.

PhotosLie.name: Photos Lie
PhotosLie.def: A photo doesn't show what happened before or after it was taken, leading to some lies.

PinocchioNose.name: Pinocchio Nose
PinocchioNose.def: Someone always does one particular thing when they lie.

PlagiarismInFiction.name: Plagiarism in Fiction
PlagiarismInFiction.def: Taking someone else's work and saying it's yours.

PlayingUpTheStereotype.name: Playing Up the Stereotype
PlayingUpTheStereotype.def: Pretending to have stereotypical qualities of your group.

PosingAsYourOwnVictim.name: Posing as Your Own Victim
PosingAsYourOwnVictim.def: Pretending to be the victim of a mysterious evil when you are the mysterious evil

ThePowerOfLegacy.name: The Power of Legacy
ThePowerOfLegacy.def: Lying about what somebody's last words were.

QuoteMine.name: Quote Mine
QuoteMine.def: Lying that somebody said something they didn't by taking bits of what they did say out of context.

RecruitersAlwaysLie.name: Recruiters Always Lie
RecruitersAlwaysLie.def: The recruiter lies to the recruit.

RedHerringSecret.name: Red Herring Secret
RedHerringSecret.def: Someone lies during an investigation to hide a secret unrelated to the matter at hand.

RedundantRomanceAttempt.name: Redundant Romance Attempt
RedundantRomanceAttempt.def: Acting out of character to impress a love interest who likes your true personality.

RelativelyFlimsyExcuse.name: Relative-ly Flimsy Excuse
RelativelyFlimsyExcuse.def: Lying that someone is your relative as an excuse to keep them around.

RetconningTheWiki.name: Retconning the Wiki
RetconningTheWiki.def: Editing a wiki to make someone (often yourself) look better or worse.

SandInMyEyes.name: Sand in My Eyes
SandInMyEyes.def: A character lies about the reason they are crying.

SelfMadeLie.name: Self-Made Lie
SelfMadeLie.def: The Self-Made Man or Woman's accomplishments are not really due to their own hard work as others have been led to believe.

TheShadowKnows.name: The Shadow Knows
TheShadowKnows.def: An invisible character casts a shadow, or a shapeshifter's shadow looks like their true form.

ShamSupernatural.name: Sham Supernatural
ShamSupernatural.def: Someone pretends to be a supernatural creature that they aren't.

SnowballLie.name: Snowball Lie
SnowballLie.def: A lie that spirals out of control, and other characters join in.

StereoFibbing.name: Stereo Fibbing
StereoFibbing.def: More than one character lies at once, about the same thing but often different lies.

SuccessThroughCheatingAccusation.name: "Success Through Cheating" Accusation
SuccessThroughCheatingAccusation.def: A character is falsely accused of having cheated to achieve a victory.

SuspiciouslySpecificDenial.name: Suspiciously Specific Denial
SuspiciouslySpecificDenial.def: Somebody denies doing something very specific .

TrickedToDeath.name: Tricked to Death
TrickedToDeath.def: A lie that results in death.

TwistingTheWords.name: Twisting the Words
TwistingTheWords.def: Turning an innocuous statement into something that sounds more incriminating.

TwoFacedAside.name: Two-Faced Aside
TwoFacedAside.def: A character lies, then whispers or mouths the truth.

UnreliableVoiceover.name: Unreliable Voiceover
UnreliableVoiceover.def: A Flash Back shows the truth, but the voiceover is lying.

UrbanLegendLoveLife.name: Urban Legend Love Life
UrbanLegendLoveLife.def: Someone's reputation as The Casanova or someone who Really Gets Around is actually made up.

VaguenessEqualsDishonesty.name: Vagueness Equals Dishonesty
VaguenessEqualsDishonesty.def: If someone is being vague, it means they are lying.

VeryFakeResume.name: Very Fake Résumé
VeryFakeResume.def: A resume has some very blatant untruths in it.

WeDoNotKnowEachOther.name: We Do Not Know Each Other
WeDoNotKnowEachOther.def: Two or more characters pretend to be strangers.

WeWereRehearsingAPlay.name: We Were Rehearsing a Play
WeWereRehearsingAPlay.def: One or more characters pretend they were acting.

WeWillNotUsePhotoshopInTheFuture.name: We Will Not Use Photoshop in the Future
WeWillNotUsePhotoshopInTheFuture.def: False photography or video. Tends to be mistaken as real in fiction.

WroteAGoodFakeStory.name: Wrote a Good Fake Story
WroteAGoodFakeStory.def: A character lies about writing a story as a cover for some other activity, then gets too involved in the non-existent story and wants to make it real.

WildCardExcuse.name: Wild Card Excuse
WildCardExcuse.def: Somebody uses the same lie as an excuse for everything.

YouCanAlwaysTellALiar.name: You Can Always Tell a Liar

YouWontFeelAThing.name: You Won't Feel a Thing!
YouWontFeelAThing.def: Claiming that something won't be felt, which is usually a lie.

AccidentalChildKillerBackstory.name: Accidental Child-Killer Backstory
AccidentalChildKillerBackstory.def: A character who unintentionally caused a child's death in the past carries the burden into the present.

AccidentalMurder.name: Accidental Murder
AccidentalMurder.def: When someone unintentionally kills another person.

AccidentalResurrection.name: Accidental Resurrection
AccidentalResurrection.def: A deceased character/s is brought back to life without having been intended to.

AccidentNotMurder.name: Accident, Not Murder
AccidentNotMurder.def: Circumstances cause a freak accident to appear to be a murder.

AcquittedTooLate.name: Acquitted Too Late
AcquittedTooLate.def: A person wrongly convicted of a crime is sentenced to death and is killed before their name is cleared.

ActorDiesCharacterLeaves.name: Actor Dies, Character Leaves
ActorDiesCharacterLeaves.def: After an actor's death, the character they play simply leaves the cast and no longer makes any on-screen appearances, being explicitly Put on a Bus or their fate is left ambiguous.

ActorLeavesCharacterDies.name: Actor Leaves, Character Dies
ActorLeavesCharacterDies.def: Character is killed off because of the actor playing them leaving.

TheAfterafterlife.name: The Afterafterlife
TheAfterafterlife.def: You go from life to afterlife, but what comes after that?

AfterlifeAntechamber.name: Afterlife Antechamber
AfterlifeAntechamber.def: The afterlife shown on-screen is actually a pathway to the real afterlife, which isn't shown.

AfterlifeExpress.name: Afterlife Express
AfterlifeExpress.def: Dead souls are taken into the afterlife by a vehicle, usually a train.

AfterlifeWelcome.name: Afterlife Welcome
AfterlifeWelcome.def: Someone is greeted on their deathbed by those already in the afterlife.

AgingPetAngst.name: Aging Pet Angst
AgingPetAngst.def: A character's beloved animal companion is getting old and close to death. Many examples end with said pet dying.

AgonizingStomachWound.name: Agonizing Stomach Wound
AgonizingStomachWound.def: A stomach wound leads to a long, painful death.

AlasPoorScrappy.name: Alas, Poor Scrappy
AlasPoorScrappy.def: A character's detractors feel sorry for the character after they are killed off.

AlasPoorVillain.name: Alas, Poor Villain
AlasPoorVillain.def: A villain's demise is portrayed as sympathetic.

AlasPoorYorick.name: Alas, Poor Yorick
AlasPoorYorick.def: Lamenting the deceased while holding their skull.

AliveInTheAlternateUniverse.name: Alive in the Alternate Universe
AliveInTheAlternateUniverse.def: A dead person's Alternate Self is still alive.

AllAreEqualInDeath.name: All Are Equal in Death
AllAreEqualInDeath.def: Everyone is treated or shown as equal in death, regardless of how they were in life.

AllDeathsFinal.name: All Deaths Final
AllDeathsFinal.def: A setting where not even science or magic can bring back the dead.

AmmunitionConservation.name: Ammunition Conservation
AmmunitionConservation.def: Characters use as little ammunition as possible when dispatching enemies.

AncestorVeneration.name: Ancestor Veneration
AncestorVeneration.def: The veneration, exaltation, and/or outright worship of one's deceased ancestors.

AndShowItToYou.name: And Show It to You
AndShowItToYou.def: Killing someone by removing their heart and showing it to them.

AndThereWasMuchRejoicing.name: And There Was Much Rejoicing
AndThereWasMuchRejoicing.def: Everyone's glad that this person has died.

AngstySurvivingTwin.name: Angsty Surviving Twin
AngstySurvivingTwin.def: A twin dies and their surviving sibling grieves their passing.

AnotherMansTerror.name: Another Man's Terror
AnotherMansTerror.def: Having a better understanding of another person's death by experiencing the circumstances of their demise firsthand.

AntagonistInMourning.name: Antagonist in Mourning
AntagonistInMourning.def: The bad guy feels sorry for the hero's death.

AnkleDrag.name: Ankle Drag
AnkleDrag.def: A character is dragged to their unfortunate end by their ankles.

AnyLastWords.name: Any Last Words?
AnyLastWords.def: A character about to be killed is asked if they have any last words. They use the opportunity to turn the tables on the person who was about to kill them.

AnyoneCanDie.name: Anyone Can Die
AnyoneCanDie.def: A story shows that death can happen to anyone, no matter how powerful or important that character is.

ArtifactOfDeath.name: Artifact of Death
ArtifactOfDeath.def: A magical Artifact of Doom that is capable of killing people.

AscendToAHigherPlaneOfExistence.name: Ascend to a Higher Plane of Existence
AscendToAHigherPlaneOfExistence.def: A character dies without actually dying, often becoming a spirit.

AsLongAsThereIsEvil.name: As Long as There Is Evil
AsLongAsThereIsEvil.def: The villain can't really be killed because he'll keep coming back as long as evil exists.

AssassinationAttempt.name: Assassination Attempt
AssassinationAttempt.def: An attempt is made at taking an important person's life.

AteHisGun.name: Ate His Gun
AteHisGun.def: Someone commits suicide by firing a gun after putting it in their mouth.

AttackOnTheHeart.name: Attack on the Heart
AttackOnTheHeart.def: Someone kills someone else by shooting, stabbing, or otherwise injuring them in the heart.

AttendingYourOwnFuneral.name: Attending Your Own Funeral
AttendingYourOwnFuneral.def: A living character attends their own funeral, whether they've been faking their demise or were simply mistaken for being deceased.

BackForTheDead.name: Back for the Dead
BackForTheDead.def: A character who hasn't been seen in a while returns only to get killed.

BackFromTheDead.name: Back from the Dead
BackFromTheDead.def: A deceased character is resurrected back into the world of the living.

BackupFromOtherworld.name: Backup from Otherworld
BackupFromOtherworld.def: The dead assist the living during a fight.

BackupTwin.name: Backup Twin
BackupTwin.def: A deceased character is replaced by revealing that they have a surviving twin.

BalancingDeathsBooks.name: Balancing Death's Books
BalancingDeathsBooks.def: Saving someone's life by offering Death your own in exchange.

BarefootSuicide.name: Barefoot Suicide
BarefootSuicide.def: A character removes their shoes before killing themselves.

BarredFromTheAfterlife.name: Barred from the Afterlife
BarredFromTheAfterlife.def: A deceased person who can't enter Heaven or Hell.

BathSuicide.name: Bath Suicide
BathSuicide.def: A person kills themselves while bathing. Can overlap with Deadly Bath .

BequeathedPower.name: Bequeathed Power
BequeathedPower.def: A person gives their powers to a chosen successor before they die.

BestedByTheInexperienced.name: Bested by the Inexperienced
BestedByTheInexperienced.def: A person is killed by someone less experienced in combat than they are.

BetterIfNotBornPlot.name: "Better If Not Born" Plot
BetterIfNotBornPlot.def: A suicidal person is shown what life would be like if they didn't exist... only for everyone to be doing just fine or better without their presence.

BetterManhandleTheMurderWeapon.name: Better Manhandle the Murder Weapon
BetterManhandleTheMurderWeapon.def: An innocent person is incriminated because they started holding the murder weapon right after the victim's death.

BetterToDieThanBeKilled.name: Better to Die than Be Killed
BetterToDieThanBeKilled.def: A person commits suicide so the enemy can't hurt them on their own terms.

BigGuyFatalitySyndrome.name: Big Guy Fatality Syndrome
BigGuyFatalitySyndrome.def: The strongest of the group gives their life to the cause.

BigSleep.name: Big Sleep
BigSleep.def: Someone dies with their eyes closed.

BirthDeathJuxtaposition.name: Birth-Death Juxtaposition
BirthDeathJuxtaposition.def: A new life is born or introduced shortly before or after another person dies.

BitterAlmonds.name: Bitter Almonds
BitterAlmonds.def: Cyanide poisoning results in the victim smelling like bitter almonds.

BlackCapOfDeath.name: Black Cap of Death
BlackCapOfDeath.def: The judge wears a black hat to show they intend to give a death sentence.

BlackComedyPetDeath.name: Black Comedy Pet Death
BlackComedyPetDeath.def: The death of a pet is played for Black Comedy .

BlackComedyPredation.name: Black Comedy Predation
BlackComedyPredation.def: An animal being killed and eaten by a predator is played for Black Comedy .

TheBlackDeath.name: The Black Death
TheBlackDeath.def: The bubonic plague and its horrifying presence in 14th century Europe.

BlackDudeDiesFirst.name: Black Dude Dies First
BlackDudeDiesFirst.def: In a work of the horror genre, the first victim is a black man.

BlackSpot.name: Black Spot
BlackSpot.def: It is indicated that a person is marked for death by a mundane or cryptic thing.

BlofeldPloy.name: Blofeld Ploy
BlofeldPloy.def: A character threatens to kill someone, but kills someone else instead.

BloodFromEveryOrifice.name: Blood from Every Orifice
BloodFromEveryOrifice.def: Someone bleeds from their eyes, nose, mouth, and/or ears.

BloodFromTheMouth.name: Blood from the Mouth
BloodFromTheMouth.def: A character is indicated to be dying because they're bleeding from the mouth.

BloodyHallucinationsOfGuilt.name: Bloody Hallucinations of Guilt
BloodyHallucinationsOfGuilt.def: Guilt over another's death has a character seeing blood where there isn't any.

BloodyHorror.name: Bloody Horror
BloodyHorror.def: Horror works revolve around bloody and violent deaths.

BludgeonedToDeath.name: Bludgeoned to Death
BludgeonedToDeath.def: A person smashes someone else on the head over and over until they die.

BoardToDeath.name: Board to Death
BoardToDeath.def: Villain kills people at a meeting.

BodyguardBetrayal.name: Bodyguard Betrayal
BodyguardBetrayal.def: A person is betrayed by the person who is supposed to protect them.

BolivianArmyCliffhanger.name: Bolivian Army Cliffhanger
BolivianArmyCliffhanger.def: A show's season ends on a cliffhanger where it's hard to tell who survived and who didn't.

BolivianArmyEnding.name: Bolivian Army Ending
BolivianArmyEnding.def: The story ends with a character or characters’ fates uncertain, but highly likely they will die.

BondingOverMissingParents.name: Bonding over Missing Parents
BondingOverMissingParents.def: Two characters bond over the fact that they both have missing relatives.

BondOneLiner.name: Bond One-Liner
BondOneLiner.def: A character taunts their victim after killing them.

BoomHeadshot.name: Boom, Headshot!
BoomHeadshot.def: Killing an enemy by shooting them in the head.

BornFromADeadWoman.name: Born from a Dead Woman
BornFromADeadWoman.def: A child is born after the mother has already died.

BorrowinSamedi.name: Borrowin' Samedi
BorrowinSamedi.def: An expy of Baron Samedi, the Voudou god of death.

BrokenFaceplate.name: Broken Faceplate
BrokenFaceplate.def: Someone's death is emphasized by having their helmet or mask shattered.

BucketList.name: Bucket List
BucketList.def: A person puts together a list of things to do before they die.

BungledSuicide.name: Bungled Suicide
BungledSuicide.def: A person tries to commit suicide, but fails.

BurialAtSea.name: Burial at Sea
BurialAtSea.def: A dead body is disposed by being tossed into the ocean.

BurialInSpace.name: Burial in Space
BurialInSpace.def: A dead body is disposed by launching it into the vacuum of outer space.

BuriedAlive.name: Buried Alive
BuriedAlive.def: A living person, usually unconscious and mistaken for dead, gets dumped into a grave. Should they fail to escape in time, they'll die of asphyxiation and become real corpses.

BuriedInAPileOfCorpses.name: Buried in a Pile of Corpses
BuriedInAPileOfCorpses.def: Someone hides beneath a bunch of dead bodies.

BurnTheWitch.name: Burn the Witch!
BurnTheWitch.def: A person accused of witchcraft gets burned at the stake.

BurpOfFinality.name: Burp of Finality
BurpOfFinality.def: If a person is eaten, the creature who ate them burping means they're dead.

BuryMeNotOnTheLonePrairie.name: Bury Me Not on the Lone Prairie
BuryMeNotOnTheLonePrairie.def: Someone has difficulty in honoring the deceased's last requests.

BuryYourDisabled.name: Bury Your Disabled
BuryYourDisabled.def: A disabled character (physically or mentally) gets killed.

BuryYourGays.name: Bury Your Gays
BuryYourGays.def: When the token gay characters end up getting killed.

BusCrash.name: Bus Crash
BusCrash.def: A character who was phased out of a show is killed off before they have a chance to return.

ButterflyOfDeathAndRebirth.name: Butterfly of Death and Rebirth
ButterflyOfDeathAndRebirth.def: Butterflies used to symbolize death and/or rebirth.

CainAndAbel.name: Cain and Abel
CainAndAbel.def: A sibling becomes dead set on killing the other.

CameBackStrong.name: Came Back Strong
CameBackStrong.def: A resurrected person is more powerful than they were before they died.

CameBackWrong.name: Came Back Wrong
CameBackWrong.def: A resurrection goes wrong, causing the revived person to have a nasty side effect to come with their rebirth.

TheCanKickedHim.name: The Can Kicked Him
TheCanKickedHim.def: Someone is killed in a bathroom.

CannotKillTheirLovedOnes.name: Cannot Kill Their Loved Ones
CannotKillTheirLovedOnes.def: Almost everyone has someone they can't bring themselves to kill.

CarCushion.name: Car Cushion
CarCushion.def: Someone lands on a car after falling from a great height.

CarpeDiem.name: Carpe Diem
CarpeDiem.def: The reasoning that the brevity of life means you have the right to do whatever you want as long as you're alive.

CarpetRolledCorpse.name: Carpet-Rolled Corpse
CarpetRolledCorpse.def: Hiding a corpse by rolling it up in a carpet.

CartwrightCurse.name: Cartwright Curse
CartwrightCurse.def: The character's love interests always get killed.

CasualtyInTheRing.name: Casualty in the Ring
CasualtyInTheRing.def: Professional fighter dies in the ring.

CeilingCorpse.name: Ceiling Corpse
CeilingCorpse.def: Someone finds a corpse on the ceiling.

CelebrityCasualty.name: Celebrity Casualty
CelebrityCasualty.def: A still-living Real Life person is killed off in a work of fiction.

CelestialBureaucracy.name: Celestial Bureaucracy
CelestialBureaucracy.def: There's a spiritual bureaucracy dedicated to sorting out where the souls of the deceased are supposed to go.

CementShoes.name: Cement Shoes
CementShoes.def: Drowning someone by casting their feet into cement.

CensoredChildDeath.name: Censored Child Death
CensoredChildDeath.def: Children are killed offscreen, or the camera obscured this when it happened.

CessationOfExistence.name: Cessation of Existence
CessationOfExistence.def: The idea that there is no afterlife and once you die, that's it.

ChalkOutline.name: Chalk Outline
ChalkOutline.def: The crime scene has the silhouette of a dead body drawn on the ground.

TheCharacterDiedWithHim.name: The Character Died with Him
TheCharacterDiedWithHim.def: A character is killed off after their actor passed away in real life.

CharacterOutlivesActor.name: Character Outlives Actor
CharacterOutlivesActor.def: A character is established to still be alive, though no longer given major appearances, after their actor has passed away.

CharactersDroppingLikeFlies.name: Characters Dropping Like Flies
CharactersDroppingLikeFlies.def: Lots of named characters die throughout the course of the series.

CheatedDeathDiedAnyway.name: Cheated Death, Died Anyway
CheatedDeathDiedAnyway.def: A character survives a near death experience, only to die in different but equal cruel and unusual circumstances a short time later.

CheatingDamnation.name: Cheating Damnation
CheatingDamnation.def: A character plans to cheat their way out of Hell when they die.

ChessWithDeath.name: Chess with Death
ChessWithDeath.def: Challenging the Grim Reaper in a game or contest so that you may have a chance of cheating death.

ChronicallyKilledActor.name: Chronically Killed Actor
ChronicallyKilledActor.def: An actor always plays characters who get killed.

ChunkySalsaRule.name: Chunky Salsa Rule
ChunkySalsaRule.def: When video games go for realism by having certain injuries befalling the player character be as fatal as it is in real life.

ElCidPloy.name: El Cid Ploy
ElCidPloy.def: A deception where people are convinced that a dead person is still alive, commonly by having someone else impersonate the deceased.

CirclingVultures.name: Circling Vultures
CirclingVultures.def: Vultures surround someone when they're about to die.

CivilizationDestroyer.name: Civilization Destroyer
CivilizationDestroyer.def: A being powerful enough to wipe out entire civilizations.

ClimacticBattleResurrection.name: Climactic Battle Resurrection
ClimacticBattleResurrection.def: Someone comes back from the dead in time for the final battle.

CListFodder.name: C-List Fodder
CListFodder.def: Casualties are established by killing off minor characters.

CoinsForTheDead.name: Coins for the Dead
CoinsForTheDead.def: Coins are left for the dead so they can use them to pay in the afterlife.

ColdEquation.name: Cold Equation
ColdEquation.def: Choosing to kill someone so that others may live.

CollateralDamage.name: Collateral Damage
CollateralDamage.def: Often a euphemistic term referring to (allegedly unintentional) civilian casualties of war.

ComfortTheDying.name: Comfort the Dying
ComfortTheDying.def: A character dies with someone else soothing them.

CompetingWithACorpse.name: Competing with a Corpse
CompetingWithACorpse.def: A Love Triangle in which one of the love rivals is already deceased.

CondolenceCasserole.name: Condolence Casserole
CondolenceCasserole.def: Giving people baked dishes when they have a loved one who just died.

ConspicuouslyPublicAssassination.name: Conspicuously Public Assassination
ConspicuouslyPublicAssassination.def: When the assassination is done in view of many witnesses.

ContractualImmortality.name: Contractual Immortality
ContractualImmortality.def: A character can't die as long as their actor is still obligated to play them.

ConvenientTerminalIllness.name: Convenient Terminal Illness
ConvenientTerminalIllness.def: Someone makes the decision to sacrifice themselves on the grounds that they're dying anyway.

ConversationCasualty.name: Conversation Casualty
ConversationCasualty.def: Killing someone while talking to them.

CookedToDeath.name: Cooked to Death
CookedToDeath.def: Death by cooking device, including an oven.

CopKiller.name: Cop Killer
CopKiller.def: Someone who has murdered a police officer.

CopKillerManhunt.name: Cop Killer Manhunt
CopKillerManhunt.def: If you kill a cop, expect the rest of the police to be chasing after you with a vengeance.

TheCorpseStopsHere.name: The Corpse Stops Here
TheCorpseStopsHere.def: Someone is accused of murder just for being near the body.

CoupDeGrace.name: Coup de Grâce
CoupDeGrace.def: The final blow that kills, often done to finish off a defeated opponent at the end of a fight.

CradleOfLoneliness.name: Cradle of Loneliness
CradleOfLoneliness.def: Cradling a keepsake of the person you're mourning.

CradleToGraveCharacter.name: Cradle-to-Grave Character
CradleToGraveCharacter.def: The story is about a character's entire life from birth to death.

CradlingYourKill.name: Cradling Your Kill
CradlingYourKill.def: The corpse is cradled by the killer.

CruelAndUnusualDeath.name: Cruel and Unusual Death
CruelAndUnusualDeath.def: Dying in a way that's very painful, undignified, or unpleasant.

CryonicsFailure.name: Cryonics Failure
CryonicsFailure.def: A cryogenically frozen person dies because the freezing process didn't work properly.

CuriosityKilledTheCast.name: Curiosity Killed the Cast
CuriosityKilledTheCast.def: Character dooms themselves by messing with what they really should've known better than to mess with.

CutTheSafetyRope.name: Cut the Safety Rope
CutTheSafetyRope.def: A character sacrifices themselves by disconnecting what could've carried them to safety.

DamagedSoul.name: Damaged Soul
DamagedSoul.def: The resurrected has gone insane as a side effect of their revival.

DangerThinIce.name: Danger — Thin Ice
DangerThinIce.def: Walking on thin ice brings risk of falling in and drowning or freezing to death.

DeagedInDeath.name: De-aged in Death
DeagedInDeath.def: A person's soul looks young even though the person in question died at an older age.

DeadAlternateCounterpart.name: Dead Alternate Counterpart
DeadAlternateCounterpart.def: Character visits an alternate reality where their counterpart has died.

DeadAnimalWarning.name: Dead Animal Warning
DeadAnimalWarning.def: Showing someone you mean business by delivering them dead animals.

DeadArtistsAreBetter.name: Dead Artists Are Better
DeadArtistsAreBetter.def: When an artist dies, their death increases the value and uniqueness of their work.

DeadBodyRoommate.name: Dead Body Roommate
DeadBodyRoommate.def: Keeping a body in your home so no one else finds out.

DeaderThanDead.name: Deader than Dead
DeaderThanDead.def: A character known to cheat death is killed in a way that it's now impossible for them to ever be resurrected again.

DeadFootLeadfoot.name: Dead Foot Leadfoot
DeadFootLeadfoot.def: A driver gets killed and their foot is still pressing on the pedal somehow. Usually caused by falling asleep at the wheel.

TheDeadGuyDidIt.name: The Dead Guy Did It
TheDeadGuyDidIt.def: The dead person is responsible for some or all of a mystery.

DeadGuyJunior.name: Dead Guy Junior
DeadGuyJunior.def: Someone is named after a person who died before their birth.

DeadGuyOnDisplay.name: Dead Guy on Display
DeadGuyOnDisplay.def: Displaying the corpse of someone you killed.

DeadGuyPuppet.name: Dead Guy Puppet
DeadGuyPuppet.def: Working a person's corpse like a puppet.

DeadHandShot.name: Dead-Hand Shot
DeadHandShot.def: Showing a shot of a dead person's hand to show that they've died.

DeadHatShot.name: Dead Hat Shot
DeadHatShot.def: Showing that a person has died by showing a shot of their discarded hat.

TheDeadHaveNames.name: The Dead Have Names
TheDeadHaveNames.def: The dead are named to show their significance.

DeadlineNews.name: Deadline News
DeadlineNews.def: A news anchor dies on the air, commonly killed by whatever disaster they're reporting.

DeadlyBath.name: Deadly Bath
DeadlyBath.def: Someone dies while taking a bath. Can overlap with Bath Suicide .

DeadlyClosingCredits.name: Deadly Closing Credits
DeadlyClosingCredits.def: The scene cuts to black/closing credits immediately after a life-threatening situation, leaving the viewers to come to their own conclusions as to whether the character(s) really died or not.

DeadlyDeferredConversation.name: Deadly Deferred Conversation
DeadlyDeferredConversation.def: Someone promises to tell someone else about something, only for one or both of them to die later.

DeadlyDistantFinale.name: Deadly Distant Finale
DeadlyDistantFinale.def: The work ends with a flash forward to the main character's later years where they die.

DeadlyEuphemism.name: Deadly Euphemism
DeadlyEuphemism.def: Using a better phrase and/or term to refer to death, dying, or killing someone.

DeadlyGame.name: Deadly Game
DeadlyGame.def: A game in which losers are killed.

DeadlyGas.name: Deadly Gas
DeadlyGas.def: A gas that has lethal effects due to either toxicity or suffocation.

DeadlyHug.name: Deadly Hug
DeadlyHug.def: A hug turns out to be fatal, usually causing strangulation, decapitation, or Marshmallow Hell .

DeadlyNosebleed.name: Deadly Nosebleed
DeadlyNosebleed.def: A character bleeds from their nose to show they're dying. Not as common as Blood from the Mouth .

DeadlyPrank.name: Deadly Prank
DeadlyPrank.def: A seemingly harmless prank goes fatally wrong.

DeadlyRoadTrip.name: Deadly Road Trip
DeadlyRoadTrip.def: Ending up in peril while on vacation.

DeadlyScratch.name: Deadly Scratch
DeadlyScratch.def: A seemingly-minor injury proves unexpectedly dangerous, possibly even fatal.

DeadManHonking.name: Dead Man Honking
DeadManHonking.def: A dead driver's corpse falls forward and honks the car horn.

DeadMansTriggerFinger.name: Dead Man's Trigger Finger
DeadMansTriggerFinger.def: Someone armed with a gun involuntarily fires once they're killed.

DeadMansSwitch.name: Dead Man's Switch
DeadMansSwitch.def: Character arranges it so their death causes bad things to happen. May or may not be a supernatural being.

DeadMansChest.name: Dead Man's Chest
DeadMansChest.def: Hiding a body by stuffing it in a trunk.

DeadPartner.name: Dead Partner
DeadPartner.def: Someone has a partner die in the line of duty.

DeadPersonConversation.name: Dead Person Conversation
DeadPersonConversation.def: Communicating with the deceased. Usually a witch or psychic.

DeadSerious.name: Dead Serious
DeadSerious.def: Someone proves they're not fucking around anymore by killing someone important.

DeadSidekick.name: Dead Sidekick
DeadSidekick.def: Hero is haunted by the death of their ward.

DeadToBeginWith.name: Dead to Begin With
DeadToBeginWith.def: Story starts with the main character already dead and goes on in the afterlife.

DeathlyUnmasking.name: Deathly Unmasking
DeathlyUnmasking.def: A Dramatic Unmask that occurs just before or after death.

DeathActivatedSuperpower.name: Death-Activated Superpower
DeathActivatedSuperpower.def: A person gains powers after dying.

DeathAmnesia.name: Death Amnesia
DeathAmnesia.def: The resurrected have no memory of their death.

DeathAsComedy.name: Death as Comedy
DeathAsComedy.def: Someone's death is played for Black Comedy .

DeathAsGameMechanic.name: Death as Game Mechanic
DeathAsGameMechanic.def: When dying is used as a mechanic in the game that does more than just end or restart the game.

DeathbedPromotion.name: Deathbed Promotion
DeathbedPromotion.def: A soldier at or near the point of death is honored by being formally elevated in rank.

DeathBasedGhostPowers.name: Death-Based Ghost Powers
DeathBasedGhostPowers.def: A ghost with powers, quirks, and/or a theme based around how they died.

DeathByAdaptation.name: Death by Adaptation
DeathByAdaptation.def: A character still alive in the original work is killed off in the adaptation, or a character who dies later in the original work is killed off sooner in the adaptation.

DeathByAmbulance.name: Death by Ambulance
DeathByAmbulance.def: Someone is killed by an ambulance.

DeathByCameo.name: Death by Cameo
DeathByCameo.def: An actor makes a cameo appearance where they're killed or seen as a corpse.

DeathByDeaging.name: Death by De-aging
DeathByDeaging.def: Becoming younger and younger until it kills/erases them.

DeathByDepower.name: Death by Depower
DeathByDepower.def: Losing powers means losing what's keeping someone alive.

DeathByDespair.name: Death by Despair
DeathByDespair.def: Depression exacerbates illness to the point of fatality.

DeathByDisfigurement.name: Death by Disfigurement
DeathByDisfigurement.def: A beautiful person dies shortly after being deformed in some way.

DeathByFallingOver.name: Death by Falling Over
DeathByFallingOver.def: Someone dies after losing their balance.

DeathByFlashback.name: Death by Flashback
DeathByFlashback.def: We learn a character's backstory just before they die.

DeathByIrony.name: Death by Irony
DeathByIrony.def: The cause of death is ironic.

DeathByLookingUp.name: Death by Looking Up
DeathByLookingUp.def: Character about to be squashed looks upward long enough to react to what's about to crush them.

DeathByMaterialism.name: Death by Materialism
DeathByMaterialism.def: Someone dies because they're too greedy to leave alone the item of value that they covet.

DeathByMocking.name: Death by Mocking
DeathByMocking.def: A person is killed in retaliation for mocking their killer.

DeathByMusicVideo.name: Death by Music Video
DeathByMusicVideo.def: A music video where the band members are killed, sometimes to tell a story or make a point.

DeathByNewberyMedal.name: Death by Newbery Medal
DeathByNewberyMedal.def: A work aimed at children has someone die for the sake of pathos.

DeathByOriginStory.name: Death by Origin Story
DeathByOriginStory.def: The hero's backstory involves someone close to them dying. In the case of undead heroes, their own death.

DeathByPragmatism.name: Death by Pragmatism
DeathByPragmatism.def: Character dies in spite of making the sensible and logical decision in solving the problem.

DeathByRacism.name: Death by Racism
DeathByRacism.def: A racist gets killed for being racist.

DeathByRecognition.name: Death by Recognition
DeathByRecognition.def: Someone gets killed immediately after recognizing their killer.

DeathBySecretIdentity.name: Death by Secret Identity
DeathBySecretIdentity.def: A person who's found out the superhero's secret identity gets killed before he can do anything with the knowledge.

DeathByTransceiver.name: Death by Transceiver
DeathByTransceiver.def: Someone hears or sees another person's death through a communications system, such as a phone or school PA system.

DeathByWomanScorned.name: Death by Woman Scorned
