DeathByWomanScorned.def: Killing an adulterous spouse is treated as okay.

DeathCult.name: Death Cult
DeathCult.def: A cult whose doctrine includes murder and/or suicide.

DeathEqualsEmotion.name: Death Equals Emotion
DeathEqualsEmotion.def: An emotionless person shows emotion when they die.

DeathEqualsRedemption.name: Death Equals Redemption
DeathEqualsRedemption.def: A villain is forgiven for their misdeeds after their death.

DeathFakedForYou.name: Death Faked for You
DeathFakedForYou.def: A person has their death faked by someone else.

DeathFlight.name: Death Flight
DeathFlight.def: Someone is executed by being dropped from above.

DeathInCustody.name: Death in Custody
DeathInCustody.def: A death happens in a police station.

DeathInTheClouds.name: Death in the Clouds
DeathInTheClouds.def: A murder happens on an airplane.

ADeathInTheLimelight.name: A Death in the Limelight
ADeathInTheLimelight.def: A minor character dies at the end of their focus episode.

DeathIsALoser.name: Death Is a Loser
DeathIsALoser.def: The Grim Reaper is a loser.

DeathIsASadThing.name: Death Is a Sad Thing
DeathIsASadThing.def: Children learn about death for the first time and are saddened by it.

DeathIsASlapOnTheWrist.name: Death Is a Slap on the Wrist
DeathIsASlapOnTheWrist.def: Video games where it's possible to keep dying and respawning indefinitely as long as the player doesn't call it quits.

DeathIsCheap.name: Death Is Cheap
DeathIsCheap.def: In a fictional work's universe, various mechanics make it to where dying isn't permanent and is easily fixed. This is especially common in superhero comics, to the extent that the trope used to be called Comic Book Death.

DeathIsNotPermanent.name: Death Is Not Permanent
DeathIsNotPermanent.def: A video game gives an in-universe reason for the player character to respawn every time they die.

DeathIsSuchAnOddThing.name: Death Is Such an Odd Thing
DeathIsSuchAnOddThing.def: A character expresses their confused feelings on someone they disliked suddenly passing away.

DeathIsTheOnlyOption.name: Death Is the Only Option
DeathIsTheOnlyOption.def: A situation where the only way to win is to let yourself get killed.

DeathMarch.name: Death March
DeathMarch.def: Prisoners are forced to walk in fatal conditions, with death often the intended outcome.

DeathMeansHumanity.name: Death Means Humanity
DeathMeansHumanity.def: A non-human being has its personhood recognized upon death.

DeathMontage.name: Death Montage
DeathMontage.def: A montage of a character being repeatedly killed.

DeathNotification.name: Death Notification
DeathNotification.def: Breaking the bad news of a person's death to that person's bereaved ones. Usually done by a cop, hospital worker, or a relative.

DeathOfAChild.name: Death of a Child
DeathOfAChild.def: When fiction openly depicts children dying.

TheDeathOfDeath.name: The Death of Death
TheDeathOfDeath.def: The one dying is Death itself .

DeathOfPersonality.name: Death of Personality
DeathOfPersonality.def: A living person is regarded as dead just because they've lost their self.

DeathOfTheHypotenuse.name: Death of the Hypotenuse
DeathOfTheHypotenuse.def: A person has two love interests and one of them dies.

DeathOfTheOldGods.name: Death of the Old Gods
DeathOfTheOldGods.def: The idea that the gods of ancient mythology aren't around anymore because they're dead.

DeathOrPowerLottery.name: Death Or Power Lottery
DeathOrPowerLottery.def: A substance, tool, or other means that will either kill a person or make them stronger.

DeathRow.name: Death Row
DeathRow.def: Prisoners who are selected to eventually be executed.

DeathSeeker.name: Death Seeker
DeathSeeker.def: Character actually wants to get killed.

DeathsHourglass.name: Death's Hourglass
DeathsHourglass.def: A physical or personal manifestation of a person's remaining lifespan.

DeathTakesAHoliday.name: Death Takes a Holiday
DeathTakesAHoliday.def: The Grim Reaper stops making people die for whatever reason.

DeathWail.name: Death Wail
DeathWail.def: Reacting to a loved one's death by screaming.

DeathlyDiesIrae.name: Deathly Dies Irae
DeathlyDiesIrae.def: Musical motif signifying the presence of death.

DecapitatedArmy.name: Decapitated Army
DecapitatedArmy.def: The underlings will see no reason to continue fighting if you've killed their leader.

DecapitationPresentation.name: Decapitation Presentation
DecapitationPresentation.def: Holding up a dead person's head to prove you've killed them. Common with serial killers, Vikings, executioners, and headhunters.

DecapitationRequired.name: Decapitation Required
DecapitationRequired.def: Cutting off the enemy's head is the only way to kill it. Commonly seen in zombie fiction.

DecapitationStrike.name: Decapitation Strike
DecapitationStrike.def: A planned attempt to kill or incapacitate multiple leaders at once.

DecayIsNecessary.name: Decay Is Necessary
DecayIsNecessary.def: An Aesop about the need for organisms that clean up after the dead.

DeceasedFallGuyGambit.name: Deceased Fall-Guy Gambit
DeceasedFallGuyGambit.def: Pinning the blame on a dead person.

DeceasedParentsAreTheBest.name: Deceased Parents Are the Best
DeceasedParentsAreTheBest.def: The only good parents in the work are deceased ones. Common in Disney films.

DepartureMeansDeath.name: Departure Means Death
DepartureMeansDeath.def: It's impossible for someone to leave a certain area without dying.

DefiantToTheEnd.name: Defiant to the End
DefiantToTheEnd.def: Prisoner fearlessly shows contempt and ridicule toward their captors even when they're about to be killed.

DenyingTheDeadParentsSins.name: Denying the Dead Parent's Sins
DenyingTheDeadParentsSins.def: Someone refuses to believe that their dead parents had a dark past.

DesertSkull.name: Desert Skull
DesertSkull.def: An animal's skull found in the desert, usually a bovine.

DestinationHostUnreachable.name: Destination Host Unreachable
DestinationHostUnreachable.def: The resurrected for some reason cannot be with their loved ones anymore.

DevouredByTheHorde.name: Devoured by the Horde
DevouredByTheHorde.def: A character is Eaten Alive and/or torn apart by multiple parties.

DiceRollDeath.name: Dice Roll Death
DiceRollDeath.def: Death caused by bad luck or random chance.

DidYouDie.name: Did You Die?
DidYouDie.def: Someone is asked whether or not they survived a dangerous event even though it's obvious they lived if they're around to tell the story. Small children often ask this.

DiedDuringProduction.name: Died During Production
DiedDuringProduction.def: When the real-life death of a creator results in the cancellation or postponement of their work, or otherwise causes serious complications with its development.

DiedHappilyEverAfter.name: Died Happily Ever After
DiedHappilyEverAfter.def: A dead character is seen as happy right as they drift off to the heavens.

DiedInIgnorance.name: Died in Ignorance
DiedInIgnorance.def: A character dies without ever finding out a massive truth that completely alters their situation, usually The Reveal .

DiedInYourArmsTonight.name: Died in Your Arms Tonight
DiedInYourArmsTonight.def: Someone (usually a family member or a love interest) cradles a person in their arms as they die.

DiedOnTheirBirthday.name: Died on Their Birthday
DiedOnTheirBirthday.def: A character dies on their own birthday.

DiedStandingUp.name: Died Standing Up
DiedStandingUp.def: A person still stands after they've been killed.

DieLaughing.name: Die Laughing
DieLaughing.def: Someone literally laughs themselves to death. This has actually happened in real life.

DiesDifferentlyInAdaptation.name: Dies Differently in Adaptation
DiesDifferentlyInAdaptation.def: A character that dies one way in original work ends up dying a different way in an alternate continuity.

DiesWideOpen.name: Dies Wide Open
DiesWideOpen.def: Someone dies with their eyes open.

DigYourOwnGrave.name: Dig Your Own Grave
DigYourOwnGrave.def: Before being killed, the victim is forced to dig their own grave.

DisappearsIntoLight.name: Disappears into Light
DisappearsIntoLight.def: When a character dies, they turn into light.

DisconnectedByDeath.name: Disconnected by Death
DisconnectedByDeath.def: Someone is killed while trying to make an important phone call.

DiscoveringYourOwnDeadBody.name: Discovering Your Own Dead Body
DiscoveringYourOwnDeadBody.def: Whether through time travel, visiting an alternate reality where they died, or returning from the afterlife as a ghost, a character comes across their own corpse.

TheDisembodied.name: The Disembodied
TheDisembodied.def: Losing your body without actually dying.

DisintegrationChamber.name: Disintegration Chamber
DisintegrationChamber.def: A science fiction method of executing people by putting them in some kind of chamber where they are zapped into nonexistence.

DismemberingTheBody.name: Dismembering the Body
DismemberingTheBody.def: A character chops up pieces of a body to make it easier to dispose.

DisneyDeath.name: Disney Death
DisneyDeath.def: A character turns out to still be alive after initially appearing to die.

DisneyVillainDeath.name: Disney Villain Death
DisneyVillainDeath.def: Villain ends up falling to their death.

DisposablePilot.name: Disposable Pilot
DisposablePilot.def: Passengers of a vehicle are imperiled when the driver gets killed. Especially bad when no one else has a license or is otherwise unable to drive.

DisposableSexWorker.name: Disposable Sex Worker
DisposableSexWorker.def: Audience sympathy for a casualty victim is ruled out by making the victim a prostitute.

DisposingOfABody.name: Disposing of a Body
DisposingOfABody.def: The killer tries to avoid getting in trouble by getting rid of their victim's corpse.

DistantFuneralAttendee.name: Distant Funeral Attendee
DistantFuneralAttendee.def: Someone attends a funeral far away from the other mourners.

DistractedFromDeath.name: Distracted from Death
DistractedFromDeath.def: One character dies while the other is distracted, the other not yet noticing their friend is dead.

DivorceRequiresDeath.name: Divorce Requires Death
DivorceRequiresDeath.def: A person (usually the bride) ends their marriage by killing their spouse.

TheDogBitesBack.name: The Dog Bites Back
TheDogBitesBack.def: Someone gets killed by a person they had been abusing and tormenting.

DontFearTheReaper.name: Don't Fear the Reaper
DontFearTheReaper.def: The Grim Reaper is not such a bad guy.

DontMakeMeDestroyYou.name: Don't Make Me Destroy You
DontMakeMeDestroyYou.def: You ask someone to not make you kill them.

DoomAsTestPrize.name: Doom as Test Prize
DoomAsTestPrize.def: A competition where the winner's reward is to be killed.

DoomedByCanon.name: Doomed by Canon
DoomedByCanon.def: The prequel can't prevent a character's death without contradicting the events of the series' other installments.

DoomedContrarian.name: Doomed Contrarian
DoomedContrarian.def: The one person who disagrees gets killed.

DoomedPredecessor.name: Doomed Predecessor
DoomedPredecessor.def: Finding the corpse of a previous adventurer in a cave.

DoomMagnet.name: Doom Magnet
DoomMagnet.def: A person who always brings death and disaster to other people.

DoWithHimAsYouWill.name: Do with Him as You Will
DoWithHimAsYouWill.def: The hero leaves the villain at the mercy of the people the villain has wronged.

DraggedOffToHell.name: Dragged Off to Hell
DraggedOffToHell.def: A person is carried off to Hell against their wishes.

DramaticSpineInjury.name: Dramatic Spine Injury
DramaticSpineInjury.def: A person dies from a spine injury.

DressingToDie.name: Dressing to Die
DressingToDie.def: A person wants to look their best when they die, so they dress up before facing their end.

DrivenToSuicide.name: Driven to Suicide
DrivenToSuicide.def: A person ends up committing suicide.

DropDeadGorgeous.name: Drop Dead Gorgeous
DropDeadGorgeous.def: Titillating the audience with nude corpses. Vampires are a common theme.

DropInNemesis.name: Drop-In Nemesis
DropInNemesis.def: An enemy that kills you with little to no warning if you make a mistake.

DroppedABridgeOnHim.name: Dropped a Bridge on Him
DroppedABridgeOnHim.def: A major character is killed in a sudden and contrived manner.

DrowningUnwantedPets.name: Drowning Unwanted Pets
DrowningUnwantedPets.def: A person drowns pets, usually puppies or kittens, that they can't take care of.

DueToTheDead.name: Due to the Dead
DueToTheDead.def: Burying the dead is considered respectful, while desecrating the remains is disgraceful.

DuelToTheDeath.name: Duel to the Death
DuelToTheDeath.def: Two opponents are chosen to fight each other until one has killed the other.

DwindlingParty.name: Dwindling Party
DwindlingParty.def: The cast lowers in numbers because of deaths.

DyingAlone.name: Dying Alone
DyingAlone.def: Dying with no one else to mourn your passing is sad.

DyingAsYourself.name: Dying as Yourself
DyingAsYourself.def: A person dies shortly after being freed of the corruption that took over them.

DyingCandle.name: Dying Candle
DyingCandle.def: Death indicated by a candle going out.

DyingCurse.name: Dying Curse
DyingCurse.def: A person's last words is to vow that harm will befall the people they loathe.

DyingDealUpgrade.name: Dying Deal Upgrade
DyingDealUpgrade.def: A dying character is given new powers and allowed to continue living in exchange for servitude.

DyingDeclarationOfHate.name: Dying Declaration of Hate
DyingDeclarationOfHate.def: A character confesses their hatred of the person near them as they die.

DyingDeclarationOfLove.name: Dying Declaration of Love
DyingDeclarationOfLove.def: A character confesses their love to someone as they die.

DyingDream.name: Dying Dream
DyingDream.def: It's revealed that the story's events were all a hallucination the protagonist is experiencing as they die.

DyingMomentOfAwesome.name: Dying Moment of Awesome
DyingMomentOfAwesome.def: A character ensures that they die doing something cool.

DyingObjectDropShot.name: Dying Object Drop Shot
DyingObjectDropShot.def: A item that someone is carrying drops when they die.

DyingReconciliation.name: Dying Reconciliation
DyingReconciliation.def: Someone who is dying tries to bury the hatchet.

DyingSmirk.name: Dying Smirk
DyingSmirk.def: A person who is about to die scoffs and smirks, grins, smiles spitefully or laughs ironically, showing off to their opponents that they still have the upper hand somehow.

DyingToBeReplaced.name: Dying to Be Replaced
DyingToBeReplaced.def: A character is killed off so someone else can take their place.

DyingToWakeUp.name: Dying to Wake Up
DyingToWakeUp.def: Dying in a dream instantly wakes you up.

DyingTruce.name: Dying Truce
DyingTruce.def: Enemies decide to stop fighting when one of them is near death.

DyingVocalChange.name: Dying Vocal Change
DyingVocalChange.def: A character's voice transforms as they die.

TheDyingWalk.name: The Dying Walk
TheDyingWalk.def: Someone walks away from whatever they were doing before they die.

EatenAlive.name: Eaten Alive
EatenAlive.def: A person is killed by being devoured.

EatingTheEnemy.name: Eating the Enemy
EatingTheEnemy.def: Defeating the enemy by eating them.

ElectrifiedBathtub.name: Electrified Bathtub
ElectrifiedBathtub.def: Someone is killed when they get immersed in water that is then electrified.

EmpathyDollShot.name: Empathy Doll Shot
EmpathyDollShot.def: A shot of a child's toy on the ground is shown to indicate that children have died in the area.

EmptyBedroomGrieving.name: Empty Bedroom Grieving
EmptyBedroomGrieving.def: A person's death and/or disappearance is magnified by their abandoned bedroom.

EmptyChairMemorial.name: Empty Chair Memorial
EmptyChairMemorial.def: Honoring someone's memory by leaving the chair they used to sit in empty.

EmptyPilesOfClothing.name: Empty Piles of Clothing
EmptyPilesOfClothing.def: A person is killed in a way that their clothes are all that's left.

EndingMemorialService.name: Ending Memorial Service
EndingMemorialService.def: The story ends with a funeral.

EnemiesWithDeath.name: Enemies with Death
EnemiesWithDeath.def: A person is hated by the Grim Reaper.

EverybodyDiesEnding.name: "Everybody Dies" Ending
EverybodyDiesEnding.def: The story ends with everyone dead.

EverybodyHatesHades.name: Everybody Hates Hades
EverybodyHatesHades.def: Nobody likes the god of death.

EverybodyLives.name: Everybody Lives
EverybodyLives.def: The story ends with no one dying.

EverybodysDeadDave.name: Everybody's Dead, Dave
EverybodysDeadDave.def: An entire group dies except one survivor.

EverythingFades.name: Everything Fades
EverythingFades.def: Video game enemies disappear after they're defeated.

ExamineTheLiveGrenade.name: Examine the Live Grenade
ExamineTheLiveGrenade.def: A character is killed while failing to react appropriately to a thrown explosive.

ExcessiveMourning.name: Excessive Mourning
ExcessiveMourning.def: Someone mourns another person's death to the point that they become a problem.

ExitPursuedByABear.name: Exit, Pursued by a Bear
ExitPursuedByABear.def: A person is last seen being chased by a creature that will probably kill them.

ExplosiveDecompression.name: Explosive Decompression
ExplosiveDecompression.def: A sudden shift in pressure makes you blow up.

ExplosiveStupidity.name: Explosive Stupidity
ExplosiveStupidity.def: Someone blows themselves up by mishandling explosives.

EyeRemember.name: Eye Remember
EyeRemember.def: The dead's memories can be harvested from their eyes.

FaceDeathWithDignity.name: Face Death with Dignity
FaceDeathWithDignity.def: A character chooses to remain calm and collected upon learning they're going to die.

FacepalmOfDoom.name: Facepalm of Doom
FacepalmOfDoom.def: Grabbing someone by the face and blasting/crushing them at point-blank range.

FadingAway.name: Fading Away
FadingAway.def: A character dies by fading away.

FakeKillScare.name: Fake Kill Scare
FakeKillScare.def: Freaking people out by pretending to kill someone else.

FakingTheDead.name: Faking the Dead
FakingTheDead.def: A person only pretends to be dead.

FamilyPillarDeath.name: Family Pillar Death
FamilyPillarDeath.def: The death of parental figure causes their family to break apart.

FamilyUnfriendlyDeath.name: Family-Unfriendly Death
FamilyUnfriendlyDeath.def: When children's media shows someone dying in an unexpectedly gruesome way. Often combined with Family-Unfriendly Violence .

TheFamine.name: The Famine
TheFamine.def: Mass deaths by starvation resulting from a severe food shortage, often caused by drought-induced crop failures.

FastKillingRadiation.name: Fast-Killing Radiation
FastKillingRadiation.def: Nuclear radiation killing people faster than what is possible in real life.

FatalFamilyPhoto.name: Fatal Family Photo
FatalFamilyPhoto.def: Death happens after showing photo of relatives.

FatalMacGuffin.name: Fatal MacGuffin
FatalMacGuffin.def: A MacGuffin object which kills anyone who dares to touch or use it.

FatalMethodActing.name: Fatal Method Acting
FatalMethodActing.def: A performer dies suddenly during their performance.

FatalReward.name: Fatal Reward
FatalReward.def: A person's promised reward for doing as they've been asked turns out to be death.

FauxDeath.name: Faux Death
FauxDeath.def: A person goes through a death-like state to recover.

FearTheReaper.name: Fear the Reaper
FearTheReaper.def: Death is personified as a malicious or hostile force.

FedToPigs.name: Fed to Pigs
FedToPigs.def: Bodies are eliminated by feeding them to pigs.

FellAsleepDriving.name: Fell Asleep Driving
FellAsleepDriving.def: A person who does this has a strong chance of serious consequences, including death.

AFeteWorseThanDeath.name: A Fête Worse than Death
AFeteWorseThanDeath.def: A party or festival is held as an excuse to kill somebody.

FictionalizedDeathAccount.name: Fictionalized Death Account
FictionalizedDeathAccount.def: A work of fiction changes how a real person died.

FieldOfBlades.name: Field of Blades
FieldOfBlades.def: Swords stuck in the ground to represent the casualties of a war.

FinalExchange.name: Final Exchange
FinalExchange.def: Replying to another person's last words before they die.

FinalFirstHug.name: Final First Hug
FinalFirstHug.def: A normally stoic father who is expecting to die hugs his child for the first and last time before he does.

FinallyFoundTheBody.name: Finally Found the Body
FinallyFoundTheBody.def: After it's assumed for a long time that a person may have survived their apparent death, it's discovered that they really did die after all.

FinalSolution.name: Final Solution
FinalSolution.def: Genocidal massacres committed in an attempt to exterminate an entire group of people.

FingerInTheMail.name: Finger in the Mail
FingerInTheMail.def: Sending someone dismembered body parts of their loved one to show you've killed them.

FinishHim.name: Finish Him!
FinishHim.def: A fighter is forced to kill their opponent.

FirstEpisodeResurrection.name: First-Episode Resurrection
FirstEpisodeResurrection.def: The story begins with the main character being brought back to life.

FirstLawOfResurrection.name: First Law of Resurrection
FirstLawOfResurrection.def: A character that's been killed off will come back as long as the writer intends to bring them back.

FirstPersonDyingPerspective.name: First-Person Dying Perspective
FirstPersonDyingPerspective.def: A character dies. The last moments are seen from their POV.

Flatline.name: Flatline
Flatline.def: Monitor line going flat means the patient is done for.

FlatlinePlotline.name: Flatline Plotline
FlatlinePlotline.def: Temporary death caused by slowing down heart rate.

FoldSpindleMutilation.name: Fold-Spindle Mutilation
FoldSpindleMutilation.def: Killing someone by forcing them through an opening they can't fit in.

FondMemoriesThatCouldHaveBeen.name: Fond Memories That Could Have Been
FondMemoriesThatCouldHaveBeen.def: Mourning someone because you could've had a great life with them.

ForcedMiscarriage.name: Forced Miscarriage
ForcedMiscarriage.def: A pregnant character is forced to miscarry without their consent.

ForcedStarvation.name: Forced Starvation
ForcedStarvation.def: A person is forcefully starved, sometimes to death.

ForebodingCarcass.name: Foreboding Carcass
ForebodingCarcass.def: A dead animal foreshadows that danger (and often death) are coming for the protagonists.

ForgotToFeedTheMonster.name: Forgot to Feed the Monster
ForgotToFeedTheMonster.def: The villain attempts to summon minions or a beast, only to find that they died because he neglected to feed them.

FossilRevival.name: Fossil Revival
FossilRevival.def: Dead creatures are revived by reanimating their fossils.

FourIsDeath.name: Four Is Death
FourIsDeath.def: Four sounds "death" in Asian languages, and its disaster consequences (usually about dying).

FriendlyTarget.name: Friendly Target
FriendlyTarget.def: Those close to the hero end up targeted by the villain.

FrightDeathtrap.name: Fright Deathtrap
FrightDeathtrap.def: Literally scaring the victim to death.

TheFunInFuneral.name: The "Fun" in "Funeral"
TheFunInFuneral.def: Wacky antics happen during a person's funeral.

FuneralBanishment.name: Funeral Banishment
FuneralBanishment.def: Someone is banned from attending a deceased person's funeral, either by a relative or the dead person themselves prior to their passing.

FuneralCut.name: Funeral Cut
FuneralCut.def: The scene cuts to a funeral or something tied to one in order to set the gravity or what's happened or to make a Black Comedy gag.

GameOfChicken.name: Game of Chicken
GameOfChicken.def: Two vehicles drive toward each other and the first to turn away from the ensuing collision loses.

GasChamber.name: Gas Chamber
GasChamber.def: A sealed room where poison gas is sprayed to kill anyone inside.

GasolineDousing.name: Gasoline Dousing
GasolineDousing.def: Someone gets gasoline poured on them before being set ablaze.

GayGuyDiesFirst.name: Gay Guy Dies First
GayGuyDiesFirst.def: A gay man is the first murder victim.

GayngstInducedSuicide.name: Gayngst-Induced Suicide
GayngstInducedSuicide.def: A gay person commits suicide over feeling ashamed of their sexual orientation.

GetItOverWith.name: Get It Over With
GetItOverWith.def: A person dares their killer to get on with killing them.

GhostlyDeathReveal.name: Ghostly Death Reveal
GhostlyDeathReveal.def: An offscreen death is revealed by the character's appearance as a ghost later on.

GhostReunionEnding.name: Ghost Reunion Ending
GhostReunionEnding.def: The dead return in the ending as ghosts.

GloriousDeath.name: Glorious Death
GloriousDeath.def: A character has a favorite way to die.

GoingHomeForTheDisaster.name: Going Home for the Disaster
GoingHomeForTheDisaster.def: Death is incoming. The only thing to do under these circumstances is to go home.

GoIntoTheLight.name: Go into the Light
GoIntoTheLight.def: While dying, there will be a light to walk into in order to enter the afterlife.

GoodNightSweetPrince.name: Good Night, Sweet Prince
GoodNightSweetPrince.def: Saying "Goodnight, sweet prince" in response to a man dying.

AGoodWayToDie.name: A Good Way to Die
AGoodWayToDie.def: Character dies the way they wanted to die.

GoryDiscretionShot.name: Gory Discretion Shot
GoryDiscretionShot.def: When a person gets killed in a gruesome manner, the gory details aren't shown on-screen.

GreatWayToGo.name: Great Way to Go
GreatWayToGo.def: Commenting that a cause of death is how you would like to die.

GriefInducedSplit.name: Grief-Induced Split
GriefInducedSplit.def: A couple breaks up after a tragedy, usually a death.

GriefMakesYouCrazy.name: Grief Makes You Crazy
GriefMakesYouCrazy.def: Someone loses their mind after losing a loved one.

GriefSong.name: Grief Song
GriefSong.def: A musical piece about someone mourning the death of a loved one.

GroundByGears.name: Ground by Gears
GroundByGears.def: Getting killed by gears crushing you.

GutBuster.name: Gut Buster
GutBuster.def: Someone's belly or torso splits open, often leading to disembowelment and death.

GuttedLikeAFish.name: Gutted Like a Fish
GuttedLikeAFish.def: Killing someone by cutting their stomach open.

HalfTheManHeUsedToBe.name: Half the Man He Used to Be
HalfTheManHeUsedToBe.def: Killing someone by cutting the victim in half.

HammerHilt.name: Hammer Hilt
HammerHilt.def: Killing someone with the hilt of a sword or similar bladed weapon.

HandSlidingDownTheGlass.name: Hand Sliding Down the Glass
HandSlidingDownTheGlass.def: A dying person's hand slides down a window pane.

HangingAround.name: Hanging Around
HangingAround.def: Suspending someone by their neck with a noose to the point of death.

HangingUpOnTheGrimReaper.name: Hanging Up on the Grim Reaper
HangingUpOnTheGrimReaper.def: When the Grim Reaper shows up to claim someone, the person persuades Death to let them live just a little bit longer.

HappierHomeMovie.name: Happier Home Movie
HappierHomeMovie.def: Watching home movies of or having pleasant dreams about the departed to reflect on the good times you had with them.

HappilyFailedSuicide.name: Happily Failed Suicide
HappilyFailedSuicide.def: A failed attempt to commit suicide causes the character to rekindle their will to live.

HatsOffToTheDead.name: Hats Off to the Dead
HatsOffToTheDead.def: Respecting the dead by removing your hat.

HaveANiceDeath.name: Have a Nice Death
HaveANiceDeath.def: When the player character dies, the video games plays their demise for laughs.

HeadCrushing.name: Head Crushing
HeadCrushing.def: Killing someone by crushing their head.

HeadInOvenSuicide.name: "Head in Oven" Suicide
HeadInOvenSuicide.def: Committing suicide with help of a gas oven.

HeHadAName.name: He Had a Name
HeHadAName.def: Villain dismisses someone they killed as an inconsequential casualty. Hero emphasizes their anger by pointing out that their fallen friend had a name.

HeKnowsTooMuch.name: He Knows Too Much
HeKnowsTooMuch.def: Killing someone because they've learned about something they can't be allowed to make public knowledge.

HelplessKicking.name: Helpless Kicking
HelplessKicking.def: Someone kicking their legs as they're being Eaten Alive killed or carried off to their doom.

HelplessWindowDeath.name: Helpless Window Death
HelplessWindowDeath.def: Someone dies behind a window while the protagonist can do nothing but watch.

HerHeartWillGoOn.name: Her Heart Will Go On
HerHeartWillGoOn.def: When a person's love interest dies, they don't let their death keep them from finding someone else to love.

TheHeroDoesntKillTheVillainess.name: The Hero Doesn't Kill the Villainess
TheHeroDoesntKillTheVillainess.def: Female villains aren't killed by the hero, either because they survive, the hero spares them or someone else kills them. Their male counterparts aren't so lucky.

HeroicSacrifice.name: Heroic Sacrifice
HeroicSacrifice.def: Someone allows themselves to get killed in order to save others.

HesitantSacrifice.name: Hesitant Sacrifice
HesitantSacrifice.def: When having to give their own life for the greater good, the person in question gets emotional about having to die.

HesDeadJim.name: He's Dead, Jim
HesDeadJim.def: There are easy signs to determine whether or not a person is dead.

HesJustHiding.name: He's Just Hiding
HesJustHiding.def: Fans refuse to accept that a character is dead.

HighAltitudeHomicide.name: High-Altitude Homicide
HighAltitudeHomicide.def: Death by being dropped from a great heigth.

HisNameIs.name: His Name Is...
HisNameIs.def: A character dies before they can reveal crucial information.

HoistByHisOwnPetard.name: Hoist by His Own Petard
HoistByHisOwnPetard.def: Someone is killed by what was supposed to be helping them.

HollywoodHeartAttack.name: Hollywood Heart Attack
HollywoodHeartAttack.def: Media portrays heart attack-induced deaths as dramatic.

HonorableWarriorsDeath.name: Honorable Warrior's Death
HonorableWarriorsDeath.def: A warrior attempts to die in battle or by using some method considered worthy of a warrior in their culture.

HorrorHatesARulebreaker.name: Horror Hates a Rulebreaker
HorrorHatesARulebreaker.def: The moment you break unspoken rules, the supernatural will kill you.

HospitalSurprise.name: Hospital Surprise
HospitalSurprise.def: Character finds out they're in a hospital after going through a life-threatening situation.

HowDareYouDieOnMe.name: How Dare You Die on Me!
HowDareYouDieOnMe.def: Character gets angry about a person dying because they didn't want them to die.

HowWouldYouLikeToDie.name: How Would You Like to Die?
HowWouldYouLikeToDie.def: Character is offered multiple choices on how they will die.

HumanHeadOnTheWall.name: Human Head on the Wall
HumanHeadOnTheWall.def: Mounting the head of someone you killed on the wall.

HumanitysWake.name: Humanity's Wake
HumanitysWake.def: The story takes place after humanity has gone extinct.

HuntingAccident.name: Hunting "Accident"
HuntingAccident.def: Bringing someone on a hunting trip and getting away with killing them by claiming they were mistaken for the animal being hunted.

ICannotSelfTerminate.name: I Cannot Self-Terminate
ICannotSelfTerminate.def: A suicidal person begs others to kill them because they can't do it themselves.

IdentifyingTheBody.name: Identifying the Body
IdentifyingTheBody.def: A relative is asked to identify a body as confirmation of the deceased's identity.

IDidntMeanToKillHim.name: I Didn't Mean to Kill Him
IDidntMeanToKillHim.def: When the guilty party claims (honestly or not) that their killing was accidental.

IDieFree.name: I Die Free
IDieFree.def: Someone is content with dying because in death, they're no longer enslaved.

IfICantHaveYou.name: If I Can't Have You…
IfICantHaveYou.def: Killing someone you're attracted to just because they refuse to return your affections or have gone with someone else.

IfWeGetThroughThis.name: If We Get Through This…
IfWeGetThroughThis.def: Characters agree to do something if they survive their current predicament.

IfYouDieICallYourStuff.name: If You Die, I Call Your Stuff
IfYouDieICallYourStuff.def: People claiming other people's stuff in the event that the person might die.

ILetGwenStacyDie.name: I Let Gwen Stacy Die
ILetGwenStacyDie.def: Hero blames themselves for not being able to prevent a loved one's death.

ImColdSoCold.name: I'm Cold... So Cold...
ImColdSoCold.def: Character comments that they feel cold as they're dying.

ImDyingPleaseTakeMyMacGuffin.name: I'm Dying, Please Take My MacGuffin
ImDyingPleaseTakeMyMacGuffin.def: A dying person gives an important object to someone else before they die.

ImpaledWithExtremePrejudice.name: Impaled with Extreme Prejudice
ImpaledWithExtremePrejudice.def: Death by being impaled upon something.

ImpliedDeathThreat.name: Implied Death Threat
ImpliedDeathThreat.def: Making an indirect threat to kill someone.

ImprobableInfantSurvival.name: Improbable Infant Survival
ImprobableInfantSurvival.def: Showing older people dying is okay, but the work completely avoids having children get killed.

IncurableCoughOfDeath.name: Incurable Cough of Death
IncurableCoughOfDeath.def: When a person is constantly coughing, it means they're about to die.

InertialImpalement.name: Inertial Impalement
InertialImpalement.def: Victim is stabbed by moving into a stationary blade.

InferredSurvival.name: Inferred Survival
InferredSurvival.def: A character's death is deliberately left ambiguous so that the writers can later establish that the character somehow survived.

InformalEulogy.name: Informal Eulogy
InformalEulogy.def: Only having a brief sentence to say about the deceased.

InhumanHuman.name: Inhuman Human
InhumanHuman.def: The resurrected's soul is fine, but the body is not human.

InMemoriam.name: In Memoriam
InMemoriam.def: The work features a dedication to someone who died before the work was released.

InspirationalMartyr.name: Inspirational Martyr
InspirationalMartyr.def: By dying, a person rallies more to their cause.

InstantDeathBullet.name: Instant Death Bullet
InstantDeathBullet.def: Shooting one bullet is enough to kill someone.

InstantDeathStab.name: Instant Death Stab
InstantDeathStab.def: Being struck with a bladed weapon will kill someone instantly.

InstantFishKill.name: Instant Fish Kill
InstantFishKill.def: Large amounts of fish immediately die when something happens to the water around them.

InstantGravestone.name: Instant Gravestone
InstantGravestone.def: When someone dies, they turn into a tombstone on the spot.

InternalDeathSquad.name: Internal Death Squad
InternalDeathSquad.def: A position or unit within a larger organization tasked with tracking down and executing its own rogue or unreliable members.

InterrogatingTheDead.name: Interrogating the Dead
InterrogatingTheDead.def: Getting information by interrogating dead people.

InTheBack.name: In the Back
InTheBack.def: Stabbing or shooting someone from behind.

InverseDialogueDeathRule.name: Inverse Dialogue/Death Rule
InverseDialogueDeathRule.def: A dying, important character gets several lines of dialogue before kicking it.

InvoluntaryBattleToTheDeath.name: Involuntary Battle to the Death
InvoluntaryBattleToTheDeath.def: Two friends are forced into a fight to the death.

InvoluntarySuicideMechanism.name: Involuntary Suicide Mechanism
InvoluntarySuicideMechanism.def: A person is wired so that they die when someone tries to get them to reveal confidential information.

IronicLastWords.name: Ironic Last Words
IronicLastWords.def: The last thing a person says carries some form of irony.

ItAlwaysRainsAtFunerals.name: It Always Rains at Funerals
ItAlwaysRainsAtFunerals.def: It rains during a funeral service.

ItIsNotYourTime.name: It Is Not Your Time
ItIsNotYourTime.def: A dead person is allowed to come to life again because the afterlife isn't ready for them yet.

ItsAlwaysSunnyAtFunerals.name: It's Always Sunny at Funerals
ItsAlwaysSunnyAtFunerals.def: Funeral takes place during incongruously pleasant weather.

ItsAWonderfulFailure.name: It's a Wonderful Failure
ItsAWonderfulFailure.def: A Game Over screen shows the horrifying death of a player character.

IWillOnlySlowYouDown.name: I Will Only Slow You Down
IWillOnlySlowYouDown.def: A person insists to be left to die on the grounds that the person trying to save them would only be hindered in doing so.

IWishedYouWereDead.name: I Wished You Were Dead
IWishedYouWereDead.def: A character who wishes for another to die feels guilty for their wish when the death actually happens.

JacobMarleyApparel.name: Jacob Marley Apparel
JacobMarleyApparel.def: The ghost's wardrobe matches what they wore when they died.

JoinOrDie.name: Join or Die
JoinOrDie.def: If you don't agree to join this person's side, they'll kill you.

JokerImmunity.name: Joker Immunity
JokerImmunity.def: The villain always comes back to fight the hero again, even when they were killed in the last fight.

JokerImmunityWarranty.name: Joker Immunity Warranty
JokerImmunityWarranty.def: A villain who comes back from death at least once is done in for good and doesn’t come back.

JudgementOfTheDead.name: Judgement of the Dead
JudgementOfTheDead.def: A judge appears to evaluate the dead person's life before deciding their ultimate fate.

JumpingOnAGrenade.name: Jumping on a Grenade
JumpingOnAGrenade.def: Person sacrifices themselves by deliberately jumping onto a grenade.

JustDesserts.name: Just Desserts
JustDesserts.def: Villain gets their comeuppance by being eaten alive.

KarmicDeath.name: Karmic Death
KarmicDeath.def: A bad person dies in a way that serves as a fitting punishment for their wrongdoings .

KilledByRequest.name: Killed by Request
KilledByRequest.def: An actor asks for the character they play to be killed off so they don't have to play the role anymore.

KilledMidSentence.name: Killed Mid-Sentence
KilledMidSentence.def: Someone is killed before they can finish their sentence.

KilledOffForReal.name: Killed Off for Real
KilledOffForReal.def: A character is permanently killed off in a setting where resurrections are possible.

KilledOffScreen.name: Killed Offscreen
KilledOffScreen.def: A character is established as having been killed after the last time they were shown on-screen.

KilledToUpholdTheMasquerade.name: Killed to Uphold the Masquerade
KilledToUpholdTheMasquerade.def: Someone is killed to prevent them from exposing the existence of supernatural beings.

TheKillerBecomesTheKilled.name: The Killer Becomes the Killed
TheKillerBecomesTheKilled.def: A murderer is killed by someone else.

KillerEntranceExam.name: Killer Entrance Exam
KillerEntranceExam.def: When an admission test can literally kill you.

KillerFinale.name: Killer Finale
KillerFinale.def: The final installment of a work kills off at least one main character.

KillerOutfit.name: Killer Outfit
KillerOutfit.def: Someone is killed by their own wardrobe.

KillHimAlready.name: Kill Him Already!
KillHimAlready.def: Hero's ally demands he kill the villain already.

KillingForATissueSample.name: Killing for a Tissue Sample
KillingForATissueSample.def: A medical anomaly or supernatural curio needs to be killed in order to study its biology.

KillingInSelfDefense.name: Killing in Self-Defense
KillingInSelfDefense.def: It's okay to kill someone if they were going to kill you first.

KillingYourAlternateSelf.name: Killing Your Alternate Self
KillingYourAlternateSelf.def: A person kills their counterpart from an alternate reality.

KillItThroughItsStomach.name: Kill It Through Its Stomach
KillItThroughItsStomach.def: Getting out of a creature that swallowed you whole by stabbing your way out of their stomach.

KillItWithFire.name: Kill It with Fire
KillItWithFire.def: Death by fire or burning heat.

KillItWithIce.name: Kill It with Ice
KillItWithIce.def: Death by ice or freezing cold.

KillOneOthersGetStronger.name: Kill One, Others Get Stronger
KillOneOthersGetStronger.def: Killing one member of a group makes the surviving members more powerful.

KillOnSight.name: Kill on Sight
KillOnSight.def: Orders are given for a person or group to be killed the instant they're spotted.

KillSteal.name: Kill Steal
KillSteal.def: Killing something just when somebody else was going to do the same.

KillTheBrainwashed.name: Kill the Brainwashed
KillTheBrainwashed.def: A brainwashed character is killed off, usually so they don't have to suffer anymore.

KillTheCutie.name: Kill the Cutie
KillTheCutie.def: A sweet, lovable character is killed off.

KillTheOnesYouLove.name: Kill the Ones You Love
KillTheOnesYouLove.def: Someone is put in a situation where they have to kill someone near and dear to them.

KillTheParentRaiseTheChild.name: Kill the Parent, Raise the Child
KillTheParentRaiseTheChild.def: A character looks after the child of someone they killed.

KillThePoor.name: Kill the Poor
KillThePoor.def: Attempting to eliminate poverty by killing the destitute.

KillUsBoth.name: Kill Us Both
KillUsBoth.def: Hero trying to keep the villain down insists that the only way is for both him and the villain to be killed.

KingInTheMountain.name: King in the Mountain
KingInTheMountain.def: A legendary figure is believed to be in hibernation rather than dead.

KingOnHisDeathbed.name: King on His Deathbed
KingOnHisDeathbed.def: Story begins with a ruler dying.

TheKingslayer.name: The Kingslayer
TheKingslayer.def: Someone who kills a king or other person in position of leadership.

KlingonPromotion.name: Klingon Promotion
KlingonPromotion.def: Someone gains a position or title by killing the last person who possessed it.

KneeFoldFallOfDefeat.name: Knee Fold Fall of Defeat
KneeFoldFallOfDefeat.def: Fatally wounded character falls to his knees then dies landing face first on the ground.

LastBreathBullet.name: Last Breath Bullet
LastBreathBullet.def: Villain thought killed turns out to have enough life left in them to do one bad deed before dying for real.

LastDayToLive.name: Last Day to Live
LastDayToLive.def: Character is informed they don't have much time left, but in reality they're in perfect health.

TheLastDance.name: The Last Dance
TheLastDance.def: Character decides that if they're going to die, they may as well go down fighting.

LastDisrespects.name: Last Disrespects
LastDisrespects.def: A funeral service where the attendees aren't very respectful to the deceased.

LastGraspAtLife.name: Last Grasp at Life
LastGraspAtLife.def: Dying person reaches out in an attempt to grab something to save them.

LastKiss.name: Last Kiss
LastKiss.def: Lovers exchange one more kiss before one or both of them die.

LastMomentTogether.name: Last Moment Together
LastMomentTogether.def: Focus is given to the last interaction between two loved ones before one of them dies or they are otherwise forever separated.

LastRequest.name: Last Request
LastRequest.def: Dying person asks for one last request before they die.

LastStand.name: Last Stand
LastStand.def: Someone kills as many enemies as they can before they die.

LastSurvivorSuicide.name: Last Survivor Suicide
LastSurvivorSuicide.def: Someone kills themselves over being upset at being the last one left alive.

LastWishMarriage.name: Last Wish Marriage
LastWishMarriage.def: A dying character opts to get married while they still live.

LeaveBehindAPistol.name: Leave Behind a Pistol
LeaveBehindAPistol.def: Leaving a pistol in hopes that the person left with it will use it to commit suicide.

LeaveNoSurvivors.name: Leave No Survivors
LeaveNoSurvivors.def: The killer refuses to leave anyone in their path alive.

LeaveNoWitnesses.name: Leave No Witnesses
LeaveNoWitnesses.def: Avoiding getting caught for a crime by murdering everyone who's seen you do it.

LeftForDead.name: Left for Dead
LeftForDead.def: A person turns out to be alive after it was assumed they were left to die.

LegacyImmortality.name: Legacy Immortality
LegacyImmortality.def: A hero thought killed continues living by way of other people taking up the identity after the previous person meets their end.

LegallyDead.name: Legally Dead
LegallyDead.def: Someone is legally declared deceased on the basis that they've gone missing and no one's heard from them in a long time.

LeitmotifUponDeath.name: Leitmotif upon Death
LeitmotifUponDeath.def: A character's death triggers their Leitmotif being played to make their death sadder.

LethallyBadDiet.name: Lethally Bad Diet
LethallyBadDiet.def: A character dies or nearly dies because of unhealthy eating habits.

LibationForTheDead.name: Libation for the Dead
LibationForTheDead.def: Pouring a drink on the ground to honor the deceased.

LifeDeathJuxtaposition.name: Life/Death Juxtaposition
LifeDeathJuxtaposition.def: A life motif is juxtaposed against a death motif in some way.

LifeInsuranceSuicide.name: Life Insurance Suicide
LifeInsuranceSuicide.def: A character kills themselves so their life insurance beneficiary will receive a payout.

LightsOffSomebodyDies.name: Lights Off, Somebody Dies
LightsOffSomebodyDies.def: Someone is found dead after the lights go off and come back on.

LikeYouWereDying.name: Like You Were Dying
LikeYouWereDying.def: A character radically changes their behavior because they're dying.

LikeYouWouldReallyDoIt.name: Like You Would Really Do It
LikeYouWouldReallyDoIt.def: Because of the character's importance, the audience refuses to believe that the character will actually die, which ruins the suspense of teasing that they might die.

LiteralHeroWorship.name: Literal Hero Worship
LiteralHeroWorship.def: The religious practice of worshipping heroes, usually ones who are deceased.

LiteralSplittingHeadache.name: Literal Splitting Headache
LiteralSplittingHeadache.def: Death by the head being split open.

LiterallyApoplectic.name: Literally Apoplectic
LiterallyApoplectic.def: A person is so overwhelmed by emotion that they die (or fall ill).

LiterallyShatteredLives.name: Literally Shattered Lives
LiterallyShatteredLives.def: A person frozen solid or Taken for Granite is killed when they break into pieces.

LittleDeadRidingHood.name: Little Dead Riding Hood
LittleDeadRidingHood.def: Girl clad in red is at risk of dying.

TheLivingDead.name: The Living Dead
TheLivingDead.def: A living person pretends to be a corpse.

LivingOnBorrowedTime.name: Living on Borrowed Time
LivingOnBorrowedTime.def: Character uses artificial means to prolong their life.

LoadBearingHero.name: Load-Bearing Hero
LoadBearingHero.def: Hero has to hold up a weight to prevent it from crushing them and others to death.

LonelyFuneral.name: Lonely Funeral
LonelyFuneral.def: Very few people attend the deceased's funeral.

LongDeadBadass.name: Long-Dead Badass
LongDeadBadass.def: Characters talk about an awesome warrior or hero who is long dead.

LookBothWays.name: Look Both Ways
LookBothWays.def: Someone gets killed by crossing the street without looking both ways.

LosingTheTeamSpirit.name: Losing the Team Spirit
LosingTheTeamSpirit.def: Team falls into depression over someone's death.

LostAtSea.name: Lost at Sea
LostAtSea.def: A character or group of characters are considered stranded at sea without hope of food, water or rescue, or have drowned in the sea.

LostPetGrievance.name: Lost Pet Grievance
LostPetGrievance.def: A character feels upset about the death of their beloved pet.

TheLostLenore.name: The Lost Lenore
TheLostLenore.def: A character feels sorrow about the death of their love interest.

LoveInterestApotheosis.name: Love Interest Apotheosis
LoveInterestApotheosis.def: A character's romantic partner transforms into a spiritual or ethereal entity, thus ending their mortal existence.

LudicrousGibs.name: Ludicrous Gibs
LudicrousGibs.def: Someone explodes into bloody giblets everywhere when they die.

MadeOfPlasticine.name: Made of Plasticine
MadeOfPlasticine.def: Someone is ridiculously easy to kill by tearing apart.

MainCharacterFinalBoss.name: Main Character Final Boss
MainCharacterFinalBoss.def: The main protagonist also plays the role of final boss and in some cases ends up dead as a result.

MakeItLookLikeAnAccident.name: Make It Look Like an Accident
MakeItLookLikeAnAccident.def: A murder is made to look like an accidental death.

MakeSureHesDead.name: Make Sure He's Dead
MakeSureHesDead.def: When there's a chance that someone may have survived their apparent death, the villain decides to make sure their victim is dead for sure.

ManInTheMachine.name: Man in the Machine
ManInTheMachine.def: A cyborg whose mechanical parts may as well be glorified life support systems.

TheManyDeathsOfYou.name: The Many Deaths of You
TheManyDeathsOfYou.def: When Interactive Fiction contains a wide range of ways to meet one's demise.

MarkedToDie.name: Marked to Die
MarkedToDie.def: Someone has a marking on them to indicate that they'll get killed.

MaternalDeathBlameTheChild.name: Maternal Death? Blame the Child!
MaternalDeathBlameTheChild.def: If a woman dies giving birth, the child will be blamed for causing the mother's death.

Matricide.name: Matricide
Matricide.def: A mother is killed by her child.

MatterOfLifeAndDeath.name: Matter of Life and Death
MatterOfLifeAndDeath.def: Trying to reason with those obstructing you on the grounds that they'll be indirectly responsible for lives being lost if they don't get out of your way.

MeaningfulFuneral.name: Meaningful Funeral
MeaningfulFuneral.def: Character's funeral brings out things about them and their mourners that wouldn't have come up otherwise.

MemorialCharacter.name: Memorial Character
MemorialCharacter.def: A character in a work is based on or named for a real person who died, as a way of immortalizing that person.

MemorialForTheAntagonist.name: Memorial for the Antagonist
MemorialForTheAntagonist.def: Offering a funeral service for the deceased villain out of respect or honor, despite their atrocities.

MemorialPhoto.name: Memorial Photo
MemorialPhoto.def: The deceased has a photo of them when they were alive shown during the funeral service.

MenAreTheExpendableGender.name: Men Are the Expendable Gender
MenAreTheExpendableGender.def: The work portrays male death and suffering as less important than female death and suffering.

MentorOccupationalHazard.name: Mentor Occupational Hazard
MentorOccupationalHazard.def: Being the hero's mentor means that you're going to die.

MercyKill.name: Mercy Kill
MercyKill.def: Killing someone because the alternative would be to let them suffer.

MicrowaveTheDog.name: Microwave the Dog
MicrowaveTheDog.def: A pet is killed in the microwave.

MilesToGoBeforeISleep.name: Miles to Go Before I Sleep
MilesToGoBeforeISleep.def: Character refuses to die until they've accomplished their important mission.

AMillionIsAStatistic.name: A Million Is a Statistic
AMillionIsAStatistic.def: The death of a single identified person is treated as more important than those of countless unidentified people.

MindReformatDeath.name: Mind-Reformat Death
MindReformatDeath.def: When a character, AI or human, dies because of an electronic plot device erasing, replacing, changing, or overwriting their minds.

MisplacedSorrow.name: Misplaced Sorrow
MisplacedSorrow.def: Character is upset about someone dying for selfish reasons.

MissingManFormation.name: Missing Man Formation
MissingManFormation.def: A ceremonial incomplete formation done to honor a dead teammate.

MistakenDeathConfirmation.name: Mistaken Death Confirmation
MistakenDeathConfirmation.def: A character's death is confirmed by examination of the body or sure-fire evidence, but this turns out to be wrong.

MistakenForAfterlife.name: Mistaken for Afterlife
MistakenForAfterlife.def: Someone thinks they have died and gone to an afterlife.

MistakenForDying.name: Mistaken for Dying
MistakenForDying.def: Someone is thought to be dying when they're in perfect health or only suffering from a minor ailment.

MockingTheMourner.name: Mocking the Mourner
MockingTheMourner.def: A character uses another character's loss as a means to deride or harangue them.

AMoltenDateWithDeath.name: A Molten Date with Death
AMoltenDateWithDeath.def: Death by submergence or exposure to lava.

MomentOfSilence.name: Moment of Silence
MomentOfSilence.def: Scene becomes quiet when a character dies.

MonsterFromBeyondTheVeil.name: Monster from Beyond the Veil
MonsterFromBeyondTheVeil.def: The resurrected becomes a monster, usually a zombie.

MonsterMisogyny.name: Monster Misogyny
MonsterMisogyny.def: Movie monsters tend to only kill female victims.

TheMoralityMortalityEquation.name: The Morality/Mortality Equation
TheMoralityMortalityEquation.def: Whether or not your loved ones die depends on how evil or good you are.

MoreExpendableThanYou.name: More Expendable Than You
MoreExpendableThanYou.def: In a situation where a member of the group must give their life to the cause, it's agreed that one of them is too important to sacrifice.

MoreHeroThanThou.name: More Hero than Thou
MoreHeroThanThou.def: Characters argue over which of them is worthy of doing the Heroic Sacrifice .

MortalityGreyArea.name: Mortality Grey Area
MortalityGreyArea.def: A character is considered to be neither alive nor dead, or both at once.

MortalityPhobia.name: Mortality Phobia
MortalityPhobia.def: Fear of death motivates them to go to crazy extremes to prevent it.

MortalWoundReveal.name: Mortal Wound Reveal
MortalWoundReveal.def: Someone dies after it turns out they've been mortally wounded.

TheMourningAfter.name: The Mourning After
TheMourningAfter.def: After the love interest dies, the surviving member of the couple refuses to find a new love because they consider it disrespectful to their deceased lover.

MourningADeadRobot.name: Mourning a Dead Robot
MourningADeadRobot.def: A robot dies or is destroyed, and is mourned by its organic counterparts.

MourningAnObject.name: Mourning an Object
MourningAnObject.def: An inanimate object is destroyed, goes missing, or stops working, and is treated by the characters as though it has died.

MovingBeyondBereavement.name: Moving Beyond Bereavement
MovingBeyondBereavement.def: A character arc in which the death of a loved one must eventually be accepted.

MultipleGunshotDeath.name: Multiple Gunshot Death
MultipleGunshotDeath.def: Someone is killed from getting shot multiple times.

MurderDotCom.name: murder.com
MurderDotCom.def: A video of someone getting killed is uploaded on the Internet.

MurderByArson.name: Murder by Arson
MurderByArson.def: Killing someone by setting fire to a building they're in.

MurderByCremation.name: Murder by Cremation
MurderByCremation.def: Killing someone by burning them inside a crematory oven. See Cooked to Death for ordinary kitchen ovens.

MurderByMistake.name: Murder by Mistake
MurderByMistake.def: When someone ends up killing the wrong person, instead of their intended victim.

MurderByInaction.name: Murder by Inaction
MurderByInaction.def: Killing someone indirectly by refusing to save their life.

MurderBySuicide.name: Murder by Suicide
MurderBySuicide.def: Killing someone indirectly by forcing them to kill themselves.

MurderousMask.name: Murderous Mask
MurderousMask.def: A mask that kills the wearer.

MurderSuicide.name: Murder-Suicide
MurderSuicide.def: Someone kills another person before killing themselves.

MutualKill.name: Mutual Kill
MutualKill.def: Two opponents kill each other at the same time.

MyDeathIsJustTheBeginning.name: My Death Is Just the Beginning
MyDeathIsJustTheBeginning.def: Villain lets themselves die so their plan may continue.

MyLifeFlashedBeforeMyEyes.name: My Life Flashed Before My Eyes
MyLifeFlashedBeforeMyEyes.def: While dying or almost dying, a person sees flashbacks of their entire life.

NearDeathExperience.name: Near-Death Experience
NearDeathExperience.def: Unusual experiences that a character who recovers from almost dying is subject to, often of an afterlife.

NeckSnap.name: Neck Snap
NeckSnap.def: Killing someone by twisting and breaking their neck hard enough to sever their spinal cord.

NecroCam.name: Necro Cam
NecroCam.def: A Flashback-Montage Realization about how a character died.

NecroNonSequitur.name: Necro Non Sequitur
NecroNonSequitur.def: Character dies suddenly for no logical reason.

NegateYourOwnSacrifice.name: Negate Your Own Sacrifice
NegateYourOwnSacrifice.def: You can risk sacrificing yourself if you can't really get killed.

NeverFoundTheBody.name: Never Found the Body
NeverFoundTheBody.def: A supposedly dead person is speculated to have survived their apparent death because their corpse was never found.

NeverGotToSayGoodbye.name: Never Got to Say Goodbye
NeverGotToSayGoodbye.def: Character is upset about a loved one's death because they never had the change to say goodbye before their demise.

NeverOneMurder.name: Never One Murder
NeverOneMurder.def: If there's a murder mystery to solve, it's rare for there to only be one victim.

NeverSayDie.name: Never Say "Die"
NeverSayDie.def: The work avoids directly mentioning death.

NeverSayGoodbye.name: Never Say Goodbye
NeverSayGoodbye.def: Refusing to let another person say goodbye to keep departing from being more painful than it already is.

NeverSpeakIllOfTheDead.name: Never Speak Ill of the Dead
NeverSpeakIllOfTheDead.def: Person never stoops to saying negative things about the deceased.

NeverSuicide.name: Never Suicide
NeverSuicide.def: Covering up a murder by forging evidence the death was a suicide.

NightSwimEqualsDeath.name: Night Swim Equals Death
NightSwimEqualsDeath.def: Character swimming at night gets killed.

NobodyCanDie.name: Nobody Can Die
NobodyCanDie.def: No matter the stakes, no one in this work will ever be killed off.

NoDeadBodyPoops.name: No Dead Body Poops
NoDeadBodyPoops.def: When fiction glosses over people soiling themselves when they die.

NoLongerWithUs.name: No Longer with Us
NoLongerWithUs.def: A common euphemism for death turns out to be meant literally.

NoPermanenceNoStakes.name: No Permanence, No Stakes
NoPermanenceNoStakes.def: It's difficult to take a story seriously if everyone's been replaced by an expendable duplicate at some point.

NoOneCouldSurviveThat.name: No One Could Survive That!
NoOneCouldSurviveThat.def: Character is shown to survive an event immediately after doubts are cast on their survival.

NooseCatch.name: Noose Catch
NooseCatch.def: A villain dies by falling and snagging onto something that breaks their neck.

NoPartyLikeADonnerParty.name: No Party Like a Donner Party
NoPartyLikeADonnerParty.def: Resorting to cannibalism to prevent starvation.

NostalgiaHeaven.name: Nostalgia Heaven
NostalgiaHeaven.def: The afterlife is a place that meant something special to the dead.

NotAfraidToDie.name: Not Afraid to Die
NotAfraidToDie.def: Character is okay with dying, but not necessarily because they want to die.

NotDeadJustAsleep.name: Not Dead, Just Asleep
NotDeadJustAsleep.def: A sleeping or unconscious character is mistaken for dead.

NotEnoughToBury.name: Not Enough to Bury
NotEnoughToBury.def: All that's left of the person who got killed are bits and pieces.

NotHowImDyingDeclaration.name: "Not How I'm Dying" Declaration
NotHowImDyingDeclaration.def: A character states that there is no way they're going to die to a proposed threat, real or hypothetical.

NotNowWereTooBusyCryingOverYou.name: Not Now, We're Too Busy Crying Over You
NotNowWereTooBusyCryingOverYou.def: Person mourning someone they thought died unknowingly interrupts the person without realizing they're actually alive.

NotQuiteDead.name: Not Quite Dead
NotQuiteDead.def: Character thought to have died turns out to have managed to survive their fatal injuries.

NotQuiteSavedEnough.name: Not Quite Saved Enough
NotQuiteSavedEnough.def: Right when the hero thinks they've won, something happens from out of the blue to render their efforts pointless.

NotSoInvincibleAfterAll.name: Not So Invincible After All
NotSoInvincibleAfterAll.def: Someone thought to be invincible is killed when it turns out they actually are quite vulnerable.

NotTheIllnessThatKilledThem.name: Not the Illness That Killed Them
NotTheIllnessThatKilledThem.def: A terminally ill person dies from something else.

NotTooDeadToSaveTheDay.name: Not Too Dead to Save the Day
NotTooDeadToSaveTheDay.def: "Dead" person comes back to save the day.

TheNothingAfterDeath.name: The Nothing After Death
TheNothingAfterDeath.def: The afterlife is shown to be nothing but an empty void.

NothingLeftToDoButDie.name: Nothing Left to Do but Die
NothingLeftToDoButDie.def: Immortal character kills themselves out of boredom.

ObfuscatingPostmortemWounds.name: Obfuscating Postmortem Wounds
ObfuscatingPostmortemWounds.def: Additional wounds are inflicted on a corpse to mask the true cause of death.

ObiWanMoment.name: Obi-Wan Moment
ObiWanMoment.def: Veteran character embraces their imminent end gracefully.

OffingTheMouth.name: Offing the Mouth
OffingTheMouth.def: Killing someone for making snarky comments.

OhAndXDies.name: Oh, and X Dies
OhAndXDies.def: The author or narrator informs the audience that a character will die.

OminouslyCutTether.name: Ominously Cut Tether
OminouslyCutTether.def: A character's safety line is found, without them attached anymore.

OminousHairLoss.name: Ominous Hair Loss
OminousHairLoss.def: Encroaching baldness is a sign of approaching death... or worse.

OneDeathTwoUndead.name: One Death, Two Undead
OneDeathTwoUndead.def: A dying person splits them into two undead entities.

OneLastSmoke.name: One Last Smoke
OneLastSmoke.def: Character smokes one last time before death.

OneLastSong.name: One Last Song
OneLastSong.def: This song is the last thing you'll hear before you die.

OneTwinMustDie.name: One Twin Must Die
OneTwinMustDie.def: The older members of a family want to kill one of a pair of twins to prevent a curse.

OneWayTrip.name: One-Way Trip
OneWayTrip.def: Character goes through with a plan even though it's likely doing so will kill them.

TheOneWhereEveryoneDies.name: The One Where Everyone Dies
TheOneWhereEveryoneDies.def: Episode of an ongoing series where all or most of the characters have died by the end, but the deaths are then undone.

OnlyEvilCanDie.name: Only Evil Can Die
OnlyEvilCanDie.def: No one dies except the antagonists/bad guys/villains.

OnlyKillableAtHome.name: Only Killable at Home
OnlyKillableAtHome.def: You can die anywhere, but unless you die in your home, you'll be back.

OnlyMostlyDead.name: Only Mostly Dead
OnlyMostlyDead.def: Hero is thought to be dead, but turns out to have gone into a death-like state to recover.

OpeningSceneMurder.name: Opening Scene Murder
OpeningSceneMurder.def: A person is killed in the first scene of a work.

OrderedToDie.name: Ordered to Die
OrderedToDie.def: A person in authority commands their underling to kill themselves.

OurGhostsAreDifferent.name: Our Ghosts Are Different
OurGhostsAreDifferent.def: Ghosts, the souls after death, are portrayed differently in most media.

OurHeroIsDead.name: Our Hero Is Dead
OurHeroIsDead.def: Work ends on a cliffhanger where the protagonist appears to die.

OutOfContinues.name: Out of Continues
OutOfContinues.def: Character who has died repeatedly ends up dying permanently.

OutlivedByYourMeal.name: Outlived by Your Meal
OutlivedByYourMeal.def: The prey somehow lives longer than whatever ate them.

PainlessDeathForAPrice.name: Painless Death for a Price
PainlessDeathForAPrice.def: Someone on death's doorstep is offered a Mercy Kill in exchange for something valuable.

PartingWordsRegret.name: Parting-Words Regret
PartingWordsRegret.def: Someone feels guilty about the last things they said to a loved one before they died.

PartlyCloudyWithAChanceOfDeath.name: Partly Cloudy with a Chance of Death
PartlyCloudyWithAChanceOfDeath.def: The weather gets gloomy when someone dies.

Patricide.name: Patricide
Patricide.def: A father is killed by his own child.

PeacefulInDeath.name: Peaceful in Death
PeacefulInDeath.def: Dead person is shown to be at peace.

Permadeath.name: Permadeath
Permadeath.def: In some video games, the death of the Player Character is permanent; when they die once, it's an instant Game Over with no retries.

PersonalEffectsReveal.name: Personal Effects Reveal
PersonalEffectsReveal.def: Finding out more about a person by going through their belongings after they die.

PhoneCallFromTheDead.name: Phone Call from the Dead
PhoneCallFromTheDead.def: Receiving a phone call from a dead person.

PietaPlagiarism.name: Pietà Plagiarism
PietaPlagiarism.def: A pose where a dead person is carried in the arms of someone grieving them.

PlayerDeathIsDramatic.name: Player Death Is Dramatic
PlayerDeathIsDramatic.def: When the Player Character in a video game gets killed, the Game Over screen makes a big spectacle out of it.

PlayerPunch.name: Player Punch
PlayerPunch.def: Killing someone to make the audience feel upset or angered.

PlayingPossum.name: Playing Possum
PlayingPossum.def: Someone temporarily fakes being a dead body, usually to escape a pursuing enemy or predator.

PleaOfPersonalNecessity.name: Plea of Personal Necessity
PleaOfPersonalNecessity.def: A villain pleads for the hero not to kill them because they still need them.

PleaseDontLeaveMe.name: Please, Don't Leave Me
PleaseDontLeaveMe.def: Dying character begs a loved one not to leave them.

PleaseKillMeIfItSatisfiesYou.name: Please Kill Me If It Satisfies You
PleaseKillMeIfItSatisfiesYou.def: Character gives a person they wronged the offer to kill them so they can be satisfied.

PleaseWakeUp.name: Please Wake Up
PleaseWakeUp.def: Someone believes a dead person to merely be sleeping.

PlotlineDeath.name: Plotline Death
PlotlineDeath.def: Characters in a video game die permanently if the death happens in a cutscene.

ThePlotReaper.name: The Plot Reaper
ThePlotReaper.def: Character dies so they won't stand in the way of the story.

PlotTriggeringDeath.name: Plot-Triggering Death
PlotTriggeringDeath.def: The character dying in the beginning is the reason the story's events happen at all.

PokingDeadThingsWithAStick.name: Poking Dead Things with a Stick
PokingDeadThingsWithAStick.def: Finding a dead body or creature and poking it with a stick.

PopGoesTheHuman.name: "Pop!" Goes the Human
PopGoesTheHuman.def: Person dies from swelling up until they explode into a grisly mess.

PopulationXAndCounting.name: Population: X, and Counting
PopulationXAndCounting.def: A sign of the town's population has the number of people go down as soon as someone dies.

PosedCorpseReveal.name: Posed Corpse Reveal
PosedCorpseReveal.def: A character encounters a person sitting/standing and thinks they are alive, but upon closer inspection they turn out to be dead.

PosthumousCharacter.name: Posthumous Character
PosthumousCharacter.def: A character has already died when the audience first hears of them.

PosthumousCollaboration.name: Posthumous Collaboration
PosthumousCollaboration.def: The creator dies before their work could be finished, but other people do their best to complete the work using whatever material the creator managed to make before they died.

PosthumousCredit.name: Posthumous Credit
PosthumousCredit.def: The work credits someone involved with production who died before the work was released.

PosthumousNarration.name: Posthumous Narration
PosthumousNarration.def: Story is narrated by a character who has already died.

PosthumousSibling.name: Posthumous Sibling
PosthumousSibling.def: A character's older sibling died before they were born.

PosthumousVillainVictory.name: Posthumous Villain Victory
PosthumousVillainVictory.def: Even after the villain dies their goal is ultimately achieved.

PostMortemComeback.name: Post-Mortem Comeback
PostMortemComeback.def: Villain turns out to have prepared a duplicate of themselves to take their place in the event that they die.

PostMortemConversion.name: Post-Mortem Conversion
PostMortemConversion.def: Claiming that a dead person is on your side.

PostMortemMorton.name: Post-Mortem Morton
PostMortemMorton.def: Due to the similarity to the Latin mors , characters with names stemming from "Mort" are associated with death.

PostMortemPossessions.name: Post-Mortem Possessions
PostMortemPossessions.def: Turns out you really can take it with you.

PrecautionaryCorpseDisposal.name: Precautionary Corpse Disposal
PrecautionaryCorpseDisposal.def: A setting or situation where anyone who dies will become a monster, or otherwise dangerous.

PrematureEulogy.name: Premature Eulogy
PrematureEulogy.def: A eulogy is given for a person who is still alive.

PreMortemCatchphrase.name: Pre-Mortem Catchphrase
PreMortemCatchphrase.def: A character dies saying their catchphrase.

PreMortemOneLiner.name: Pre-Mortem One-Liner
PreMortemOneLiner.def: A character taunts their victim before killing them.

PreSacrificeFinalGoodbye.name: Pre-Sacrifice Final Goodbye
PreSacrificeFinalGoodbye.def: Before making their big sacrifice, the hero bids farewell to his loved ones.

PrettySpryForADeadGuy.name: Pretty Spry for a Dead Guy
PrettySpryForADeadGuy.def: Someone thinks a dead person has come back. They're actually hallucinating or being deceived by an imposter.

PrestigePeril.name: Prestige Peril
PrestigePeril.def: Gaining a lofty position has the downside that any screw-up means you'll get killed.

PrimalFear.name: Primal Fear
PrimalFear.def: Death is one thing often regarded as something everyone fears.

PrisonersLastMeal.name: Prisoner's Last Meal
PrisonersLastMeal.def: The last meal a prisoner on Death Row eats before their execution.

TheProblemWithFightingDeath.name: The Problem with Fighting Death
TheProblemWithFightingDeath.def: Screw over the Grim Reaper, and he'll ensure that you suffer for it.

PsychicAssistedSuicide.name: Psychic-Assisted Suicide
PsychicAssistedSuicide.def: Mind control is used to make a person kill themselves.

PsychicGlimpseOfDeath.name: Psychic Glimpse of Death
PsychicGlimpseOfDeath.def: Reading a dying person's mind causes you to experience their death.

Psychopomp.name: Psychopomp
Psychopomp.def: A deity or spirit whose job is to cause the death of all mortal beings, and/or to help bring their souls over to the afterlife when their time comes.

PuffOfLogic.name: Puff of Logic
PuffOfLogic.def: Tell something why they shouldn't be able to live, and they instantly die on the spot (or fade from existence).

PullYourselfDownTheSpear.name: Pull Yourself Down the Spear
PullYourselfDownTheSpear.def: Pulling yourself down what you're impaled on to attack the one wielding the weapon used to impale you.

PummelingTheCorpse.name: Pummeling the Corpse
PummelingTheCorpse.def: Killer continues beating up the corpse after they're already dead.

RapidAging.name: Rapid Aging
RapidAging.def: Someone keeps rapidly getting older. In some cases, it results in the person dying because they've become so old.

RasputinianDeath.name: Rasputinian Death
RasputinianDeath.def: Character survives multiple fatal events before finally dying.

ReallyDeadMontage.name: Really Dead Montage
ReallyDeadMontage.def: A montage is shown to prove that a killed off character isn't coming back.

RealTragedyFictionalVictim.name: Real Tragedy, Fictional Victim
RealTragedyFictionalVictim.def: A fictional person died in a real event whose victims are well-known and/or recorded.

RebirthMakeover.name: Rebirth Makeover
RebirthMakeover.def: A character is brought back from the dead with a change to their appearance or outfit.

RedShirtArmy.name: Red Shirt Army
RedShirtArmy.def: An entire army of nameless characters get killed.

RedSpiderLiliesOfMourning.name: Red Spider Lilies of Mourning
RedSpiderLiliesOfMourning.def: A flower commonly associated with death and loss.

ReducedToDust.name: Reduced to Dust
ReducedToDust.def: After death, dust is all that remains of a person.

RefusingParadise.name: Refusing Paradise
RefusingParadise.def: Dead person chooses resurrection over going to a peaceful afterlife.

RegularlyScheduledEvil.name: Regularly Scheduled Evil
RegularlyScheduledEvil.def: Monster or villain always shows up to kill people at a specific time.

ReleasedToElsewhere.name: Released to Elsewhere
ReleasedToElsewhere.def: Someone's death is covered up by claiming that they've simply been relocated or moved to another place.

RelievingTheReaper.name: Relieving the Reaper
RelievingTheReaper.def: Someone temporarily takes over Death's job.

RememberTheDead.name: Remember the Dead
RememberTheDead.def: You only exist in the afterlife so long as there are people who remember you.

ReportsOfMyDeathWereGreatlyExaggerated.name: Reports of My Death Were Greatly Exaggerated
ReportsOfMyDeathWereGreatlyExaggerated.def: Everyone thinks a person has died, and the person has to make it clear that they're still living.

ReroutedFromHeaven.name: Rerouted from Heaven
ReroutedFromHeaven.def: Character who was supposed to go to Heaven instead ends up in Hell.

RescuedFromTheUnderworld.name: Rescued from the Underworld
RescuedFromTheUnderworld.def: Entering the afterlife to bring a dead person back.

ResetButtonSuicideMission.name: Reset-Button Suicide Mission
ResetButtonSuicideMission.def: Sacrificing yourself while aware that it will be undone.

RespawnPoint.name: Respawn Point
RespawnPoint.def: Killed person always revives in one specific place.

RestrainedRevenge.name: Restrained Revenge
RestrainedRevenge.def: A person knows they can't kill the person who's wronged them, so they simply deliver a less severe punishment rather than forgive them.

ResurrectedMurderer.name: Resurrected Murderer
ResurrectedMurderer.def: Somebody who caused deaths doesn't stay dead.

ResurrectionDeathLoop.name: Resurrection/Death Loop
ResurrectionDeathLoop.def: A character is doomed to die, be brought back from the death and die all over again - repeatedly.

ResurrectionGambit.name: Resurrection Gambit
ResurrectionGambit.def: Someone plans their own death and subsequent resurrection.

ResurrectionSickness.name: Resurrection Sickness
ResurrectionSickness.def: Person suffers ailments upon being brought back to life.

RetGone.name: Ret-Gone
RetGone.def: A character disappeared from the face of the earth, and possibly be dead, due to their ancestor being killed.

Retirony.name: Retirony
Retirony.def: Someone dies when they were close to retiring from their career.

RevivalLoophole.name: Revival Loophole
RevivalLoophole.def: Death is foretold, but not the dead person's immediate resurrection.

RewardedAsATraitorDeserves.name: Rewarded as a Traitor Deserves
RewardedAsATraitorDeserves.def: A traitor gets killed as reward for their treason.

RiseFromYourGrave.name: Rise from Your Grave
RiseFromYourGrave.def: Undead person claws their way out of their grave.

RocksFallEveryoneDies.name: Rocks Fall, Everyone Dies
RocksFallEveryoneDies.def: The game master of an RPG gets fed up and kills everyone in the game.

RubeGoldbergHatesYourGuts.name: Rube Goldberg Hates Your Guts
RubeGoldbergHatesYourGuts.def: A Rube Goldberg Device is used to kill someone.

SayYourPrayers.name: Say Your Prayers
SayYourPrayers.def: Someone prays when realizing they're about to get killed.

ScammingTheBereaved.name: Scamming the Bereaved
ScammingTheBereaved.def: A type of con where the hustler sells something to a person in mourning, claiming their deceased loved one started the purchase for them but died before they could complete it.

TheScourgeOfGod.name: The Scourge of God
TheScourgeOfGod.def: Monster starts by killing guiltier victims first.

SecondLawOfMetafictionalThermodynamics.name: Second Law of Metafictional Thermodynamics
SecondLawOfMetafictionalThermodynamics.def: Works are likely to have more deaths if the author is less emotionally stable.

SecretlyDying.name: Secretly Dying
SecretlyDying.def: A person's days are numbered, but no one finds out until after they die.

SeekingTheMissingFindingTheDead.name: Seeking the Missing, Finding the Dead
SeekingTheMissingFindingTheDead.def: The search for a missing person ends with the discovery that the person in question has died.

SeenItAllSuicide.name: Seen-It-All Suicide
SeenItAllSuicide.def: Character commits suicide because they think they've experienced everything they can.

SelfDestructiveCharge.name: Self-Destructive Charge
SelfDestructiveCharge.def: Character moves to attack even while they're dying.

SelfDisposingVillain.name: Self-Disposing Villain
SelfDisposingVillain.def: Villain gets themselves killed after the hero thwarts their plan.

SelfMadeOrphan.name: Self-Made Orphan
SelfMadeOrphan.def: A person who has killed their own parents.

SelfSacrificeScheme.name: Self-Sacrifice Scheme
SelfSacrificeScheme.def: A character plans to sacrifice themselves.

SenselessSacrifice.name: Senseless Sacrifice
SenselessSacrifice.def: The Heroic Sacrifice does jack squat.

SerendipitousSurvival.name: Serendipitous Survival
SerendipitousSurvival.def: Avoiding death because of random chance.

SeveredHeadSports.name: Severed Head Sports
SeveredHeadSports.def: Playing a ball game with a severed head being used for the ball.

ShapeDiesShifterSurvives.name: Shape Dies, Shifter Survives
ShapeDiesShifterSurvives.def: A shapeshifted character dies in one form, but survives in another. The dead form may be unavailable to them afterwards.

ShapeShifterSwanSong.name: Shapeshifter Swan Song
ShapeShifterSwanSong.def: Shape-shifter takes on various forms as they die.

SharedFateUltimatum.name: Shared Fate Ultimatum
SharedFateUltimatum.def: A threat that if one person dies, then someone will die with them.

SharedLifeEnergy.name: Shared Life Energy
SharedLifeEnergy.def: Someone is saved from dying when another person shares their life energy with them.

Shinigami.name: Shinigami
Shinigami.def: A Japanese spirit that personifies death.

ShootHimHeHasAWallet.name: Shoot Him, He Has a Wallet!
ShootHimHeHasAWallet.def: Someone is shot for holding a mundane object mistaken for a weapon.

ShootTheBuilder.name: Shoot the Builder
ShootTheBuilder.def: Kill someone so they cannot recreate their work for someone else.

ShootTheMessenger.name: Shoot the Messenger
ShootTheMessenger.def: Villain reacts to bad news by killing the messenger.

ShootTheShaggyDog.name: Shoot the Shaggy Dog
ShootTheShaggyDog.def: Story ends with the protagonist getting killed and their efforts turning out to be pointless.

ShotAtDawn.name: Shot at Dawn
ShotAtDawn.def: Executing someone with a firing squad.

ShrineToTheFallen.name: Shrine to the Fallen
ShrineToTheFallen.def: Creating a shrine to honor the deceased.

SiblingMurder.name: Sibling Murder
SiblingMurder.def: The successful killing of one's brother or sister.

SickbedSlaying.name: Sickbed Slaying
SickbedSlaying.def: Killing someone while they're sick in bed.

SilenceOrDeath.name: Silence or Death
SilenceOrDeath.def: Someone being too loud results in their death.

SilentCredits.name: Silent Credits
SilentCredits.def: End credits of a sad episode (which may be sad because of a death happening in it) have no music.

SinisterDeerSkull.name: Sinister Deer Skull
SinisterDeerSkull.def: A creepy looking deer skull is a great indicator of malevolence.

SlashedThroat.name: Slashed Throat
SlashedThroat.def: Killing someone by slashing their throat.

SlashersPreferBlondes.name: Slashers Prefer Blondes
SlashersPreferBlondes.def: Blonde characters tend to get killed off in horror genre works.

SketchySuccessor.name: Sketchy Successor
SketchySuccessor.def: After the leader dies, their replacement fails to live up to their legacy.

SmellsOfDeath.name: Smells of Death
SmellsOfDeath.def: Dying or recently deceased characters give off a particular smell.

SmokestackDrop.name: Smokestack Drop
SmokestackDrop.def: Falling to your death down a smokestack or chimney.

SmolderingShoes.name: Smoldering Shoes
SmolderingShoes.def: A person's shoes are all that remain after they're obliterated.

SnipingTheCockpit.name: Sniping the Cockpit
SnipingTheCockpit.def: Stopping a vehicle by killing the driver.

SnuffFilm.name: Snuff Film
SnuffFilm.def: A recorded film of someone being murdered.

SomeoneHasToDie.name: Someone Has to Die
SomeoneHasToDie.def: It's mandatory for someone to die so others may live.
