SomeoneToRememberHimBy.name: Someone to Remember Him By
SomeoneToRememberHimBy.def: A dead man's widow or bereaved girlfriend turns out to be pregnant with his child.

SorrowfulStutter.name: Sorrowful Stutter
SorrowfulStutter.def: A grieving character is unable to speak about their departed loved one without getting choked up.

SortingAlgorithmOfDeadness.name: Sorting Algorithm of Deadness
SortingAlgorithmOfDeadness.def: The odds of a dead character coming back to life.

SortingAlgorithmOfMortality.name: Sorting Algorithm of Mortality
SortingAlgorithmOfMortality.def: The odds of a character getting killed off.

SoullessShell.name: Soulless Shell
SoullessShell.def: The body is revived, but the soul is gone . May or may not be a zombie.

SparedByTheAdaptation.name: Spared by the Adaptation
SparedByTheAdaptation.def: A character who died in the original work remains alive in the adaptation.

SpeakIllOfTheDead.name: Speak Ill of the Dead
SpeakIllOfTheDead.def: Person is so tactless that they'll insult the deceased.

SpecialAesopVictim.name: Special Aesop Victim
SpecialAesopVictim.def: A character dies as part of the lesson of the Very Special Episode .

SpitefulSuicide.name: Spiteful Suicide
SpitefulSuicide.def: A character, usually a villain, commits suicide to spite others.

SpitefulWill.name: Spiteful Will
SpitefulWill.def: A dead person's will allows them to posthumously insult their hated peers.

SpitOutAShoe.name: Spit Out a Shoe
SpitOutAShoe.def: A character eaten alive has one of their belongings spat out to signify that they are done for.

SpontaneousHumanCombustion.name: Spontaneous Human Combustion
SpontaneousHumanCombustion.def: A person dies by bursting into flames or blowing up for no explained reason.

SquashedFlat.name: Squashed Flat
SquashedFlat.def: Character is flattened after being crushed by something. Doesn't necessarily have to be fatal.

StakingTheLovedOne.name: Staking the Loved One
StakingTheLovedOne.def: Having to kill a loved one after they're turned into a monster.

StarsAreSouls.name: Stars Are Souls
StarsAreSouls.def: The appearance or disappearance of a star represents the death of a character.

StartsWithASuicide.name: Starts with a Suicide
StartsWithASuicide.def: Story starts with a character committing or attempting suicide.

StartsWithTheirFuneral.name: Starts with Their Funeral
StartsWithTheirFuneral.def: Work begins with a funeral before explaining how the person died.

StayingAlive.name: Staying Alive
StayingAlive.def: Character keeps coming back no matter how many times they get killed.

StayWithMeUntilIDie.name: Stay with Me Until I Die
StayWithMeUntilIDie.def: Dying person requests a loved one to stay with them in their final moments.

Stellification.name: Stellification
Stellification.def: A character becomes a star or constellation after death.

StonedToDeath.name: Stoned to Death
StonedToDeath.def: A character is executed or murdered by having people hit them with thrown rocks until they die.

StrippedToTheBone.name: Stripped to the Bone
StrippedToTheBone.def: Person is killed in a way that their skeleton is all that's left.

StuffedIntoTheFridge.name: Stuffed into the Fridge
StuffedIntoTheFridge.def: A character dies just to move the plot forward.

StupidSacrifice.name: Stupid Sacrifice
StupidSacrifice.def: Character sacrifices themselves even though they didn't have to.

SuddenSequelDeathSyndrome.name: Sudden Sequel Death Syndrome
SuddenSequelDeathSyndrome.def: Surviving the first installment means the character will end up dead in the sequel.

SuicidalLemmings.name: Suicidal Lemmings
SuicidalLemmings.def: Lemmings off themselves by way of jumping off of cliffs.

SuicidalSadisticChoice.name: Suicidal Sadistic Choice
SuicidalSadisticChoice.def: A Sadistic Choice where one of the options is death.

SuicideAsComedy.name: Suicide as Comedy
SuicideAsComedy.def: When someone killing themselves is used for dark humor.

SuicideAttack.name: Suicide Attack
SuicideAttack.def: Someone simultaneously kills themselves and other people at once.

SuicideByCop.name: Suicide by Cop
SuicideByCop.def: Committing suicide by provoking someone into killing you.

SuicideByPills.name: Suicide by Pills
SuicideByPills.def: A character intentionally overdosing on medication in pill form to kill themselves.

SuicideBySea.name: Suicide by Sea
SuicideBySea.def: Committing suicide by walking into a body of water and deliberately drowning.

SuicideForOthersHappiness.name: Suicide for Others' Happiness
SuicideForOthersHappiness.def: Someone kills themselves to make someone they care about happy.

SuicideIsShameful.name: Suicide Is Shameful
SuicideIsShameful.def: Suicide is regarded as cowardly and dishonorable.

SuicideNotAccident.name: Suicide, Not Accident
SuicideNotAccident.def: A suicide is arranged to look like an accident.

SuicideNotMurder.name: Suicide, Not Murder
SuicideNotMurder.def: A suicide is initially mistaken for murder.

SuicidePact.name: Suicide Pact
SuicidePact.def: Two or more characters agree to kill themselves.

SuperDrowningSkills.name: Super Drowning Skills
SuperDrowningSkills.def: A character drowns the instant they hit the water.

SuperheroMovieVillainsDie.name: Superhero Movie Villains Die
SuperheroMovieVillainsDie.def: Film adaptations of comic books have a villain subjected to Death by Adaptation .

SupernaturallyMarkedGrave.name: Supernaturally Marked Grave
SupernaturallyMarkedGrave.def: After someone dies, they disappear and the ground where their corpse was changes to signify their death.

SuperpowerMeltdown.name: Super-Power Meltdown
SuperpowerMeltdown.def: Over-exterting one's super powers result in exploding.

SurvivorGuilt.name: Survivor Guilt
SurvivorGuilt.def: The one person left alive feels bad that they didn't die with the others who were killed or that the others weren't the ones who survived.

SuspectExistenceFailure.name: Suspect Existence Failure
SuspectExistenceFailure.def: A person suspected of being responsible for a murder ends up becoming another victim of the real culprit.

SWATting.name: SWATting
SWATting.def: Someone sends the police to storm some place and potentially kill whoever is there.

SymbolicCastFadeout.name: Symbolic Cast Fadeout
SymbolicCastFadeout.def: A cast list that fade out or marks whenever a cast member dies.

SymbolicSereneSubmersion.name: Symbolic Serene Submersion
SymbolicSereneSubmersion.def: A dead body is shown floating beneath the water, in a symbolic kind of way.

TagTeamSuicide.name: Tag Team Suicide
TagTeamSuicide.def: Two people kill themselves because a failure to communicate causes them both to think the other has died.

TakeAMomentToCatchYourDeath.name: Take a Moment to Catch Your Death
TakeAMomentToCatchYourDeath.def: Character dies right when they think they're in the clear.

TakeCareOfTheKids.name: Take Care of the Kids
TakeCareOfTheKids.def: Dying person asks someone to look after their children.

TakenForGranite.name: Taken for Granite
TakenForGranite.def: Someone dies by being turned to stone.

TakenOffLifeSupport.name: Taken Off Life Support
TakenOffLifeSupport.def: Someone is taken off life support when it's determined that they can't recover from their injuries.

TakingTheBullet.name: Taking the Bullet
TakingTheBullet.def: Shielding someone with your own body.

TakingYouWithMe.name: Taking You with Me
TakingYouWithMe.def: Someone about to be killed makes it so that their killer dies with them.

TalkingDownTheSuicidal.name: Talking Down the Suicidal
TalkingDownTheSuicidal.def: Talking a character out of killing themselves.

TalkingTheMonsterToDeath.name: Talking the Monster to Death
TalkingTheMonsterToDeath.def: Defeating the enemy simply by talking to them.

TalkingToTheDead.name: Talking to the Dead
TalkingToTheDead.def: Talking to the dead while visiting their graves.

TearsOfBlood.name: Tears of Blood
TearsOfBlood.def: A person's death is signified by crying tears of blood.

TechnicolorDeath.name: Technicolor Death
TechnicolorDeath.def: A character's death has them become a light show.

TeenageDeathSongs.name: Teenage Death Songs
TeenageDeathSongs.def: A song about dead or dying teenagers.

TerminalDiagnosisSuicide.name: Terminal Diagnosis Suicide
TerminalDiagnosisSuicide.def: A character commits suicide because they have a terminal illness or debilitating condition.

TerminalTransformation.name: Terminal Transformation
TerminalTransformation.def: A transformation that directly results in the transformee's death.

TerminallyIllCriminal.name: Terminally-Ill Criminal
TerminallyIllCriminal.def: A character commits a serious crime after learning they have a fatal disease.

TetheredBrawl.name: Tethered Brawl
TetheredBrawl.def: Two characters try to kill each other while physically tied together in some way.

ThanatosGambit.name: Thanatos Gambit
ThanatosGambit.def: A character's scheme involves their own death.

ThatPoorPlant.name: That Poor Plant
ThatPoorPlant.def: A plant withers and shrivels after a toxic substance is poured into it.

ThatWasTheLastEntry.name: That Was the Last Entry
ThatWasTheLastEntry.def: A diary stops abruptly to indicate the author has died.

ThereIsNoKillLikeOverkill.name: There Is No Kill Like Overkill
ThereIsNoKillLikeOverkill.def: A character is killed with much more force than necessary.

TheseHandsHaveKilled.name: These Hands Have Killed
TheseHandsHaveKilled.def: Someone feels terrible about having to take a life.

TheyDiedBecauseOfYou.name: They Died Because of You
TheyDiedBecauseOfYou.def: Hero is grief-stricken by the realization that they are indirectly responsible for a person's death.

TheyKnewTheRisks.name: They Knew the Risks
TheyKnewTheRisks.def: There's no need to be sad about this person's death. They knew there was a chance they'd get killed when they took the job.

ThisBearWasFramed.name: This Bear Was Framed
ThisBearWasFramed.def: Framing an intimidating predator for the murder.

ThisIsNotMyLifeToTake.name: This Is Not My Life to Take
ThisIsNotMyLifeToTake.def: Refusing to kill someone because another person is more deserving of ending their life.

ThisWasHisTrueForm.name: This Was His True Form
ThisWasHisTrueForm.def: A shape-shifter reverts to their true form upon death.

ThreadsOfFate.name: Threads of Fate
ThreadsOfFate.def: Powerful and supernatural threads that can represent or influence fate and destiny, cutting one often directly ends a person's life.

ThrowEmToTheWolves.name: Throw 'Em to the Wolves
ThrowEmToTheWolves.def: Hero kills villain by leaving them at the mercy of someone more ruthless.

ThrownOutTheAirlock.name: Thrown Out the Airlock
ThrownOutTheAirlock.def: Someone is killed by being thrown out of a spaceship's airlock.

TimeDelayedDeath.name: Time-Delayed Death
TimeDelayedDeath.def: Injured character ends up inexplicably dying a bit after the accident.

ToAbsentFriends.name: To Absent Friends
ToAbsentFriends.def: Heroes propose a toast to their fallen friend(s).

TogetherInDeath.name: Together in Death
TogetherInDeath.def: Two lovers may have died, but at least now they'll be together for eternity in the afterlife.

TonightSomeoneDies.name: Tonight, Someone Dies
TonightSomeoneDies.def: Show announces that a major character will be killed off.

Tontine.name: Tontine
Tontine.def: A group of people reach an agreement that a collection of valuables will go to the last surviving member of them.

TooCoolToLive.name: Too Cool to Live
TooCoolToLive.def: Character dies because they're more awesome than the hero.

TooGoodForThisSinfulEarth.name: Too Good for This Sinful Earth
TooGoodForThisSinfulEarth.def: A kindhearted, innocent character dies in a Crapsack World .

TooHappyToLive.name: Too Happy to Live
TooHappyToLive.def: Story having a happy beginning means that an unfortunate death is guaranteed to happen later.

TooInjuredToSave.name: Too Injured to Save
TooInjuredToSave.def: A character whose wounds are too serious to recover from and does not have much time left.

TooPowerfulToLive.name: Too Powerful to Live
TooPowerfulToLive.def: A villain who is too powerful is killed as soon as they show up to maintain the story's conflict.

TornApartByTheMob.name: Torn Apart by the Mob
TornApartByTheMob.def: Death at the hands (feet, etc.) of an angry mob.

TorsoWithAView.name: Torso with a View
TorsoWithAView.def: Someone is killed by having a hole shot through their chest.

TragicBromance.name: Tragic Bromance
TragicBromance.def: Two heroes are friends. One dies.

TragicKeepsake.name: Tragic Keepsake
TragicKeepsake.def: A bereaved person holds onto an item that's all they have to remember their dead loved one.

TragicOneShotCharacter.name: Tragic One-Shot Character
TragicOneShotCharacter.def: A one-shot character is killed and their death affects the main character.

TragicStillbirth.name: Tragic Stillbirth
TragicStillbirth.def: Parents are saddened by their child being stillborn.

Transflormation.name: Transflormation
Transflormation.def: A person dies by being turned into a plant.

TraumaticCSection.name: Traumatic C-Section
TraumaticCSection.def: Pregnant woman has the fetus crudely cut or ripped out of her womb.

TrialByFriendlyFire.name: Trial by Friendly Fire
TrialByFriendlyFire.def: The only way to kill the enemy is by shooting through your friend.

TurbineBlender.name: Turbine Blender
TurbineBlender.def: Someone is cut to pieces by a jet engine or propeller.

UncertainDoom.name: Uncertain Doom
UncertainDoom.def: A character is last seen in a situation where they might have been killed, but it's not clear whether or not they survived.

UndignifiedDeath.name: Undignified Death
UndignifiedDeath.def: Character's death is ridiculous and embarrassing.

UnexpectedInheritance.name: Unexpected Inheritance
UnexpectedInheritance.def: Someone is surprised to learn they got an inheritance from someone they never met in person.

UnexpectedSuccessor.name: Unexpected Successor
UnexpectedSuccessor.def: After a person dies, their legacy is continued by someone who wasn't expected to be deemed worthy.

UnexplainedRecovery.name: Unexplained Recovery
UnexplainedRecovery.def: A character comes back alive with no explanation for their survival even though it was clear that they got killed the last time they appeared.

UnintentionalFinalMessage.name: Unintentional Final Message
UnintentionalFinalMessage.def: A living character receives a message that a dead character composed before they knew they were about to die.

UnmournedDeath.name: Unmourned Death
UnmournedDeath.def: A character's death only elicits abject apathy.

UnwantedRevival.name: Unwanted Revival
UnwantedRevival.def: A resurrected person isn't happy that they've been brought back to life.

VasquezAlwaysDies.name: Vasquez Always Dies
VasquezAlwaysDies.def: When a masculine female and a more feminine female are the heroines, the masculine female ends up killed while the girly female lives.

VerticalKidnapping.name: Vertical Kidnapping
VerticalKidnapping.def: Someone is killed when their killer scoops them up while hanging from the ceiling.

VideoWills.name: Video Wills
VideoWills.def: Someone leaves a final video message before they die.

VikingFuneral.name: Viking Funeral
VikingFuneral.def: A dead person is cast away in a boat with their possessions while it is set on fire.

VillainsDyingGrace.name: Villain's Dying Grace
VillainsDyingGrace.def: Dying villain decides to help the hero before they die.

VillainKiller.name: Villain Killer
VillainKiller.def: A character who successfully kills a significant number of villains over the course of the story.

VorpalPillow.name: Vorpal Pillow
VorpalPillow.def: Killing someone by smothering them with a pillow.

WakingUpAtTheMorgue.name: Waking Up at the Morgue
WakingUpAtTheMorgue.def: A person who has died or been mistaken for dead after passing out finds themselves in a place where dead bodies are kept after they resurrect or regain consciousness.

WalkingWasteland.name: Walking Wasteland
WalkingWasteland.def: A character who spreads death and destruction everywhere they go.

WallSlump.name: Wall Slump
WallSlump.def: A killed person hits against the wall before their corpse slinks down.

WallStreetHighDive.name: Wall Street High-Dive
WallStreetHighDive.def: A businessman or executive jumps from their office to their death after a catastrophic failure.

WaxMuseumMorgue.name: Wax Museum Morgue
WaxMuseumMorgue.def: The "statues" at a wax museum are actually preserved corpses.

WeAllDieSomeday.name: We All Die Someday
WeAllDieSomeday.def: Casually pointing out that everyone dies eventually.

WeHardlyKnewYe.name: We Hardly Knew Ye
WeHardlyKnewYe.def: Character is killed off not long after the audience is introduced to them.

WeWillHaveEuthanasiaInTheFuture.name: We Will Have Euthanasia in the Future
WeWillHaveEuthanasiaInTheFuture.def: In a futuristic setting, it is considered okay to kill people if they are suffering from an illness.

WeddingDeathJuxtaposition.name: Wedding/Death Juxtaposition
WeddingDeathJuxtaposition.def: The happiness of a wedding in close narrative proximity to the sadness of a death.

WentToTheGreatXInTheSky.name: Went to the Great X in the Sky
WentToTheGreatXInTheSky.def: A common euphemism referring to death is to say that the dead person has gone to "the great (insert afterlife place appropriate to the deceased's personality, interests, or habits) in the sky".

WhatADrag.name: What a Drag
WhatADrag.def: Torturing or killing someone by dragging them around.

WhatASenselessWasteOfHumanLife.name: What a Senseless Waste of Human Life
WhatASenselessWasteOfHumanLife.def: Characters express sorrow at lives wasted, particularly those of their enemies.

WhatIsOneMansLifeInComparison.name: What Is One Man's Life In Comparison?
WhatIsOneMansLifeInComparison.def: Someone is asked to give their life for the greater good.

WhereTheresAWillTheresAStickyNote.name: Where There's a Will, There's a Sticky Note
WhereTheresAWillTheresAStickyNote.def: Character who fears that their death is imminent writes their will on whatever they can find.

WhiteShirtOfDeath.name: White Shirt of Death
WhiteShirtOfDeath.def: Person dressed in white dies a very gory death.

WhodunnitToMe.name: Whodunnit to Me?
WhodunnitToMe.def: Someone who survives or is resurrected after an attempt to do them in tries to figure out who their murderer or would-be murderer was.

WhoMurderedTheAsshole.name: Who Murdered the Asshole?
WhoMurderedTheAsshole.def: An unsympathetic person has been murdered, but identifying the culprit is difficult because everyone who knew the victim hated them enough to want to kill them.

WhyCouldntYouSaveThem.name: Why Couldn't You Save Them?
WhyCouldntYouSaveThem.def: Someone is angry at the hero because they were unable to save a loved one.

WhyDontYouJustShootHim.name: Why Don't You Just Shoot Him?
WhyDontYouJustShootHim.def: When trying to get rid of their enemies, the villain never takes the easy way out.

WhyWontYouDie.name: Why Won't You Die?
WhyWontYouDie.def: Someone exasperatedly asks why the person they're trying to kill keeps surviving every attempt at their life.

WidowedAtTheWedding.name: Widowed at the Wedding
WidowedAtTheWedding.def: The bride or groom is killed immediately after the wedding.

WidowMistreatment.name: Widow Mistreatment
WidowMistreatment.def: Someone is treated poorly following the death of their spouse.

WidowsWeeds.name: Widow's Weeds
WidowsWeeds.def: Woman wears certain clothes when they are in mourning.

TheWildHunt.name: The Wild Hunt
TheWildHunt.def: Otherwordly beings show up to hunt the living or punish hunters.

WindsAreGhosts.name: Winds Are Ghosts
WindsAreGhosts.def: Wind associated with the spirits of the deceased.

WingedSoulFliesOffAtDeath.name: Winged Soul Flies Off at Death
WingedSoulFliesOffAtDeath.def: After a character dies, their soul flies off as an angel.

WinterOfStarvation.name: Winter of Starvation
WinterOfStarvation.def: Characters become desperate for food during the winter, and may end up dying from cold or hunger.

WithMyDyingBreathISummonYou.name: With My Dying Breath, I Summon You
WithMyDyingBreathISummonYou.def: When the villain dies, their last words are to summon a last opponent for the hero.

WringEveryLastDropOutOfHim.name: Wring Every Last Drop out of Him
WringEveryLastDropOutOfHim.def: A character is on the brink of death, but takes a while to actually die.

WoodChipperOfDoom.name: Wood Chipper of Doom
WoodChipperOfDoom.def: A running wood chipper or a similar machine is used as a method of murder and/or gory body disposal.

YetAnotherStupidDeath.name: Yet Another Stupid Death
YetAnotherStupidDeath.def: A video game features game over screens where the player is chastised for dying because of a dumb decision.

YouAreWorthHell.name: You Are Worth Hell
YouAreWorthHell.def: Estranged lovers are reunited in Hell.

YouAreAlreadyDead.name: You Are Already Dead
YouAreAlreadyDead.def: A character suffers a lethal blow but there's a noticeable delay in their death.

YouHaveFailedMe.name: You Have Failed Me
YouHaveFailedMe.def: Villain kills minion as punishment for screwing up royally or too often.

YouHaveOutlivedYourUsefulness.name: You Have Outlived Your Usefulness
YouHaveOutlivedYourUsefulness.def: Villain kills minions after they've done what he ordered them to do.

YouKillItYouBoughtIt.name: You Kill It, You Bought It
YouKillItYouBoughtIt.def: When you kill someone, you have to take up their title or responsibility.

YourDaysAreNumbered.name: Your Days Are Numbered
YourDaysAreNumbered.def: Character is going to die and they know it.

YourHeadASplode.name: Your Head A-Splode
YourHeadASplode.def: A person is killed when their head explodes.

YouSeeImDying.name: You See, I'm Dying
YouSeeImDying.def: Character reveals that they are dying.

YouShallNotPass.name: You Shall Not Pass!
YouShallNotPass.def: Sacrificing yourself to hold back an enemy.

YouShouldHaveDiedInstead.name: You Should Have Died Instead
YouShouldHaveDiedInstead.def: A person who's loved one has died wishes that it was a person they hated who died instead.

ZippingUpTheBodybag.name: Zipping Up the Bodybag
ZippingUpTheBodybag.def: A character is proven to be dead for real by showing their corpse being zipped up in a body bag.

AccentsArentHereditary.name: Accents Aren't Hereditary
AccentsArentHereditary.def: A character speaks with an accent different from the rest of their family.

AdoptingTheAbused.name: Adopting the Abused
AdoptingTheAbused.def: An abused child is taken in by a healthier and much more loving family.

AdoptionAngst.name: Adoption Angst
AdoptionAngst.def: A character discovers they are adopted, and don't take it well.

AdoptionConflict.name: Adoption Conflict
AdoptionConflict.def: The biological and adoptive parents of a character fight over who's actually the character's family.

AdoptionIsNotAnOption.name: Adoption Is Not an Option
AdoptionIsNotAnOption.def: A couple who are struggling to have children never think about adopting a kid.

AdultAdoptee.name: Adult Adoptee
AdultAdoptee.def: An adult character is adopted into a different family despite being legally of age.

AlternateTimelineAncestry.name: Alternate Timeline Ancestry
AlternateTimelineAncestry.def: A character, or an Alternate Self , is born anyway despite their ancestry being changed.

AmbiguousFamilyTies.name: Ambiguous Family Ties
AmbiguousFamilyTies.def: Spouses assume a distant relative comes from each other's family.

AmbiguouslyAbsentParent.name: Ambiguously Absent Parent
AmbiguouslyAbsentParent.def: A character has a parental figure missing from their life without any explanation as to why.

AmbiguouslyRelated.name: Ambiguously Related
AmbiguouslyRelated.def: Characters' actions and similarities suggest they might be related, but the work never confirms if they are.

AmicableExes.name: Amicable Exes
AmicableExes.def: Parents remain on good terms with each other despite being divorced.

AndYourRewardIsParenthood.name: And Your Reward Is Parenthood
AndYourRewardIsParenthood.def: When completing objectives in a video game allows the player to start a family.

AntiNepotism.name: Anti-Nepotism
AntiNepotism.def: A character treats their family members coldly at work to stave off accusations of nepotism.

AppealToFamilialWisdom.name: Appeal to Familial Wisdom
AppealToFamilialWisdom.def: My relative told me this, so it must be right.

AristocratTeam.name: Aristocrat Team
AristocratTeam.def: A team where it is possible that certain members of rich/noble bloodlines team-up together.

ArtificialFamilyMember.name: Artificial Family Member
ArtificialFamilyMember.def: A robot or an Artificial Human that is treated as their creator's own child.

AwkwardFatherSonBondingActivity.name: Awkward Father-Son Bonding Activity
AwkwardFatherSonBondingActivity.def: A father tries to bond with his son, who is quite reluctant to do so.

BabiesEverAfter.name: Babies Ever After
BabiesEverAfter.def: A couple is shown to have started a family at the end of the story.

BabyAsPayment.name: Baby as Payment
BabyAsPayment.def: A family is broken apart after a parent (willing or otherwise) gives away their child in exchange for something else.

BandOfRelatives.name: Band of Relatives
BandOfRelatives.def: A musical group comprised of relatives.

BigScrewedUpFamily.name: Big, Screwed-Up Family
BigScrewedUpFamily.def: A horribly bleak, loveless, and all around dysfunctional family.

BlendedFamilyDrama.name: Blended Family Drama
BlendedFamilyDrama.def: Tension among new stepparents and stepsiblings.

ABoyAGirlAndABabyFamily.name: A Boy, a Girl, and a Baby Family
ABoyAGirlAndABabyFamily.def: A family where the children consist of one son, one daughter, and a baby of either gender.

BreakfastInBed.name: Breakfast in Bed
BreakfastInBed.def: Family members making the first meal of the day for another as a show of love and appreciation.

BreakingTheCycleOfBadParenting.name: Breaking the Cycle of Bad Parenting
BreakingTheCycleOfBadParenting.def: A parent or parental figure who is shown as a better parent than their own.

CannibalClan.name: Cannibal Clan
CannibalClan.def: A family who kills and eats their dinner guests.

ChasteToons.name: Chaste Toons
ChasteToons.def: Characters who have nieces and nephews but never any children of their own.

ChubbyMamaSkinnyPapa.name: Chubby Mama, Skinny Papa
ChubbyMamaSkinnyPapa.def: The mother is plump while the father is thin.

TheClan.name: The Clan
TheClan.def: A large extensive family, often one of nobility.

ClashingCousins.name: Clashing Cousins
ClashingCousins.def: Cousins who either form a rivalry or dislike each other.

CoattailRidingRelative.name: Coattail-Riding Relative
CoattailRidingRelative.def: A character who tries to leech off their family's wealth/status.

CommonLawMarriage.name: Common Law Marriage
CommonLawMarriage.def: A family where the parents aren't legally married for some reason.

CoolUncle.name: Cool Uncle
CoolUncle.def: An uncle ( or sometimes aunt ) that is beloved by their niece/nephew.

CreepyFamily.name: Creepy Family
CreepyFamily.def: A very strange or downright scary family, often one literally of supernatural origin.

CreepyUncle.name: Creepy Uncle
CreepyUncle.def: The uncle (or sometimes aunt) who lusts after their niece/nephew.

CriminalFoundFamily.name: Criminal Found Family
CriminalFoundFamily.def: A gang of outlaws treat each other like family.

CrossoverRelatives.name: Crossover Relatives
CrossoverRelatives.def: A work combining two franchises makes characters from one related to those of the other.

DaddyDNATest.name: Daddy DNA Test
DaddyDNATest.def: A DNA test done to figure out who a child's father is.

DadsOffFightingInTheWar.name: Dad's Off Fighting in the War
DadsOffFightingInTheWar.def: A character's parents are off fighting in a war.

DinnerAndAShow.name: Dinner and a Show
DinnerAndAShow.def: When dysfunctional families eat together, fights are likely to break out.

DisneylandDad.name: Disneyland Dad
DisneylandDad.def: A divorced parent who spoils their children.

DisownedParent.name: Disowned Parent
DisownedParent.def: A child of any age disowns at least one of their parents.

DissatisfiedFamilyMan.name: Dissatisfied Family Man
DissatisfiedFamilyMan.def: A depressed middle-aged man working a dead-end job who is a mediocre husband and/or father.

DontSplitUsUp.name: Don't Split Us Up
DontSplitUsUp.def: Siblings are threatened with being separated from each other by divorce or foster care.

DontTellMama.name: Don't Tell Mama
DontTellMama.def: A character doesn't want their family to know about their criminal activities.

DotingGrandparent.name: Doting Grandparent
DotingGrandparent.def: A grandparent who's affectionate and spoils their grandchildren.

DreadedKidsTable.name: Dreaded Kids' Table
DreadedKidsTable.def: During large family meals, kids who aren't quite adults are forced to sit with smaller children, much to their dismay.

TheDreadedPretendTeaParty.name: The Dreaded Pretend Tea-Party
TheDreadedPretendTeaParty.def: When a family has a young daughter, it's inevitable that one of the members will be subjected to one of her pretend tea parties.

DynasticDrama.name: Dynastic Drama
DynasticDrama.def: Matters of inheritance, marriage, alliances, rivalries, within a family/house

DysfunctionalFamily.name: Dysfunctional Family
DysfunctionalFamily.def: The family where everyone behaves as though they don't like each other.

EasyAdoption.name: Easy Adoption
EasyAdoption.def: Legal adoption is shown as being very easy.

ElderAbandonment.name: Elder Abandonment
ElderAbandonment.def: A character stops taking care of their elderly family members.

ElderAbuse.name: Elder Abuse
ElderAbuse.def: A character treats their elderly family members horribly, either by physical abuse or Financial Abuse .

EmancipatedChild.name: Emancipated Child
EmancipatedChild.def: A child who splits off legally from their parents.

EmbarrassingRelativeTeacher.name: Embarrassing Relative Teacher
EmbarrassingRelativeTeacher.def: A relative becomes staff at a child's school, and humiliates them.

EmptyNest.name: Empty Nest
EmptyNest.def: A home where a couple's children have grown up and left the house.

EnemyBecomesFamily.name: Enemy Becomes Family
EnemyBecomesFamily.def: A character becomes family with their enemy/enemies.

EstrangedSoapFamily.name: Estranged Soap Family
EstrangedSoapFamily.def: Family members never show up for their relative's important life events.

EvenBadMenLoveTheirMamas.name: Even Bad Men Love Their Mamas
EvenBadMenLoveTheirMamas.def: Evil characters have their mother as their Morality Pet .

EvilNephew.name: Evil Nephew
EvilNephew.def: The villainous nephew who plots to murder his uncle.

EvilParentsWantGoodKids.name: Evil Parents Want Good Kids
EvilParentsWantGoodKids.def: Villainous characters who become parents strive to raise their children to be model citizens.

EvilUncle.name: Evil Uncle
EvilUncle.def: The wicked uncle (or sometimes aunt) that mistreats their niece/nephew.

FamilialBodySnatcher.name: Familial Body Snatcher
FamilialBodySnatcher.def: A Body Snatcher who only possesses members of their own family and/or descendants.

FamilyBusiness.name: Family Business
FamilyBusiness.def: A business such as a store or a restaurant that's owned by a family.

FamilyDisunion.name: Family Disunion
FamilyDisunion.def: Family reunions are a source of major drama.

FamilyEyeResemblance.name: Family Eye Resemblance
FamilyEyeResemblance.def: Family members with the same, distinctive-looking eyes.

FamilyHonor.name: Family Honor
FamilyHonor.def: Families with a huge degree of honor and respect expect their members to live up to it.

FamilyOfChoice.name: Family of Choice
FamilyOfChoice.def: A group of friends who don't have any blood/marital relations among themselves still treat each other as though they were family.

FamilyPortraitOfCharacterization.name: Family Portrait of Characterization
FamilyPortraitOfCharacterization.def: A family portrait tells us something about the members.

TheFamilyThatSlaysTogether.name: The Family That Slays Together
TheFamilyThatSlaysTogether.def: A family of murderers or other kinds of rogues.

FamilyVersusCareer.name: Family Versus Career
FamilyVersusCareer.def: How dare a woman be good at her career job and have a family, too!

FamousAncestor.name: Famous Ancestor
FamousAncestor.def: A character is a descendant of someone famous.

FatherIWantToMarryMyBrother.name: Father, I Want to Marry My Brother
FatherIWantToMarryMyBrother.def: A child expresses an innocent desire to marry a family member.

FelonsFailson.name: Felon's Failson
FelonsFailson.def: A criminal's offspring who is nowhere near as respected or competent as their parent.

FeminineMotherTomboyishDaughter.name: Feminine Mother, Tomboyish Daughter
FeminineMotherTomboyishDaughter.def: A mother is more traditionally feminine than her daughter, which may cause conflict.

FeudingFamilies.name: Feuding Families
FeudingFamilies.def: Families who despise each other to the point of actually going to war.

FinancialAbuse.name: Financial Abuse
FinancialAbuse.def: A character abuses their family member by using money to control them.

FollowingInRelativesFootsteps.name: Following in Relative's Footsteps
FollowingInRelativesFootsteps.def: Character is inspired by their relative and decides to take up the same job.

FormerlyFriendlyFamily.name: Formerly Friendly Family
FormerlyFriendlyFamily.def: Family members were once close, but grew to hate each other.

FoundFamilyViaWork.name: Found Family via Work
FoundFamilyViaWork.def: A group of coworkers treat each other like family.

FriendsAreChosenFamilyArent.name: Friends Are Chosen, Family Aren't
FriendsAreChosenFamilyArent.def: A character has a bad relationship with their family but a good relationship with their friends.

FromCousinToHonorarySibling.name: From Cousin to Honorary Sibling
FromCousinToHonorarySibling.def: Cousins who share a close bond are looked at as siblings instead.

GenerationalTrauma.name: Generational Trauma
GenerationalTrauma.def: Conflict arises due to unresolved baggage passed down from generation to generation.

GettingMyOwnRoomPlot.name: "Getting My Own Room" Plot
GettingMyOwnRoomPlot.def: A family member wants their own room.

GiftForAnOutgrownInterest.name: Gift for an Outgrown Interest
GiftForAnOutgrownInterest.def: A gift-giver's idea of what the recipient would like is based on very outdated memories.

GrandparentalAgeDissonance.name: Grandparental Age Dissonance
GrandparentalAgeDissonance.def: A grandparent is a lot older or younger than they realistically should be.

GrandparentFavoritism.name: Grandparent Favoritism
GrandparentFavoritism.def: A grandparent who shares a close bond with/had a preference for their children's offspring that they don't (or didn't) have with their children.

GruesomeGrandparent.name: Gruesome Grandparent
GruesomeGrandparent.def: A grandparent who is abysmal to their grandchildren.

HappilyAdopted.name: Happily Adopted
HappilyAdopted.def: A character lives a happy life with their adoptive family.

HereditaryCurse.name: Hereditary Curse
HereditaryCurse.def: A curse is passed on through a family.

HereditaryHairstyle.name: Hereditary Hairstyle
HereditaryHairstyle.def: A hairstyle that's passed down through a family.

HeroicLineage.name: Heroic Lineage
HeroicLineage.def: Heroism is passed down through the family.

TheHilariousTable.name: The Hilarious Table
TheHilariousTable.def: Family members are shown laughing and joking with each other around a table.

HippieParents.name: Hippie Parents
HippieParents.def: Former flower children that have become parents.

HistoricalCharactersFictionalRelative.name: Historical Character's Fictional Relative
HistoricalCharactersFictionalRelative.def: A fictional character is related to a real-life person.

HistoricalRelationshipOverhaul.name: Historical Relationship Overhaul
HistoricalRelationshipOverhaul.def: Two historical domain characters are related differently in Historical Fiction , or aren't related at all, or the dynamic of their relationship is changed.

HonoraryUncle.name: Honorary Uncle
HonoraryUncle.def: A character who is considered an honorary member of their friend's family.

HonorRelatedAbuse.name: Honor-Related Abuse
HonorRelatedAbuse.def: A character is mistreated or killed by their family for the sake of preserving the family's honor.

HowDadMetMom.name: How Dad Met Mom
HowDadMetMom.def: A character tells their children the story of how they met their spouse.

HumbleParentSpoiledKids.name: Humble Parent, Spoiled Kids
HumbleParentSpoiledKids.def: One or both parents in a family are down to earth people while their kids are Spoiled Brats .

IAmNotMyFather.name: I Am Not My Father
IAmNotMyFather.def: A character actively defies becoming like their parent.

IdenticalGrandson.name: Identical Grandson
IdenticalGrandson.def: A character closely resembles their ancestor.

IHaveAFamily.name: I Have a Family
IHaveAFamily.def: A character pleads for their life by mentioning they have a family to care for.

IHaveNoSon.name: I Have No Son!
IHaveNoSon.def: A character is disowned by their family.

IllegalGuardian.name: Illegal Guardian
IllegalGuardian.def: A wicked relative of a character gains guardianship of them through unscrupulous means in order to get their money.

InterracialAdoptionStruggles.name: Interracial Adoption Struggles
InterracialAdoptionStruggles.def: A kid is adopted by a family with a different race or ethnicity, struggles and cultural clashes ensue.

InTheBlood.name: In the Blood
InTheBlood.def: Family members tend to have similar personalities, behaviors and/or moralities.

ItRunsInTheFamily.name: It Runs in the Family
ItRunsInTheFamily.def: Insanity and quirkiness runs in the family.

KidnappedByFamily.name: Kidnapped by Family
KidnappedByFamily.def: Being kidnapped by your own family members.

LamarckWasRight.name: Lamarck Was Right
LamarckWasRight.def: A character inherits a non-genetic trait from their parents.

LivingDistantAncestor.name: Living Distant Ancestor
LivingDistantAncestor.def: An ancestor many generations removed (usually an immortal) is still alive.

LongLostRelative.name: Long-Lost Relative
LongLostRelative.def: A character meets someone that's later revealed to be related to them.

LoveFatherLoveSon.name: Love Father, Love Son
LoveFatherLoveSon.def: The child of a character's unrequited crush marries said character

LoveObstructingParents.name: Love-Obstructing Parents
LoveObstructingParents.def: The parents of the protagonist's Love Interest make their love life difficult.

LukeIAmYourFather.name: Luke, I Am Your Father
LukeIAmYourFather.def: A character finds out their parentage in a plot twist.

MageBornOfMuggles.name: Mage Born of Muggles
MageBornOfMuggles.def: Two non-magical characters give birth to a child who has magic.

MamaDidntRaiseNoCriminal.name: Mama Didn't Raise No Criminal
MamaDidntRaiseNoCriminal.def: The family of a criminal denies that their child could ever be such a thing.

AMistakeIsBorn.name: A Mistake Is Born
AMistakeIsBorn.def: A character is unwanted by their family or the character is unplanned.

MistakenForDifferentRelative.name: Mistaken for Different Relative
MistakenForDifferentRelative.def: Someone incorrectly guesses how two or more characters are related.

MotherhoodIsSuperior.name: Motherhood Is Superior
MotherhoodIsSuperior.def: Mothers tend to love the children more than their fathers do.

MuggleBornOfMages.name: Muggle Born of Mages
MuggleBornOfMages.def: Magic using characters have a non-magical child.

MultigenerationalHousehold.name: Multigenerational Household
MultigenerationalHousehold.def: A home where a character lives with their parents, grandparents, great grandparents, etc.

MyGrandsonMyself.name: My Grandson, Myself
MyGrandsonMyself.def: An immortal passes themselves off as their own descendant.

Nephewism.name: Nephewism
Nephewism.def: A character lives with another relative (often an aunt or an uncle) without any explanation on where their parents are.

Nepotism.name: Nepotism
Nepotism.def: A character shows favoritism towards a relative at work.

NotActuallyHisChild.name: Not Actually His Child
NotActuallyHisChild.def: One character is believed the biological parent of another. Turns out they were wrong.

NuclearFamily.name: Nuclear Family
NuclearFamily.def: The standard issue family consisting of a mother, a father, and their children.

OlderNephewYoungerUncle.name: Older Nephew, Younger Uncle
OlderNephewYoungerUncle.def: A niece or nephew and their aunt or uncle are close in age, or the former is older than the latter.

OneNormalNight.name: One Normal Night
OneNormalNight.def: An embarrassing family pretends to be normal when meeting their child's date.

PaidForFamily.name: Paid-for Family
PaidForFamily.def: A character pays some strangers to pretend to be their family.

ParentChildTeam.name: Parent-Child Team
ParentChildTeam.def: Parents work together with their children.

ParentsKnowTheirChildren.name: Parents Know Their Children
ParentsKnowTheirChildren.def: Parents are able to recognize their children even when they're in disguise.

PlatonicCoParenting.name: Platonic Co-Parenting
PlatonicCoParenting.def: Characters who aren't romantically involved raise children together.

PlatonicShipping.name: Platonic Shipping
PlatonicShipping.def: The fandom pairs characters in a familial or otherwise non-romantic way.

PostChildMarriage.name: Post-Child Marriage
PostChildMarriage.def: A child's unwed parents get married to each other.

PostNightmareComfort.name: Post-Nightmare Comfort
PostNightmareComfort.def: A family member comforts another after a terrible nightmare.

ThePowerOfFamily.name: The Power of Family
ThePowerOfFamily.def: Members of a family share unbreakable bonds.

PretendingToBeOnesOwnRelative.name: Pretending to Be One's Own Relative

ProtagonistsBecomeBadParents.name: Protagonists Become Bad Parents
ProtagonistsBecomeBadParents.def: The heroes of the previous story have trouble parenting their children in the sequel or Spin-Offspring .

PursuingParentalPerils.name: Pursuing Parental Perils
PursuingParentalPerils.def: A character decides to take up their dead parent's occupation.

QuirkyHousehold.name: Quirky Household
QuirkyHousehold.def: A family that looks out for each other, in spite of having wacky moments.

RealMenHateAffection.name: Real Men Hate Affection
RealMenHateAffection.def: The men in the family refuse to openly show affection for each other.

RefusedReunion.name: Refused Reunion
RefusedReunion.def: Upon discovery, a character who's missing or presumed dead by their family chooses to remain missing and presumed dead.

RelatedInTheAdaptation.name: Related in the Adaptation
RelatedInTheAdaptation.def: Two or more characters are related in a derivative work when they weren't in what said work is based on.

RelatedRegardlessOfDistance.name: Related Regardless of Distance
RelatedRegardlessOfDistance.def: Distant relatives are treated the same as close ones.

RelativeRidicule.name: Relative Ridicule
RelativeRidicule.def: Making fun of someone's family members, or mocking them for whom they are related to.

ReplacementSibling.name: Replacement Sibling
ReplacementSibling.def: A child is born to a couple whose previous child died.

RichSiblingPoorSibling.name: Rich Sibling, Poor Sibling
RichSiblingPoorSibling.def: One sibling is wealthy and/or showered in love and praise; the other is degraded and impoverished.

RoboFamily.name: Robo Family
RoboFamily.def: Robots depicted as being related to one another, or built and programmed so as to resemble a family.

RoyallyScrewedUp.name: Royally Screwed Up
RoyallyScrewedUp.def: Royal families that are prone to breeding mentally ill/evil members.

RulingFamilyMassacre.name: Ruling Family Massacre
RulingFamilyMassacre.def: A nation's royal family is murdered when an enemy nation seizes control.

SearchingForTheLostRelative.name: Searching for the Lost Relative
SearchingForTheLostRelative.def: A character is searching for a lost relative.

SecretLegacy.name: Secret Legacy
SecretLegacy.def: The Hero discovers his extraordinary family legacy.

SecretOtherFamily.name: Secret Other Family
SecretOtherFamily.def: A character has another family that's unbeknownst to their other one.

SeniorCitizensEvenOlderParent.name: Senior Citizen's Even Older Parent
SeniorCitizensEvenOlderParent.def: An already elderly character has at least one living parent, who may or may not be a great-grandparent (or beyond).

SharedFamilyQuirks.name: Shared Family Quirks
SharedFamilyQuirks.def: Family members tend to have similar behavioral traits.

SharedSignatureMove.name: Shared Signature Move
SharedSignatureMove.def: A Badass Family or family consisting of action heroes can have a Signature Move that multiple members use.

ShedTheFamilyName.name: Shed the Family Name
ShedTheFamilyName.def: A character changes their family name in order to disassociate themself from a hated family member.

SingleSexOffspring.name: Single Sex Offspring
SingleSexOffspring.def: A family produces exclusively (or nearly so) male or female children.

SinisterSerialAdopter.name: Sinister Serial Adopter
SinisterSerialAdopter.def: A villainous character "adopts" multiple children, usually for unwholesome purposes, usually via kidnapping or other underhanded methods.

SmallParentHugeChild.name: Small Parent, Huge Child
SmallParentHugeChild.def: A character is noticeably larger than one or more of their parents.

StayingWithTheSuffering.name: Staying with the Suffering
StayingWithTheSuffering.def: A character stays with a family member as they recover from a sickness, injury, or trauma.

SteppingStoneSpouse.name: Stepping Stone Spouse
SteppingStoneSpouse.def: A partner sacrifices for their spouse only to be left behind when fortunes increase.

StrictParentsMakeSneakyKids.name: Strict Parents Make Sneaky Kids
StrictParentsMakeSneakyKids.def: Super strict parenting causes the children to become good at hiding things from their parents.

SuccessfulSiblingSyndrome.name: Successful Sibling Syndrome
SuccessfulSiblingSyndrome.def: A character feels overshadowed by their more successful sibling.

SuperFamilyTeam.name: Super Family Team
SuperFamilyTeam.def: A superhero team who happens to be a family.

SupportYourParents.name: Support Your Parents
SupportYourParents.def: A child decides to financially support their parents.

SurpriseSibling.name: Surprise Sibling
SurpriseSibling.def: When a character's sibling shows up in the story with no mention prior to their arrival.

TangledFamilyTree.name: Tangled Family Tree
TangledFamilyTree.def: A family tree with a little too much incest going on.

TeasingParent.name: Teasing Parent
TeasingParent.def: Parent(s) teasing their children and/or playing jokes on them.

ThatThingIsNotMyChild.name: That Thing Is Not My Child!
ThatThingIsNotMyChild.def: A character refuses to consider a clone or artificially created person made from their DNA to be their family member.

ThickerThanWater.name: Thicker Than Water
ThickerThanWater.def: Loyalty to family members always comes first.

ThreeSuccessfulGenerations.name: Three Successful Generations
ThreeSuccessfulGenerations.def: Successive family members that have achieved success.

TokenHouseguest.name: Token Houseguest
TokenHouseguest.def: Someone who lives with a family, even though they might not be related.

UndercoverAsFamily.name: Undercover as Family
UndercoverAsFamily.def: Unrelated characters pretending to be family or lovers while undercover.

UnpleasantParentReveal.name: Unpleasant Parent Reveal
UnpleasantParentReveal.def: A character meets their missing parent, only to find out that they're not anything like the child had hoped they would be.

VillainousLineage.name: Villainous Lineage
VillainousLineage.def: When characters are born into an evil family, they run the risk of becoming evil themselves.

WackyParentSeriousChild.name: Wacky Parent, Serious Child
WackyParentSeriousChild.def: The parent is spontaneous and goofy while the child is more sensible and The Stoic .

WhatIfTheBabyIsLikeMe.name: What If the Baby Is Like Me
WhatIfTheBabyIsLikeMe.def: A parent to be worries about their child inheriting their negative traits.

WoobieFamily.name: Woobie Family
WoobieFamily.def: A family that's prone to misfortune.

YourTraditionIsNotMine.name: Your Tradition Is Not Mine
YourTraditionIsNotMine.def: A character rebels against their family's way of living.

AbandonmentInducedAnimosity.name: Abandonment-Induced Animosity
AbandonmentInducedAnimosity.def: A character was left behind in the past by their allies, letting them face capture or death on their own.

AssassinsAreAlwaysBetrayed.name: Assassins Are Always Betrayed
AssassinsAreAlwaysBetrayed.def: Professional killers are always at risk of being double-crossed by their employers.

BackupAbstention.name: Backup Abstention
BackupAbstention.def: Someone you counted on to provide backup in a bad situation just leaves you to deal with it on your own.

BastardUnderstudy.name: Bastard Understudy
BastardUnderstudy.def: A villain's underling biding their time until they can betray the villain.

BecauseYouCanCope.name: Because You Can Cope
BecauseYouCanCope.def: A character abandons someone they're charged with taking care of when it becomes clear that the charge doesn't need them anymore.

BetrayalByInaction.name: Betrayal by Inaction
BetrayalByInaction.def: Leaving someone to suffer or die instead of helping them.

BetrayalByOffspring.name: Betrayal by Offspring
BetrayalByOffspring.def: A parent is betrayed by one of their children.

BetrayalInsurance.name: Betrayal Insurance
BetrayalInsurance.def: A character makes plans against someone in case that person decides to turn on them.

BigBadFriend.name: Big Bad Friend
BigBadFriend.def: The hero's friend turns out to be the main villain.

BrokenPedestal.name: Broken Pedestal
BrokenPedestal.def: Someone finds out that the person they idolized wasn't quite as heroic and noble as they thought they were.

CategoryTraitor.name: Category Traitor
CategoryTraitor.def: Someone gets accused of betrayal for liking or doing something that goes against their culture.

CavalryBetrayal.name: Cavalry Betrayal
CavalryBetrayal.def: The Cavalry has arrived! Wait... why are they shooting us instead of helping us?!

CavalryRefusal.name: Cavalry Refusal
CavalryRefusal.def: Your supposed rescue party isn't interested in saving you.

ChronicBackstabbingDisorder.name: Chronic Backstabbing Disorder
ChronicBackstabbingDisorder.def: A character who always stabs everyone they help out in the back.

LesCollaborateurs.name: Les Collaborateurs
LesCollaborateurs.def: Characters or governments who collaborate with an occupying power against their people.

ConfidentialityBetrayal.name: Confidentiality Betrayal
ConfidentialityBetrayal.def: A character tells another character's secret to third parties, making it no longer a secret.

ConflictingLoyalty.name: Conflicting Loyalty
ConflictingLoyalty.def: A character must choose between two sides that they're on.

TheCorruptible.name: The Corruptible
TheCorruptible.def: A character under the sway of The Corrupter or otherwise in danger of betraying their side.

TheCoup.name: The Coup
TheCoup.def: A government is overthrown and replaced, usually by a subordinate official seeking to hold leadership over it. Military Coup : When a (usually civilian) government is ousted and replaced by their own military officers.

DefectingForLove.name: Defecting for Love
DefectingForLove.def: A character switches sides due to falling in love with someone of the other camp.

DefectorFromDecadence.name: Defector from Decadence
DefectorFromDecadence.def: Someone leaves behind a group they're a part of out of disgust at their bad ways.

DevourTheDragon.name: Devour the Dragon
DevourTheDragon.def: The Big Bad kills his top minion to get stronger.

DisguisedHostageGambit.name: Disguised Hostage Gambit
DisguisedHostageGambit.def: The villains disguise innocent hostages as their minions in hopes of getting them killed by their would-be rescuers.

DoctorVonTurncoat.name: Doctor von Turncoat
DoctorVonTurncoat.def: A war criminal with valuable expertise is given immunity by their former enemies in exchange for working for them.

DoubleAgent.name: Double Agent
DoubleAgent.def: A member of an organization who is secretly a mole working for an opposing organization. Double Reverse Quadruple Agent : A character is affiliated with way too many opposing factions at once.

TheMole.name: The Mole
TheMole.def: A cover agent who infiltrates the opposing organization by pretending to be on their side. Bait the Mole : Rooting out a mole by giving different information to different suspects.

FeedTheMole.name: Feed the Mole
FeedTheMole.def: The hero gives the villain false information.

MistakenlyAttackedMole.name: Mistakenly Attacked Mole
MistakenlyAttackedMole.def: Attack someone you didn't know was your mole.

MoleInCharge.name: Mole in Charge
MoleInCharge.def: A character becomes the leader of a group and destroys it.

EtTuBrute.name: Et Tu, Brute?
EtTuBrute.def: A person is betrayed by the one they trusted most.

EvilAllAlong.name: Evil All Along
EvilAllAlong.def: A character thought to be on the side of good has actually been evil from the start.

FaceHeelTurn.name: Face–Heel Turn
FaceHeelTurn.def: A good guy becomes evil. Heel–Face Turn : A bad guy becomes good.

HeelFaceBrainwashing.name: Heel–Face Brainwashing
HeelFaceBrainwashing.def: A bad guy gets brainwashed or hypnotized into being good.

HazyFeelTurn.name: Hazy–Feel Turn
HazyFeelTurn.def: A character betrays one group and sides with another, but it's unclear whether either group is good or evil.

HeelFaceRevolvingDoor.name: Heel–Face Revolving Door
HeelFaceRevolvingDoor.def: The character keeps switching between being good and being evil.

HeelFaceDoorSlam.name: Heel–Face Door-Slam
HeelFaceDoorSlam.def: An evil character tries to change their ways, but either no one will accept that they genuinely want to make amends for what they did, or another evil character does something really bad to them before they can make any progress.

HighHeelFaceTurn.name: High-Heel–Face Turn
HighHeelFaceTurn.def: The sole female villain ends up reforming.

FailureToSaveMurder.name: Failure-to-Save Murder
FailureToSaveMurder.def: When a character blames a hero for letting someone die, when that hero did everything in their power to save them.

FakeDefector.name: Fake Defector
FakeDefector.def: A good guy pretends to change sides to pull one over the enemy.

FalseFriend.name: False Friend
FalseFriend.def: They were only pretending to be your friend so they could manipulate you into advancing their scheme.

FalseInnocenceTrick.name: False Innocence Trick
FalseInnocenceTrick.def: A villain feigns innocence in order to set up the heroes for something nasty.

TheFarmerAndTheViper.name: The Farmer and the Viper
TheFarmerAndTheViper.def: An act of kindness to a villain is repaid by the villain betraying the one who did them the good turn.

FindingJudas.name: Finding Judas
FindingJudas.def: Betrayal for benevolent reasons by a non-villain.

GoingNative.name: Going Native
GoingNative.def: Finding more in common with another group than your own, sometimes to the point of betrayal.

GoldFever.name: Gold Fever
GoldFever.def: Greed for riches drives you to betray your friends.

TheHeretic.name: The Heretic
TheHeretic.def: A character who betrays their religion, or whose beliefs are seen as a betrayal by their religion.

HeroicTeamRevolt.name: Heroic Team Revolt
HeroicTeamRevolt.def: The hero's True Companions turn against them and leave due to the hero's very unheroic and immoral behavior.

HoardingTheProfits.name: Hoarding the Profits
HoardingTheProfits.def: When an individual or small group steals the gains from the larger group they are part of.

HuntingTheRogue.name: Hunting the Rogue
HuntingTheRogue.def: A rogue agent deserts from an organization they served and they're chased as a result.

ICanRuleAlone.name: I Can Rule Alone
ICanRuleAlone.def: One half of a Duumvirate decides to backstab the other half in order to take full power for themselves.

InevitableMutualBetrayal.name: Inevitable Mutual Betrayal
InevitableMutualBetrayal.def: Two sides form an alliance with the explicit intent of betraying each other when it's done.

InsideJob.name: Inside Job
InsideJob.def: A crime is committed or assisted by someone affiliated with the target.

InstantAllegianceArtifact.name: Instant Allegiance Artifact
InstantAllegianceArtifact.def: A piece of Applied Phlebotinum that alters one's mind and can make someone change sides.

IWillPunishYourFriendForYourFailure.name: I Will Punish Your Friend for Your Failure
IWillPunishYourFriendForYourFailure.def: A villain hurts someone a person cares about in order to punish them for something they did.

LovableTraitor.name: Lovable Traitor
LovableTraitor.def: A character with a likeable personality and a penchant for stabbing folks in the back.

LoveInterestTraitor.name: Love-Interest Traitor
LoveInterestTraitor.def: Surprise! Someone you thought you could love is working for the other side!

LoveMakesYouEvil.name: Love Makes You Evil
LoveMakesYouEvil.def: Love can be an ugly thing that can bring out someone's worst, sometimes to the point of betrayal.

LuredIntoATrap.name: Lured into a Trap
LuredIntoATrap.def: Someone, sometimes someone who is normally someone's friend, betrays them by leading them into a trap by people who mean the person harm.

MistakenForBetrayal.name: Mistaken for Betrayal
MistakenForBetrayal.def: Something happens to cause a rift between two friends and make them believe that one has betrayed the other.

MistreatmentInducedBetrayal.name: Mistreatment-Induced Betrayal
MistreatmentInducedBetrayal.def: Someone is betrayed by another, and the former repays this abuse by turning on the latter.

TheMutiny.name: The Mutiny
TheMutiny.def: Insurrection aboard a ship against the ship's captain or commander. Anti-Mutiny : Insurrection against a captain or a commander who has chosen to defy their original orders.

NastyParty.name: Nasty Party
NastyParty.def: A "party" intended to get people together for betrayal and elimination.

NoHonorAmongThieves.name: No Honor Among Thieves
NoHonorAmongThieves.def: Criminals are willing to betray each other if it suits them.

TheOathbreaker.name: The Oath-Breaker
TheOathbreaker.def: Breaking an oath is one of the most basic forms of betrayal.

ObviousJudas.name: Obvious Judas
ObviousJudas.def: YMMV trope where it's painfully obvious to the audience that a character will betray the rest.

TheParagonAlwaysRebels.name: The Paragon Always Rebels
TheParagonAlwaysRebels.def: The "big figure" of the good guys suddenly decides to rebel for some reason.

ParentalBetrayal.name: Parental Betrayal
ParentalBetrayal.def: When a parent (a mother or father) betrays their own offspring.

PersonalHorror.name: Personal Horror
PersonalHorror.def: The one thing worse than being betrayed by others is betraying yourself and your sense of who you are.

PlayingTheEnemy.name: Playing the Enemy
PlayingTheEnemy.def: Transforming your appearance to appear like you're part of the enemy party in a Player Versus Player game.

PleaseShootTheMessenger.name: Please Shoot the Messenger
PleaseShootTheMessenger.def: When a messenger is sent to someone with a message instructing the receiver to kill them.

PopularityCycle.name: Popularity Cycle
PopularityCycle.def: Enjoy being popular. You're inevitably going to lose it.

PostBetrayalJustification.name: Post-Betrayal Justification
PostBetrayalJustification.def: A character explains their reasons for betrayal.

PostSupportRegret.name: Post-Support Regret
PostSupportRegret.def: A character is betrayed by someone they cared and vouched for against people who talked badly about them, making them regret defending and believing in them.

PrisonersDilemma.name: Prisoner's Dilemma
PrisonersDilemma.def: Do you cooperate, stay silent and hope your partner doesn't betray you, or do you rat them out and hope they don't do the same to you?

ProppingUpTheirPatsy.name: Propping Up Their Patsy
ProppingUpTheirPatsy.def: A culprit proclaims the innocence of another suspect to conceal their own culpability or further their own agenda.

PushedAtTheMonster.name: Pushed at the Monster
PushedAtTheMonster.def: I don't have to outrun the monster. I just have to outrun you .

TheQuisling.name: The Quisling
TheQuisling.def: Someone decides to pledge allegiance to an invading force, selling out their own country or world.

RashEquilibrium.name: Rash Equilibrium
RashEquilibrium.def: A meeting between enemies has both sides making plans against the other in response to trickery from the other side.

RebelliousRebel.name: Rebellious Rebel
RebelliousRebel.def: Rebelling against a group of rebels .

RegretfulTraitor.name: Regretful Traitor
RegretfulTraitor.def: A traitor who finds that backstabbing their friends wasn't worth it after all.

RenegadeSplinterFaction.name: Renegade Splinter Faction
RenegadeSplinterFaction.def: An evil, crazy or fanatical offshoot of a more respectable organization, often viewed as traitors by the other organization.

RestrictedRescueOperation.name: Restricted Rescue Operation
RestrictedRescueOperation.def: Outside forces restrict a rescue operation, often in ways that force heroes to act against their own morality.

SalvagePirates.name: Salvage Pirates
SalvagePirates.def: They don't intend to save you. They just want your stuff, and you are merely collateral.

SavedToEnslave.name: Saved to Enslave
SavedToEnslave.def: Someone saved your life only to put you in their service.

ShootTheDangerousMinion.name: Shoot the Dangerous Minion
ShootTheDangerousMinion.def: A villain's minion is getting too dangerous for his own good! Better get rid of them before they start getting ideas...

SixthRangerTraitor.name: Sixth Ranger Traitor
SixthRangerTraitor.def: The newest member of the team turns out to secretly be a villain intent on destroying the group from within.

TheSmartOneTurnsTraitor.name: The Smart One Turns Traitor
TheSmartOneTurnsTraitor.def: The smartest or wisest of a team turns out to be or ends up becoming a traitor to their group and their cause.

SocialDeductionGame.name: Social Deduction Game
SocialDeductionGame.def: A game where one or more players is secretly a traitor.

SomebodySetUpUsTheBomb.name: Somebody Set Up Us the Bomb
SomebodySetUpUsTheBomb.def: Sneaking a bomb into enemy territory.

SpiesAreDespicable.name: Spies are Despicable
SpiesAreDespicable.def: Spies are viewed as bad people because of the propensity for betraying and lying to people as part of their work.

StealingTheCredit.name: Stealing the Credit
StealingTheCredit.def: A character betrays someone by taking all the credit for their accomplishments.

SubvertedSuspicionAesop.name: Subverted Suspicion Aesop
SubvertedSuspicionAesop.def: Someone believes a character claiming to be good or reformed to be untrustworthy. After it looks like they're just being paranoid, their suspicions of the other person really being evil become validated.

TemporaryPartyMemberToVillain.name: Temporary Party Member to Villain
TemporaryPartyMemberToVillain.def: A Guest-Star Party Member that betrays the party and later fights it.

ThirtyPiecesOfSilver.name: Thirty Pieces of Silver
ThirtyPiecesOfSilver.def: Someone accuses someone of betrayal by referencing thirty pieces of silver.

TraitorShot.name: Traitor Shot
TraitorShot.def: A close-up of a character that is meant to draw suspicion upon the character.

TranshumanTreachery.name: Transhuman Treachery
TranshumanTreachery.def: A character who becomes something other than human abandons and seeks to prey upon their former species.

TreacherousAdvisor.name: Treacherous Advisor
TreacherousAdvisor.def: A mentor or other important character betrays the one they're teaching or looking out for.

TreacherousQuestGiver.name: Treacherous Quest Giver
TreacherousQuestGiver.def: A character giving you a mission has ulterior motives for the mission and turns on you either during or after the mission.

TreacheryCoverUp.name: Treachery Cover-Up
TreacheryCoverUp.def: A treacherous deed needs to be covered up, for the perceived greater good.

TreacheryIsASpecialKindOfEvil.name: Treachery Is a Special Kind of Evil
TreacheryIsASpecialKindOfEvil.def: Betrayal is treated as being worse than any other evil act a villain has done. Kinslaying Is a Special Kind of Evil : Murdering members of one's own family is almost universally considered to be perhaps the most wicked form of betrayal.

TroubleMagnetGambit.name: Trouble Magnet Gambit
TroubleMagnetGambit.def: A character betrays someone by planting something on them that will get the other person in deep trouble.

TruceTrickery.name: Truce Trickery
TruceTrickery.def: Making an end-run around or blatantly violating a ceasefire or peace treaty.

Turncoat.name: Turncoat
Turncoat.def: A character that switches sides in order to help out the other side.

UndercoverWhenAlone.name: Undercover When Alone
UndercoverWhenAlone.def: A character keeps up their cover even when there is no one to see them.

UriahGambit.name: Uriah Gambit
UriahGambit.def: A subordinate is sent on a mission meant to get rid of them.

TheUsurper.name: The Usurper
TheUsurper.def: Someone who seizes a position of power away from its legitimate holder; such as a monarch being overthrown by another royal seeking to hold the throne themselves.

VichyEarth.name: Vichy Earth
VichyEarth.def: Aliens rule humanity instead of exterminating us, complete with Les Collaborateurs among the human side.

WasItAllALie.name: Was It All a Lie?
WasItAllALie.def: Someone finds out that they have been lied to by a loved one and ponders whether the fabrication means that everything concerning their relationship with this person was insincere. Becoming the Mask : What was intended to be the cover of the mole ends up becoming how they really are.

WeComeInPeaceShootToKill.name: We Come in Peace — Shoot to Kill
WeComeInPeaceShootToKill.def: First Contact with aliens ends badly.

WelcomeBackTraitor.name: Welcome Back, Traitor
WelcomeBackTraitor.def: A character who once betrayed the group is welcomed back with open arms.

WeUsedToBeFriends.name: We Used to Be Friends
WeUsedToBeFriends.def: Bitter rivals used to be the best of friends.

WhoNeedsEnemies.name: Who Needs Enemies?
WhoNeedsEnemies.def: Characters on the heroes' side are willing to betray others for their own goals.

WrongSideAllAlong.name: Wrong Side All Along
WrongSideAllAlong.def: It turns out the heroes were unwittingly helping the bad guys.

AccuserOfTheBrethren.name: Accuser of the Brethren
AccuserOfTheBrethren.def: I don't care if you're sorry and want to make amends! I won't forgive you and I will punish you!

AccompliceByInaction.name: Accomplice by Inaction
AccompliceByInaction.def: You did nothing to save me from injustice even though you could. Therefore, I'm gonna end you!

AfterlifeAvenger.name: Afterlife Avenger
AfterlifeAvenger.def: I'm gonna get my revenge, even after you die and run off into the afterlife. You will not escape me!

AllianceOfRevenge.name: Alliance of Revenge
AllianceOfRevenge.def: You didn't just piss me off. You pissed a lot of others off. And we've banded together to take you down.

AllianceOfWomenScorned.name: Alliance of Women Scorned
AllianceOfWomenScorned.def: We're all the women you've ever hurt, or who've been hurt by men in general, banding together!

AndThisIsFor.name: And This Is for...
AndThisIsFor.def: Announcing why the recipient deserves the revenge inflicted upon them, usually naming someone being avenged.

AngerIsHealthyAesop.name: "Anger Is Healthy" Aesop
AngerIsHealthyAesop.def: It's good to be angry so you've got nothing to feel bad about.

AnimalNemesis.name: Animal Nemesis
AnimalNemesis.def: I'm gonna get my revenge against that irritating creature!

AttackOnOneIsAnAttackOnAll.name: Attack on One Is an Attack on All
AttackOnOneIsAnAttackOnAll.def: You harmed one of our members of my group, nation, or race. Now all of us are gonna tear you apart!

AuthorsRetaliation.name: Author's Retaliation
AuthorsRetaliation.def: A character insults the work's production values , so the creators screw with the story/world.

AvengingTheVillain.name: Avenging the Villain
AvengingTheVillain.def: You killed my evil leader, and now I will avenge them by hunting you down!

BestServedCold.name: Best Served Cold
BestServedCold.def: I'm gonna take my time in paying you back for what you've done to me.

BewilderingPunishment.name: Bewildering Punishment
BewilderingPunishment.def: What did I do to you that made you so vengeful?

BuyThemOff.name: Buy Them Off
BuyThemOff.def: Trying to buy off the victim of a crime so they will not seek revenge when they learn that the person has wronged them.

CameBackWithAVengeance.name: Came Back with a Vengeance
CameBackWithAVengeance.def: You ruined my life and sent me away to rot in exile, but I'm back with new skills, a new identity, and a meticulous plan to destroy everything you love.

ColorMeBlack.name: Color Me Black
ColorMeBlack.def: You treated me like crap because I'm from a different race. Now I'm gonna turn you into the very thing you hate, you racist prick!

CycleOfRevenge.name: Cycle of Revenge
CycleOfRevenge.def: You harmed me, and I harmed you... and your friend harmed me, and my friend harmed them... and so it goes on...

DefeatAsBackstory.name: Defeat as Backstory
DefeatAsBackstory.def: I can never forget how you defeated me, and I demand a rematch!

DemandingTheirHead.name: Demanding Their Head
DemandingTheirHead.def: You've crossed me, and now I'm calling for your head to be brought to me on a silver platter, whatever the price may be!

DesignatedBullet.name: Designated Bullet
DesignatedBullet.def: I'm crafting a specific special bullet just for you. And it's gonna be the worst feeling you will ever have in your life!

DisproportionateRetribution.name: Disproportionate Retribution
DisproportionateRetribution.def: Two eyes for an eye, all teeth for a tooth, all limbs for a limb.

EscalatingWar.name: Escalating War
EscalatingWar.def: When one minor slight leads to a situation where opposing sides have to come up with larger and larger schemes to one-up their opponent.

ExtremeMeleeRevenge.name: Extreme Melee Revenge
ExtremeMeleeRevenge.def: I'm gonna beat your head in over and over and over... And even when you're a bloody mess, I'm gonna keep on beating you!

FamilialCannibalismSurprise.name: Familial Cannibalism Surprise
FamilialCannibalismSurprise.def: Serving one's enemy a meal consisting of their offspring.

ForcedAddiction.name: Forced Addiction
ForcedAddiction.def: Someone is turned into an addict by force or manipulation to get them back for interfering with someone who's usually in the drug trade in one way or another.

GaiasVengeance.name: Gaia's Vengeance
GaiasVengeance.def: You tiny humans have abused Mother Nature for far too long! Now you must suffer my wrath!

GenocideBackfire.name: Genocide Backfire
GenocideBackfire.def: Someone trying to wipe out a people to keep them from destroying oneself will only give the survivors (and there are always survivors) all the reason they need to destroy that person.

GoodIsNotSoft.name: Good Is Not Soft
GoodIsNotSoft.def: I may be a virtuous and idealistic hero everyone desires to be, but I will not hesitate to harshly punish anybody who has done any kind of wrongdoing, especially towards the innocent.

GypsyCurse.name: Gypsy Curse
GypsyCurse.def: A curse that is more about vengeance and spite than actual justice. Expect it to be disproportionate .

TheHunterBecomesTheHunted.name: The Hunter Becomes the Hunted
TheHunterBecomesTheHunted.def: I'm sick and tired of running away from you bastards! Now it's time I make you run away from me !

InfantilizationRetaliation.name: Infantilization Retaliation
InfantilizationRetaliation.def: How dare you treat me like a baby! Time for some pain!

Inugami.name: Inugami
Inugami.def: Dog Yōkai created through a cruel ritual and who, when mistreated, devours its owner.

ItsNotAboutTheRequest.name: It's Not About the Request
ItsNotAboutTheRequest.def: Normally I wouldn't be opposed to doing the thing you asked or ordered me to do, but because you've been a jerk to me I'm going to refuse because it'll hurt you.

ItsPersonal.name: It's Personal
ItsPersonal.def: It sure is. You hurt someone dear to me. Now I'm gonna fucking kill you!

ItsPersonalWithTheDragon.name: It's Personal with the Dragon
ItsPersonalWithTheDragon.def: It's not the Big Bad I'm concerned about. His right-hand man is what I want to go after. It won't be settled until one of them is dead.

MisplacedRetribution.name: Misplaced Retribution
MisplacedRetribution.def: It doesn't matter if you're not responsible for what the offender did to me. Nevertheless, you're going down. After all, you're in the wrong place at the wrong time.

NoSympathyForGrudgeholders.name: No Sympathy for Grudgeholders
NoSympathyForGrudgeholders.def: How dare you seek vengeance against your tormentors! You're just as bad as they are!

OppositesAttractRevenge.name: Opposites Attract Revenge
OppositesAttractRevenge.def: A character's love interest leaves them for their ideological opposite, causing a feud.

ParanoiaGambit.name: Paranoia Gambit
ParanoiaGambit.def: A Batman Gambit involving the victim sabotaging oneself out of paranoia.

ParkingPayback.name: Parking Payback
ParkingPayback.def: That was my spot you were parking at, asshole! Now I'm gonna kick your ass!

PayEvilUntoEvil.name: Pay Evil unto Evil
PayEvilUntoEvil.def: It's what revenge is all about. The evil you've done to me, I will do to you!

PervertRevengeMode.name: Pervert Revenge Mode
PervertRevengeMode.def: Caught doing something perverted? This person will see immediate revenge on the perpetrator.

PettyChildhoodGrudge.name: Petty Childhood Grudge
PettyChildhoodGrudge.def: It may have happened when we were kids, but I still hate you for it!

RageAgainstTheLegalSystem.name: Rage Against the Legal System
RageAgainstTheLegalSystem.def: The legal system had put me through hell. Now I'm gonna make them suffer dearly!

RapeAndRevenge.name: Rape and Revenge
RapeAndRevenge.def: You've raped me/someone I love, and I will kill you!

RationalizingTheOverkill.name: Rationalizing the Overkill
RationalizingTheOverkill.def: My revenge ended up going too far/causing collateral damage, but it was well worth it!

RelativeButton.name: Relative Button
RelativeButton.def: A person finally confronts another over the family members they murdered.

RememberTheAlamo.name: Remember the Alamo!
RememberTheAlamo.def: A battle cry named for an enemy atrocity; a call for revenge in war.

ResurrectionRevenge.name: Resurrection Revenge
ResurrectionRevenge.def: I've come Back from the Dead to avenge my own death!

ReunionRevenge.name: Reunion Revenge
ReunionRevenge.def: It's time I go to my Class Reunion and torment all of those assholes who bullied me in the past!

RevengeAgainstMen.name: Revenge Against Men
RevengeAgainstMen.def: Men have caused me so much pain! Therefore, all of the men deserve death or at least a cruel punishment!

RevengeBallad.name: Revenge Ballad
RevengeBallad.def: I'm on my way to get revenge! Time to sing a song about it!

RevengeBeforeReason.name: Revenge Before Reason
RevengeBeforeReason.def: This isn't about common sense! This is about revenge, so get out of my way!

RevengeByProxy.name: Revenge by Proxy
RevengeByProxy.def: You killed someone I loved, so now I'm gonna kill someone you loved!

RevengeFic.name: Revenge Fic
RevengeFic.def: I hate this character and I'm gonna write a Fan Fic where I will make his life a living Hell!

RevengeIsADishBestServed.name: Revenge Is a Dish Best Served
RevengeIsADishBestServed.def: What better way to get back at you than to make you eat something so disgusting!

RevengeIsSweet.name: Revenge Is Sweet
RevengeIsSweet.def: I finally obtained my revenge and it was worth it!

RevengeIsNotJustice.name: Revenge Is Not Justice
RevengeIsNotJustice.def: I know they hurt you but this isn't justice!

RevengeMyopia.name: Revenge Myopia
RevengeMyopia.def: I don't care if you were trying to get even with me or acting out of self-defense! I'm still getting revenge on you for that! I never get even with anybody!

RevengeOfTheNerd.name: Revenge of the Nerd
RevengeOfTheNerd.def: So you think I'm hot, huh? Remember me? I'm the one you made fun of for being too geeky for you and having bad teeth! So since you mocked me when I looked like a geek, I'm rejecting you to show you how it feels!

RevengeOfTheSequel.name: Revenge of the Sequel
RevengeOfTheSequel.def: You haven't seen the last of me, hero! We Will Meet Again in the next part of the story, when I shall get my vengeance upon you!

RevengeOnTheBully.name: Revenge on the Bully
RevengeOnTheBully.def: You bullied me, and now I'm going to pay it back.

RevengeRevealStory.name: Revenge Reveal Story
RevengeRevealStory.def: You want to know why I want revenge against you? Let me explain.

RevengeRomance.name: Revenge Romance
RevengeRomance.def: Romancing someone to get revenge on an ex.

RevengeSVP.name: RevengeSVP
RevengeSVP.def: You didn't invite me to your party. Now I'm gonna pay you a very special visit...

RevengeThroughCorruption.name: Revenge Through Corruption
RevengeThroughCorruption.def: You hurt me, so I'll go find your friend or lover... corrupt them and turn them against you! Maybe just your little dog will also suffice!

RevengeViaStorytelling.name: Revenge via Storytelling
RevengeViaStorytelling.def: I don't like you, and I'm going to make you look ridiculous in my story!

RoaringRampageOfRevenge.name: Roaring Rampage of Revenge
RoaringRampageOfRevenge.def: Forget plotting my vengeance! I want to get them through raging violence!

ScrewTheMoneyThisIsPersonal.name: Screw the Money, This Is Personal!
ScrewTheMoneyThisIsPersonal.def: You think money is going to buy your way out of this?! Think again...

SinsOfOurFathers.name: Sins of Our Fathers
SinsOfOurFathers.def: Children must be punished for what their parents have done!

SparedButNotForgiven.name: Spared, but Not Forgiven
SparedButNotForgiven.def: You caused me a lot of pain and for that I'll never forgive you, but I won't lash out at you for it in the name of revenge.

SpitefulSurcharge.name: Spiteful Surcharge
SpitefulSurcharge.def: You did me wrong, so I'll double-charge you for my services!

SuccessAsRevenge.name: Success as Revenge
SuccessAsRevenge.def: The best way to repay you for what you've done to me is by living a good life while you end up being miserable.

ATasteOfTheirOwnMedicine.name: A Taste of Their Own Medicine
ATasteOfTheirOwnMedicine.def: Someone receives the same bad treatment that they've shown/they were going to show others.

ThenLetMeBeEvil.name: Then Let Me Be Evil
ThenLetMeBeEvil.def: They've treated me like a monster. Guess what? They've created a monster and I will destroy every last one of them until there's no one left!

ThisIsUnforgivable.name: This Is Unforgivable!
ThisIsUnforgivable.def: What you did is unforgivable, so I'm gonna give you some well-deserved payback!

ThisMeansWar.name: This Means War!
ThisMeansWar.def: That's it! You've done it now! Time to take you to war!

UpsettingTheBalance.name: Upsetting the Balance
UpsettingTheBalance.def: As someone in the heavens who support balance, we must punish the sinner for ruining the balance maintaining the world.

UtilitarianRevenge.name: Utilitarian Revenge
UtilitarianRevenge.def: I'm not just here to make you suffer for what you did to me - I'm also doing something really important!

VengeanceDenied.name: Vengeance Denied
VengeanceDenied.def: I've come to get revenge, but circumstances have prevented this from happening.

VengeanceDrivenVillain.name: Vengeance-Driven Villain
