VengeanceDrivenVillain.def: A villain whose only motivation is getting revenge for being wronged in the past.

VengeanceFeelsEmpty.name: Vengeance Feels Empty
VengeanceFeelsEmpty.def: I've successfully gotten my revenge... now I have no idea what to do.

VengefulAbandonedToy.name: Vengeful Abandoned Toy
VengefulAbandonedToy.def: I'm coming after the child who got bored of me and threw me away when I stopped being fun!

VengefulGhost.name: Vengeful Ghost
VengefulGhost.def: I am a ghost of your past and now I will make you suffer for your sins!

VillainByProxyFallacy.name: Villain-by-Proxy Fallacy
VillainByProxyFallacy.def: When someone goes after not only a crime's perpetrator, but those who supplied the perpetrator or were otherwise marginally connected to it, whether or not the people involved had anything to do with the actual crime.

TheVillainMustBePunished.name: The Villain Must Be Punished
TheVillainMustBePunished.def: The villain must pay for their crimes; merely foiling their plans isn't enough.

VoodooDoll.name: Voodoo Doll
VoodooDoll.def: The best way to get back at my enemy is to torture them with a doll that looks just like them. I'm gonna enjoy this.

WhosLaughingNow.name: Who's Laughing Now?
WhosLaughingNow.def: They've treated me like a joke. Now I will be their worst nightmare!

YouKilledMyFather.name: You Killed My Father
YouKilledMyFather.def: ...and now I will kill you in return!

ZeroPercentApprovalRating.name: 0% Approval Rating
ZeroPercentApprovalRating.def: An authority figure hated by all.

AlienNonInterferenceClause.name: Alien Non-Interference Clause
AlienNonInterferenceClause.def: Aliens are forbidden from meddling with the affairs of humans.

ArtisticLicenseEducation.name: Artistic License – Education
ArtisticLicenseEducation.def: In the case of teachers and other school staff exerting their authority over students when, in real life, they should not have that much authority.

AsskickingLeadsToLeadership.name: Asskicking Leads to Leadership
AsskickingLeadsToLeadership.def: The best fighter becomes the one in charge.

AuthoritativeInPublicDocileInPrivate.name: Authoritative in Public, Docile in Private
AuthoritativeInPublicDocileInPrivate.def: Someone in a position of authority is markedly submissive when it comes to their personal life and romantic relationships.

AuthoritySoundsDeep.name: Authority Sounds Deep
AuthoritySoundsDeep.def: An authority figure's status is signaled by their deep voice.

BavarianFireDrill.name: Bavarian Fire Drill
BavarianFireDrill.def: Deceiving people by pretending to be an authority figure.

BringThemAround.name: Bring Them Around
BringThemAround.def: A hero or villain switching sides needs to convince her underlings to jump ship with her.

DependingUponTheUndependable.name: Depending Upon the Undependable
DependingUponTheUndependable.def: An authority figure keeps hiring or promoting incompetent people even though they know (or should know) disaster will always result.

EvilOverlordList.name: Evil Overlord List
EvilOverlordList.def: A list of things one must consider if they ever decide to become an evil overlord in order to prevent ever being defeated.

ForgotICouldChangeTheRules.name: Forgot I Could Change the Rules
ForgotICouldChangeTheRules.def: An authority figure forgets that it's within their power to change the rules.

GracefullyDemoted.name: Gracefully Demoted
GracefullyDemoted.def: Someone with a position of power accepts or even wants their demotion.

TheLeader.name: The Leader
TheLeader.def: The member of the group who calls the shots.

TheManBehindTheMonsters.name: The Man Behind the Monsters
TheManBehindTheMonsters.def: A human/someone resembling a human who leads an army of monsters that look less human.

NestedOwnership.name: Nested Ownership
NestedOwnership.def: Subordinates have their own subordinates, and this goes beyond the usual for the setting situation.

RankScalesWithAsskicking.name: Rank Scales with Asskicking
RankScalesWithAsskicking.def: Your skill in combat is equivalent to your rank in the hierarchy.

ScrewTheRulesIMakeThem.name: Screw the Rules, I Make Them!
ScrewTheRulesIMakeThem.def: An authority figure believes that being in charge makes them above the law.

SelfAppointedLeader.name: Self-Appointed Leader
SelfAppointedLeader.def: When the group's leader has no actual authority to hold the position.

SexualPredatorBoss.name: Sexual Predator Boss
SexualPredatorBoss.def: A boss sexually abuses their subordinates.

UnderStrangeManagement.name: Under Strange Management
UnderStrangeManagement.def: An organization is run by unexpected or unqualified people.

VerticalPowerPlay.name: Vertical Power Play
VerticalPowerPlay.def: A character positions themself to appear bigger as expression of power, or smaller as an expression of submission.

VolatileSecondTierPosition.name: Volatile Second Tier Position
VolatileSecondTierPosition.def: The second-highest job in a hierarchy, but with some very demanding drawbacks.

WhipOfDominance.name: Whip of Dominance
WhipOfDominance.def: Using a whip as a symbol of dominance, control, authority, or sadism.

CorruptCorporateExecutive.name: Corrupt Corporate Executive
CorruptCorporateExecutive.def: The head of a corporation is evil or at least very unscrupulous.

HonestCorporateExecutive.name: Honest Corporate Executive
HonestCorporateExecutive.def: The head of a corporation is honest and refuses to use their company to do anything illegal or unethical.

AnarchoTyranny.name: Anarcho-Tyranny
AnarchoTyranny.def: A corrupt government or tyrannical regime creates a state of Anarchy Is Chaos so everyone is too busy fighting each other to worry about them, criminal neglect on a nationwide scale.

JustTheFirstCitizen.name: Just the First Citizen
JustTheFirstCitizen.def: A monarch with a modest title.

MayorPain.name: Mayor Pain
MayorPain.def: A mayor who is either sketchy or incompetent.

PlanetBaron.name: Planet Baron
PlanetBaron.def: The ruler or owner of an entire planet.

RogueryBeforeLegitimacy.name: Roguery Before Legitimacy
RogueryBeforeLegitimacy.def: A rebel movement has all the authority of a legitimate government, but prefer to present themselves a rag-tag opposition movement.

RoyalFavorite.name: Royal Favorite
RoyalFavorite.def: Their authority is often second only to the monarch, due to the high regard the monarch has for them, regardless of actual position in society.

RoyalWe.name: Royal "We"
RoyalWe.def: Royalty addressing themselves with plural pronouns.

RoyalsWhoActuallyDoSomething.name: Royals Who Actually Do Something
RoyalsWhoActuallyDoSomething.def: A ruler who doesn't just sit around on the throne giving orders and actually does things to help their people.

SheIsTheKing.name: She Is the King
SheIsTheKing.def: A female ruler is addressed with a title that typically goes to men.

SuspiciouslySoloCop.name: Suspiciously Solo Cop
SuspiciouslySoloCop.def: When a Corrupt Cop is called out for acting alone and not calling for backup, indicating that their actions are not lawful (can also be applied to rogue members of a military or criminal organization).

GeneralFailure.name: General Failure
GeneralFailure.def: A general who is very incompetent.

GeneralRipper.name: General Ripper
GeneralRipper.def: A military leader who insanely pursues a vendetta against the enemy.

TheWarlord.name: The Warlord
TheWarlord.def: A military leader with power and authority beyond legal or official status.

AbsurdlyPowerfulStudentCouncil.name: Absurdly Powerful Student Council
AbsurdlyPowerfulStudentCouncil.def: The student body president and school council have way more power than they should have.

NonGivingUpSchoolGuy.name: Non-Giving-Up School Guy
NonGivingUpSchoolGuy.def: A person who won't rest until children playing hooky are forced to go class.

RedArmbandOfLeadership.name: Red Armband of Leadership
RedArmbandOfLeadership.def: Red armband signifying prefects or student council members in Japanese schools.

YellowSashOfPower.name: Yellow Sash of Power
YellowSashOfPower.def: Hall monitors having unreasonable amounts of power.

BreakingOutTheBoss.name: Breaking Out the Boss
BreakingOutTheBoss.def: A gang of criminals break their incarcerated boss from prison.

MookLieutenant.name: Mook Lieutenant
MookLieutenant.def: The villain's henchmen are led by one who has slightly more depth and difference from the rank-and-file goons.

Mooks.name: Mooks
Mooks.def: The generic underlings of the main villain.

AnimalLordOfTheWilds.name: Animal Lord of the Wilds
AnimalLordOfTheWilds.def: When an animal claims authority over a significant portion of territory and becomes respected and/or feared for it.

HighbornUnicorn.name: Highborn Unicorn
HighbornUnicorn.def: Unicorns are associated with elite distinction, leadership eligibility, and exceptionalism—either as possessions, companions, or symbols.

MultipleOfficialRulers.name: Multiple Official Rulers
MultipleOfficialRulers.def: A group has more than one ruler.

Nurarihyon.name: Nurarihyon
Nurarihyon.def: Humanoid with a deformed head regarded as the leader of all youkai.

PlayingTheAgeCard.name: Playing the Age Card
PlayingTheAgeCard.def: An older character feels that their age gives them authority over younger people.

AesopAmnesia.name: Aesop Amnesia
AesopAmnesia.def: A character learns an important lesson in one episode, but in subsequent episodes reverts back to their bad behavior as if the lesson they learned somehow didn't stick.

AlternateIdentityAmnesia.name: Alternate Identity Amnesia
AlternateIdentityAmnesia.def: A character suffers amnesia when changing into another form.

AmnesiacCostumeIdentity.name: Amnesiac Costume Identity
AmnesiacCostumeIdentity.def: A characters with amnesia tries to figure out who they are based on the unusual costume or outfit they are wearing.

AmnesiacDissonance.name: Amnesiac Dissonance
AmnesiacDissonance.def: A good or evil person suddenly remembers their past of the opposite alignment .

AmnesiacGod.name: Amnesiac God
AmnesiacGod.def: A character with amnesia who is actually a Physical God or something similar.

AmnesiacProtagonistCatalyst.name: Amnesiac Protagonist Catalyst
AmnesiacProtagonistCatalyst.def: The protagonist has forgotten something important about themselves when the story starts. Which is that they were responsible for what's currently wrong in the story.

AmnesiacResonance.name: Amnesiac Resonance
AmnesiacResonance.def: An amnesiac instinctively performs skills they had before losing their memory, without knowledge of how or why they know them.

AmnesiacsAreInnocent.name: Amnesiacs Are Innocent
AmnesiacsAreInnocent.def: People who lose their memory act as innocent as children.

AmnesiacVillainJoinsTheHeroes.name: Amnesiac Villain Joins the Heroes
AmnesiacVillainJoinsTheHeroes.def: A villain working for the heroes and is on the good side only because they forgot their own identity and their past.

AmnesiaDanger.name: Amnesia Danger
AmnesiaDanger.def: A character with amnesia is in a situation they would normally be able to handle, but can't because they don't remember how.

AmnesiaEpisode.name: Amnesia Episode
AmnesiaEpisode.def: An episode where a character develops amnesia.

AmnesiaLoop.name: Amnesia Loop
AmnesiaLoop.def: A person discovers something and gets their memories wiped repeatedly.

AmnesiaMissedASpot.name: Amnesia Missed a Spot
AmnesiaMissedASpot.def: A character tries to induce Laser-Guided Amnesia and it doesn't quite work.

AwesomenessInducedAmnesia.name: Awesomeness-Induced Amnesia
AwesomenessInducedAmnesia.def: A character does something awesome, but can't remember how they actually did it or what they even did.

BackstoryInvader.name: Backstory Invader
BackstoryInvader.def: A character who is implanted in the memories of other characters who don't really know them.

BagOfSpilling.name: Bag of Spilling
BagOfSpilling.def: A character loses all their items and abilities in the sequel.

BrainwashResidue.name: Brainwash Residue
BrainwashResidue.def: A person is no longer Brainwashed , but the effects still linger in their body.

ChekhovsAmnesia.name: Chekhovs Amnesia
ChekhovsAmnesia.def: If a character is mentioned to have memory loss, expect whatever they forgot and/or how they forgot it to become important later in the story .

ChildhoodHomeRediscovery.name: Childhood Home Rediscovery
ChildhoodHomeRediscovery.def: A character rediscovers a place that they lived as a child, but has no recollection of it as an adult.

CongruentMemory.name: Congruent Memory
CongruentMemory.def: A person learns something in a certain environment or emotional or physical state and can only remember what they learned when in that same state.

ConvenientlyUnverifiableCoverStory.name: Conveniently Unverifiable Cover Story
ConvenientlyUnverifiableCoverStory.def: A fake background, but it can't be disproven.

CrazyMemory.name: Crazy Memory
CrazyMemory.def: A character remembers an outrageous moment of their lives that may or may not have happened.

DamnYouMuscleMemory.name: Damn You, Muscle Memory!
DamnYouMuscleMemory.def: Difference in control layouts makes it easy to screw up.

DejaVu.name: Déjà Vu
DejaVu.def: The odd sensation of already having experienced something that is currently happening.

DemotedMemories.name: Demoted Memories
DemotedMemories.def: A person remembers that they used to be something great, but chooses not to believe that it's real.

DerailedTrainOfThought.name: Derailed Train of Thought
DerailedTrainOfThought.def: Someone forgets what they were talking about in favor of a totally unrelated topic.

EarthedMemories.name: Earthed Memories
EarthedMemories.def: Planet Earth is said to harbor memories of its own events and people.

EasyAmnesia.name: Easy Amnesia
EasyAmnesia.def: Developing amnesia through something as simple as being hit on the head.

EatBrainForMemories.name: Eat Brain for Memories
EatBrainForMemories.def: Gaining someone else's memories by consuming their brain.

ElephantsNeverForget.name: Elephants Never Forget
ElephantsNeverForget.def: Elephants are often depicted as having prodigiously strong and accurate memories.

EyeRecall.name: Eye Recall
EyeRecall.def: A flashback sequence that starts with the camera zooming inside the pupil of the character recalling the memory.

FakeMemories.name: Fake Memories
FakeMemories.def: Remembering something from the past that didn't actually happen.

FightingDownMemoryLane.name: Fighting Down Memory Lane
FightingDownMemoryLane.def: A character uses their opponent's memory as a weapon.

Flashback.name: Flashback
Flashback.def: The characters' reminiscence of past events are relayed to the audience through another scene.

FlashbackFail.name: Flashback Fail
FlashbackFail.def: A character tries to flashback to something that happened earlier, but that doesn't quite remember what actually happened or what was said.

FlashbackMontageRealization.name: Flashback-Montage Realization
FlashbackMontageRealization.def: A montage of previous scenes and lines of dialogue, representing a character remembering all the clues hinting at The Reveal .

TheFogOfAges.name: The Fog of Ages
TheFogOfAges.def: A character who has lived for so long that they start to forget common things.

ForgetsToEat.name: Forgets to Eat
ForgetsToEat.def: A character who's notorious for ignoring their body's need for nutrition and has to be reminded to eat.

ForgettableCharacter.name: Forgettable Character
ForgettableCharacter.def: A character who is often forgotten by other characters.

ForgivenButNotForgotten.name: Forgiven, but Not Forgotten
ForgivenButNotForgotten.def: A character forgives others, but still will not forget what they've done.

ForgotAboutHisPowers.name: Forgot About His Powers
ForgotAboutHisPowers.def: A character suddenly forgets a certain skill/ability that could easily get them out of a tough spot.

ForgotICouldntSwim.name: Forgot I Couldn't Swim
ForgotICouldntSwim.def: Going swimming, then remembering you don't know how.

ForgottenBirthday.name: Forgotten Birthday
ForgottenBirthday.def: No one notices a character's birthday.

ForgottenFirstMeeting.name: Forgotten First Meeting
ForgottenFirstMeeting.def: It's established that two characters actually met before what was believed to be their first meeting, they just didn't remember their real first meeting.

ForgottenStateOfUndress.name: Forgotten State of Undress
ForgottenStateOfUndress.def: A character is too preoccupied to notice their state of undress.

ForgotTheCall.name: Forgot the Call
ForgotTheCall.def: A character gets amnesia and forgets that they're an action hero.

ForgotTheCooking.name: Forgot the Cooking
ForgotTheCooking.def: Food being cooked is forgotten about, resulting in spoiled food, or fire.

ForgotTheDisability.name: Forgot the Disability
ForgotTheDisability.def: Forgetting that the person you're with is disabled.

ForgotTheirIntangibility.name: Forgot Their Intangibility
ForgotTheirIntangibility.def: An intangible character forgets they can't interact with the real world or that not everyone shares their intangibility.

ForgotTheirOwnBirthday.name: Forgot Their Own Birthday
ForgotTheirOwnBirthday.def: A character forgets when their own birthday is.

ForgotTheyApprovedOfIt.name: Forgot They Approved of It
ForgotTheyApprovedOfIt.def: A character wonders who allowed a stupid product or idea to come to fruition, only to be reminded that they were the one to do so.

GameplayGuidedAmnesia.name: Gameplay-Guided Amnesia
GameplayGuidedAmnesia.def: A video game character needing reminders of how to do certain things as an excuse for the players to receive exposition and tutorials.

GeneticMemory.name: Genetic Memory
GeneticMemory.def: An ability to record personal memories/skills into their genes and pass them onto their offspring.

GhostAmnesia.name: Ghost Amnesia
GhostAmnesia.def: A character becomes a ghost and has no recollection of their past life or even how they died.

GhostMemory.name: Ghost Memory
GhostMemory.def: A character receives memories or abilities that weren't originally theirs.

HappinessInMindControl.name: Happiness in Mind Control
HappinessInMindControl.def: A victim of mind control who does not want to be freed.

HouseAmnesia.name: House Amnesia
HouseAmnesia.def: A person orders someone to get out of their house, only to be reminded that it's their house.

HumanNotepad.name: Human Notepad
HumanNotepad.def: A character who is covered in writing.

ImmortalityThroughMemory.name: Immortality Through Memory
ImmortalityThroughMemory.def: The idea that someone only truly dies when they are forgotten.

InjuryBookend.name: Injury Bookend
InjuryBookend.def: A repeat of what caused an injury gets rid of it.

IRememberBecause.name: I Remember Because...
IRememberBecause.def: Someone remembers something because of a Contrived Coincidence .

IRememberItLikeItWasYesterday.name: I Remember It Like It Was Yesterday
IRememberItLikeItWasYesterday.def: A Stock Phrase often followed by a flashback , or the punchline that it really was yesterday.

LaserGuidedAmnesia.name: Laser-Guided Amnesia
LaserGuidedAmnesia.def: A person is made to forget very specific things.

LegendFadesToMyth.name: Legend Fades to Myth
LegendFadesToMyth.def: People having a skewed memory of a previous installment in the sequel.

LivingMemory.name: Living Memory
LivingMemory.def: A memory of a character becomes alive and able to interact with other characters.

LossOfIdentity.name: Loss of Identity
LossOfIdentity.def: A character deals with their sense of identity after radical mental, physical or spiritual changes.

MemorizedTheWholeProcess.name: Memorized the Whole Process
MemorizedTheWholeProcess.def: A character has something so many times they can recite the entire sequence of events.

MemoryJar.name: Memory Jar
MemoryJar.def: An object that is imbued with memories for safekeeping or viewing.

MemoryPalace.name: Memory Palace
MemoryPalace.def: A character's memories are shown as an organized space where memories can be retrieved.

MemoryRestoringMelody.name: Memory-Restoring Melody
MemoryRestoringMelody.def: A song that helps a character remember something important upon being heard.

MemoryTrigger.name: Memory Trigger
MemoryTrigger.def: Something triggers someone to remember something.

MemoryWipeExploitation.name: Memory Wipe Exploitation
MemoryWipeExploitation.def: Someone exploits character's memory loss for their own gain.

MemoryWipingCrew.name: Memory-Wiping Crew
MemoryWipingCrew.def: People who wipe the memories of those who might see through the Masquerade .

MindVirus.name: Mind Virus
MindVirus.def: An ailment similar to a computer virus that infects minds.

MissingTime.name: Missing Time
MissingTime.def: When a character has no memory of what happened between going to work and coming home.

MySkullRunnethOver.name: My Skull Runneth Over
MySkullRunnethOver.def: A character suddenly obtains so much knowledge that their mind is in danger of overloading.

NameAmnesia.name: Name Amnesia
NameAmnesia.def: Character can't remember their own name.

NeuralImplanting.name: Neural Implanting
NeuralImplanting.def: Computer files, images, databases, or abilities are downloaded into a person's brain.

NeverForgottenSkill.name: Never-Forgotten Skill
NeverForgottenSkill.def: A character learns a special skill and never forgets how to do it.

NoInfantileAmnesia.name: No Infantile Amnesia
NoInfantileAmnesia.def: A person is able to remember experiences from their infancy.

NoteToSelf.name: Note to Self
NoteToSelf.def: Leaving yourself a message in case you lose your memories.

NPCAmnesia.name: NPC Amnesia
NPCAmnesia.def: NPCs won't remember your actions for gameplay purposes.

ParalysisByAnalysis.name: Paralysis by Analysis
ParalysisByAnalysis.def: A person does something they're good at, only to suddenly choke from pressure.

PastLifeMemories.name: Past-Life Memories
PastLifeMemories.def: A character gains memories from their previous incarnation.

PhotographicMemory.name: Photographic Memory
PhotographicMemory.def: A person is able to remember every single detail of something they've only seen, read or heard once.

PhysicalMemory.name: Physical Memory
PhysicalMemory.def: A memory is given a tangible and interactive form.

APlaceHoldsMemories.name: A Place Holds Memories
APlaceHoldsMemories.def: A character's memories are triggered by a certain location.

QuestForIdentity.name: Quest for Identity
QuestForIdentity.def: A character tries to rediscover who they are.

RecentEventNostalgia.name: Recent Event Nostalgia
RecentEventNostalgia.def: A recent event is reflected on as though it was a long ago memory.

RecollectionSidequest.name: Recollection Sidequest
RecollectionSidequest.def: A video game sidequest where the player character has to regain lost memories.

RegainedMemoriesSequence.name: Regained Memories Sequence
RegainedMemoriesSequence.def: A character regains several memories at once.

RememberedICouldFly.name: Remembered I Could Fly
RememberedICouldFly.def: A character is in mortal danger until remembering that they have a special skill/ability that can help them.

RememberedTooLate.name: Remembered Too Late
RememberedTooLate.def: A character recalls something when it is too late to use said information.

RememberThatYouTrustMe.name: Remember That You Trust Me
RememberThatYouTrustMe.def: A character has to be reminded that they need to trust their friends.

ReminderFailure.name: Reminder Failure
ReminderFailure.def: A character's attempt at trying to remind themselves of something ends in failure.

RepeatedRehearsalFailure.name: Repeated Rehearsal Failure
RepeatedRehearsalFailure.def: A character's attempt at trying to memorize something by repeating it to themselves ends in failure.

RepressedMemories.name: Repressed Memories
RepressedMemories.def: A person subconsciously chooses to forget something that is too painful to remember.

RippleEffectProofMemory.name: Ripple-Effect-Proof Memory
RippleEffectProofMemory.def: A character goes back in time and changes history, but they still remember the original timeline.

AScarToRemember.name: A Scar to Remember
AScarToRemember.def: A villain leaves a wound on the hero's body to make them remember their encounter.

ScatterbrainedSenior.name: Scatterbrained Senior
ScatterbrainedSenior.def: An elderly person with memory problems.

SecretWord.name: Secret Word
SecretWord.def: A word or phrase that you have to remember.

SelfInflictedAmnesia.name: Self-Inflicted Amnesia
SelfInflictedAmnesia.def: Someone choses to forget something with the intention of it being permanent.

SelfServingMemory.name: Self-Serving Memory
SelfServingMemory.def: A person remembers past events as how they believed them to happen as opposed to how the events really occurred.

StringOnFingerReminder.name: String-on-Finger Reminder
StringOnFingerReminder.def: Someone ties a piece of string to their finger in an attempt to remind them of something they might forget.

SuperIntelligence.name: Super-Intelligence
SuperIntelligence.def: Someone having extreme smarts as a superpower.

ThatOneSummer.name: That One Summer
ThatOneSummer.def: A summer that acts as a major hallmark in a person's memory.

TooImportantToRememberYou.name: Too Important to Remember You
TooImportantToRememberYou.def: Someone rich or powerful can't be bothered to remember the names of their lessers.

TransferableMemory.name: Transferable Memory
TransferableMemory.def: Memories that can be processed like data.

TraumaButton.name: Trauma Button
TraumaButton.def: One character inadvertently triggers another character's repressed traumatic memory.

TraumaInducedAmnesia.name: Trauma-Induced Amnesia
TraumaInducedAmnesia.def: A person develops amnesia as a result of physical or mental trauma.

TriggerPhrase.name: Trigger Phrase
TriggerPhrase.def: A phrase that can help someone remember something.

VictoryGuidedAmnesia.name: Victory-Guided Amnesia
VictoryGuidedAmnesia.def: A character accomplishes something only to lose their memories of it afterwards.

ViewersAreGoldfish.name: Viewers Are Goldfish
ViewersAreGoldfish.def: A work of fiction reminds the audience of stuff that just happened shortly before as if the audience can't remember stuff well.

WeHaveForgottenThePhlebotinum.name: We Have Forgotten the Phlebotinum
WeHaveForgottenThePhlebotinum.def: A character forgets to bring Applied Phlebotinum to a situation where it would have been useful.

WhatDidIDoLastNight.name: What Did I Do Last Night?
WhatDidIDoLastNight.def: Someone regains consciousness after a night of being high or drunk and begins to panic while trying to remember what they did in their inebriated state.

WillTalkForAPrice.name: Will Talk for a Price
WillTalkForAPrice.def: When someone being questioned claims they can't remember—but a little bit of cash might jog their memory...

WistfulAmnesia.name: Wistful Amnesia
WistfulAmnesia.def: A character whose memories are wiped of certain events only to retain the sense that they've lost something.

YouRemindMeOfX.name: You Remind Me of X
YouRemindMeOfX.def: A character reminds another character of someone they know.

YourWorstMemory.name: Your Worst Memory
YourWorstMemory.def: A character relives the worst moment of their life in dreams, flashbacks or worse.

AdaptationalSecrecyDowngrade.name: Adaptational Secrecy Downgrade
AdaptationalSecrecyDowngrade.def: An In-Universe secret from the original work is less of a secret in the adaptation.

AmbiguousCriminalHistory.name: Ambiguous Criminal History
AmbiguousCriminalHistory.def: I'm secretly a criminal. No, I won't tell you about it.

ApocalypticGagOrder.name: Apocalyptic Gag Order
ApocalypticGagOrder.def: The government keeps an existential threat to a specific location or the whole world a secret to avert mass panic and chaos .

BatmanInMyBasement.name: Batman in My Basement
BatmanInMyBasement.def: When someone highly conspicuous hides in a "normal" location.

BlackSite.name: Black Site
BlackSite.def: A top-secret government facility, military base, or prison that the authorities really don't want anyone not in the know to access or visit. Secret Government Warehouse : A covert government facility that secretly contains various objects they don't want anyone else to know about.

BookcasePassage.name: Bookcase Passage
BookcasePassage.def: A bookcase hides a secret passage.

TheBrideWithAPast.name: The Bride with a Past
TheBrideWithAPast.def: A bride-to-be has a secret she really wants to keep hidden from her fiance.

CannotKeepASecret.name: Cannot Keep a Secret
CannotKeepASecret.def: Someone who really can't keep their mouth shut, even if their life depended on it.

CheatingViaHiddenNotes.name: Cheating via Hidden Notes
CheatingViaHiddenNotes.def: A character cheats on a test by using hidden notes.

ClassifiedInformation.name: Classified Information
ClassifiedInformation.def: This info is an official secret, and we're not allowed to share it with anyone who isn't authorized to know it.

ClosetGay.name: Closet Gay
ClosetGay.def: An LGBT character is hiding their true orientation by pretending to be completely straight.

TheConspiracy.name: The Conspiracy
TheConspiracy.def: A grand, secretive (and most likely sinister ) plot that is planned and executed by a mysterious group. Ancient Conspiracy : A very old secret society that has manipulated various historical and current events for their own gain.

BenevolentConspiracy.name: Benevolent Conspiracy
BenevolentConspiracy.def: A secret society that isn't really evil, but is in fact planning something for the (greater) good of the world.

CorporateConspiracy.name: Corporate Conspiracy
CorporateConspiracy.def: A secret project run by a big business institution .

NebulousCriminalConspiracy.name: Nebulous Criminal Conspiracy
NebulousCriminalConspiracy.def: Interconnected secret schemes that are committed by various organized crime syndicates.

CovertGroup.name: Covert Group
CovertGroup.def: A secret group or organization of any kind.

CurrencyConspiracy.name: Currency Conspiracy
CurrencyConspiracy.def: All the proof you need that "they" exist is in an everyday dollar bill.

DeducingTheSecretIdentity.name: Deducing the Secret Identity
DeducingTheSecretIdentity.def: Someone logically deduces a Secret Identity using clues, process of elimination, etc.

DominoRevelation.name: Domino Revelation
DominoRevelation.def: One revealed secret reveals another secret, which reveals another, which...

EasterEgg.name: Easter Egg
EasterEgg.def: The programmers hid some sort of secret in a video game.

ElevatorGame.name: Elevator Game
ElevatorGame.def: Entering a secret code using an elevator unlocks an unlisted floor.

EmpireWithADarkSecret.name: Empire with a Dark Secret
EmpireWithADarkSecret.def: A whole civilization is built on a horrible secret.

EyeObscuringHat.name: Eye-Obscuring Hat
EyeObscuringHat.def: The hat that still conceals who you are and adds an air of mystery.

EyeOfProvidence.name: Eye of Providence
EyeOfProvidence.def: An eye in a triangle is shorthand for Secret Societies and other ominous conspiracy stuff.

EyesOutOfSight.name: Eyes Out of Sight
EyesOutOfSight.def: You'll never see what this person's eyes look like.

ForcedOutOfTheCloset.name: Forced Out of the Closet
ForcedOutOfTheCloset.def: A character who is secretly LGBT is outed without their permission.

TheHiddenHour.name: The Hidden Hour
TheHiddenHour.def: A secret time that only a few people know exists.

HiddenMechanic.name: Hidden Mechanic
HiddenMechanic.def: A mechanic in a video game that is not explained to the player.

HiddenTrack.name: Hidden Track
HiddenTrack.def: A secret song on a CD or record.

HideYourOtherness.name: Hide Your Otherness
HideYourOtherness.def: Keeping up the lies that protect the secret world.

HideYourShapeshifting.name: Hide Your Shapeshifting
HideYourShapeshifting.def: Preventing anyone from finding out that you're undergoing a physical change of form.

HidingTheHandicap.name: Hiding the Handicap
HidingTheHandicap.def: Hiding the fact that you're disabled or afflicted.

IdTellYouButThenIdHaveToKillYou.name: I'd Tell You, but Then I'd Have to Kill You
IdTellYouButThenIdHaveToKillYou.def: A secret so critical that divulging it would mean the recipient has to die.

IllNeverTellYouWhatImTellingYou.name: I'll Never Tell You What I'm Telling You!
IllNeverTellYouWhatImTellingYou.def: Blurting out a secret while simultaneously claiming you won't do just that.

IfOnlyYouKnew.name: If Only You Knew
IfOnlyYouKnew.def: A character says something that connects to a fact or event of which they're unaware , usually to someone who is in the know.

IllusoryWall.name: Illusory Wall
IllusoryWall.def: What looks like a wall is secretly not even solid.

InformationWantsToBeFree.name: Information Wants to Be Free
InformationWantsToBeFree.def: A secret must be made public. The bad guys want to prevent that.

InvisibleWriting.name: Invisible Writing
InvisibleWriting.def: Writing is made invisible to keep it a secret.

IsThatWhatHeToldYou.name: Is That What He Told You?
IsThatWhatHeToldYou.def: A character reveals to a person what someone else has been keeping from them.

KnowledgeBasedProgression.name: Knowledge-Based Progression
KnowledgeBasedProgression.def: A style of game based on discovering secrets, such as information or hidden mechanics.

LockedOutOfTheLoop.name: Locked Out of the Loop
LockedOutOfTheLoop.def: Everyone is conspiring to keep the main character oblivious.

LooseLips.name: Loose Lips
LooseLips.def: Someone gives away sensitive information unintentionally.

LooseFloorboardHidingSpot.name: Loose Floorboard Hiding Spot
LooseFloorboardHidingSpot.def: Hiding something secret under a loose floorboard.

LovesSecrecy.name: Loves Secrecy
LovesSecrecy.def: Delighting in keeping secrets from others and mocking them about it.

TheManBehindTheMan.name: The Man Behind the Man
TheManBehindTheMan.def: The Big Bad is secretly controlled by an even Bigger Bad.

Masquerade.name: Masquerade
Masquerade.def: There's a secret world of strangeness that has been carefully hidden beneath everyone else's noses. Broken Masquerade : You have discovered the big secret that was hidden from you all along.

ExpositingTheMasquerade.name: Expositing the Masquerade
ExpositingTheMasquerade.def: Turns out these folks knew about the weird stuff all along.

ExtraStrengthMasquerade.name: Extra-Strength Masquerade
ExtraStrengthMasquerade.def: The big secret should've been revealed by now, but yet it hasn't .

MasqueradeEnforcer.name: Masquerade Enforcer
MasqueradeEnforcer.def: Reality conspires to punish those that try to reveal the secret.

MasqueradeParadox.name: Masquerade Paradox
MasqueradeParadox.def: Turns out the big secret isn't worth keeping secret.

TheMasqueradeWillKillYourDatingLife.name: The Masquerade Will Kill Your Dating Life
TheMasqueradeWillKillYourDatingLife.def: Trying to uphold the masquerade (or living a double life ) makes dating difficult.

MutualMasquerade.name: Mutual Masquerade
MutualMasquerade.def: Two people who are part of the same (or different) conspiracies both think the other is normal.

ToUnmasqueTheWorld.name: To Unmasque the World
ToUnmasqueTheWorld.def: Someone wants to expose the big secret and reveal it to everyone else.

WelcomedToTheMasquerade.name: Welcomed to the Masquerade
WelcomedToTheMasquerade.def: A character is introduced into a secret society or hidden world.

TheWorldIsNotReady.name: The World Is Not Ready
TheWorldIsNotReady.def: The secret masquerade exists out of a well-intentioned belief that the truth is so shocking , most people wouldn't be able to handle it , and would descend into mass panic and chaos .

MissingSecret.name: Missing Secret
MissingSecret.def: When one mistakenly believes there is a "secret" feature in a video game that doesn't actually exist.

MysteriousPurple.name: Mysterious Purple
MysteriousPurple.def: The color purple is used to characterize or code things as mysterious, ambiguous, or enigmatic, often with a yet-unrevealed backstory or secret motivations.

MysticalCityPlanning.name: Mystical City Planning
MysticalCityPlanning.def: A whole location is secretly in the shape of a giant spell.

NeverBareheaded.name: Never Bareheaded
NeverBareheaded.def: A character never reveals what's under their hat.

ObviousVillainSecretVillain.name: Obvious Villain, Secret Villain
ObviousVillainSecretVillain.def: One villain is obvious, the other one is a secret.

OpeningUpMoment.name: Opening-Up Moment
OpeningUpMoment.def: Someone opens up to someone else, sharing something they normally keep private.

OstentatiousSecret.name: Ostentatious Secret
OstentatiousSecret.def: Someone openly advertises that they have a secret .

OverTheTopSecret.name: Over-the-Top Secret
OverTheTopSecret.def: Super-duper-extremely-top-secret information that has its own special security class.

PetWithADoubleLife.name: Pet with a Double Life
PetWithADoubleLife.def: A pet keeps a secret from their owner(s).

PlayingNiceForNow.name: Playing Nice for Now
PlayingNiceForNow.def: Don't let anyone know we are at each other's throats.

PlotDrivingSecret.name: Plot-Driving Secret
PlotDrivingSecret.def: If they knew the truth, we wouldn't have a plot.

PopCultureSymbology.name: Pop Culture Symbology
PopCultureSymbology.def: Secret meanings found in pop culture.

PublicSecretMessage.name: Public Secret Message
PublicSecretMessage.def: Announcing secret info by concealing it in plain sight.

PubliclyDiscussingTheSecret.name: Publicly Discussing the Secret
PubliclyDiscussingTheSecret.def: Characters who know a secret disregard all semblance of actual secrecy.

QueerFlowers.name: Queer Flowers
QueerFlowers.def: Gay men and women using certain flowers to convey homosexual romance, originally meant to be hidden messages to other homosexuals.

RelationshipGonePublic.name: Relationship Gone Public
RelationshipGonePublic.def: We don't want to keep this relationship secret anymore, so we're telling people about it.

SafelySecludedScienceCenter.name: Safely Secluded Science Center
SafelySecludedScienceCenter.def: A laboratory is isolated for the sake of secrecy - and safety.

SecretArt.name: Secret Art
SecretArt.def: A skill or technique known only to a few people.

SecretCharacter.name: Secret Character
SecretCharacter.def: A playable character in a video game who is a secret until they're unlocked.

SecretCircleOfSecrets.name: Secret Circle of Secrets
SecretCircleOfSecrets.def: A secret society of ominous hooded figures up to who-knows-what.

SecretCompartment.name: Secret Compartment
SecretCompartment.def: A storage compartment Hidden in Plain Sight for storing items that only people in the know are supposed to be aware of.

SecretDiary.name: Secret Diary
SecretDiary.def: A diary or journal that is kept in secret.

SecretHandshake.name: Secret Handshake
SecretHandshake.def: The secret means of identifying people who are keeping a secret together.

SecretIdentity.name: Secret Identity
SecretIdentity.def: An alternate identity that is used to hide a secret double life. Second Super-Identity : When there is more than one secret identity.

SecretIngredient.name: Secret Ingredient
SecretIngredient.def: The mysterious something added to food to make it special.

SecretLevel.name: Secret Level
SecretLevel.def: A bonus level of a video game that is hidden and not needed to beat the game.

SecretlyGayActivity.name: Secretly Gay Activity
SecretlyGayActivity.def: Disguising flirtation (or sex) with the same sex with a perfectly "innocent" activity.

SecretMessageWink.name: Secret Message Wink
SecretMessageWink.def: Winking to secretly get a message across.

SecretPath.name: Secret Path
SecretPath.def: A hidden path that bypasses obstacles by taking a route not many know.

SecretPetPlot.name: Secret Pet Plot
SecretPetPlot.def: A character adopts a pet and tries to hide it.

SecretPolice.name: Secret Police
SecretPolice.def: A covert law enforcement agency serving an oppressive government, with the aim of violently suppressing any opposition.

SecretRelationship.name: Secret Relationship
SecretRelationship.def: Two characters keep their relationship a secret from everyone else.

SecretSexWorker.name: Secret Sex Worker
SecretSexWorker.def: A character is Living a Double Life , hiding that they are a sex worker from those closest to them, typically out of fear of social rejection, condemnation, or arrest for engaging in a criminalized profession.

SecretSocietyGroupPicture.name: Secret Society Group Picture
SecretSocietyGroupPicture.def: The members of a (not so) secret society all posed for a group photo that provides damning evidence of their existence.

SecretSquatter.name: Secret Squatter
SecretSquatter.def: A character lives concealed in an already-occupied house.

SecretStabWound.name: Secret Stab Wound
SecretStabWound.def: A character hides a serious injury. Clothing-Concealed Injury : When clothing has to be used to hide said injury.

SecretTestOfCharacter.name: Secret Test of Character
SecretTestOfCharacter.def: The actual test is a secret to prove what's in their heart.

SecretWar.name: Secret War
SecretWar.def: A covert conflict that's being fought behind a masquerade between the belligerents.

SecretWeapon.name: Secret Weapon
SecretWeapon.def: A hidden weapon typically revealed during or near the climax of the story.

SentIntoHiding.name: Sent Into Hiding
SentIntoHiding.def: A person is kept hidden, and thus secret, from the rest of society.

ShadowAchievement.name: Shadow Achievement
ShadowAchievement.def: A part of a game's Achievement System that's not part of and hidden from normal play.

ShadowGovernment.name: Shadow Government
ShadowGovernment.def: A secret government faction that actually runs things.

SpectrogramSpectacle.name: Spectrogram Spectacle
SpectrogramSpectacle.def: Encoding a secret into the spectrogram of an audio file.

Spoiler.name: Spoilers
Spoiler.def: Surprising plot details from a work of fiction, which may or may not be kept hidden to avoid spoiling the impact of The Reveal for anyone who hasn't seen that story yet.

SubtleSuperpowering.name: Subtle Superpowering
SubtleSuperpowering.def: Keeping your powers secret by using them in a downplayed manner.

SurprisinglySharedSecret.name: Surprisingly Shared Secret
SurprisinglySharedSecret.def: A character is surprised to learn that somebody has something in common with them that they were keeping secret.

TheyreCalledPersonalIssuesForAReason.name: They're Called "Personal Issues" for a Reason
TheyreCalledPersonalIssuesForAReason.def: Secrets that, when discovered, only reveal embarrassing and unimportant information.

ThisPageWillSelfDestruct.name: This Page Will Self-Destruct
ThisPageWillSelfDestruct.def: A self-destruct mechanism is built into a device that relays secret information.

ThoughtTheyKnewAlready.name: Thought They Knew Already
ThoughtTheyKnewAlready.def: A secret is revealed because someone didn't know it was secret.

UnmanlySecret.name: Unmanly Secret
UnmanlySecret.def: A man hides his love of something stereotypically not masculine.

WaterSourceTampering.name: Water Source Tampering
WaterSourceTampering.def: They don't want you to know what you're really drinking.

WeWouldHaveToldYouBut.name: We Would Have Told You, But...
WeWouldHaveToldYouBut.def: A character has to be kept in the dark about something in order for the plan to work out.

WhatsInsidePlot.name: "What's Inside?" Plot
WhatsInsidePlot.def: Characters try to figure out what is hidden inside a locked box or closet.

WorldOfMysteries.name: World of Mysteries
WorldOfMysteries.def: A whole setting consisting of secrets and mysteries.

HeroicVowOfDefiance.name: Heroic Vow of Defiance
HeroicVowOfDefiance.def: A defiant vow at the Darkest Hour .

OathboundPower.name: Oathbound Power
OathboundPower.def: A supernatural power that's contingent on keeping an oath.

RashPromise.name: Rash Promise
RashPromise.def: "I gave my word... but not much thought to it."

BloodOath.name: Blood Oath
BloodOath.def: Drawing your own blood to illustrate commitment to a vow.

MagicallyBindingContract.name: Magically Binding Contract
MagicallyBindingContract.def: An agreement made with magic will make at least one side forced to comply, or punished if they don't follow it.

PinkySwear.name: Pinky Swear
PinkySwear.def: Using pinky fingers as gesture of promise.

ChildhoodMarriagePromise.name: Childhood Marriage Promise
ChildhoodMarriagePromise.def: Two kids promise to marry each other when they grow up.

FallbackMarriagePact.name: Fallback Marriage Pact
FallbackMarriagePact.def: Two single characters promise to marry each other if they're still single by X age.

IWillWaitForYou.name: I Will Wait for You
IWillWaitForYou.def: Promising to remain faithful to your lover who's away

NoMatterHowMuchIBeg.name: No Matter How Much I Beg
NoMatterHowMuchIBeg.def: "Promise to follow through, even if I try to back out."

PromiseMeYouWontX.name: Promise Me You Won't X
PromiseMeYouWontX.def: A character is going to say something to someone, but makes them promise not to have a certain reaction.

ReunionVow.name: Reunion Vow
ReunionVow.def: A promise to see each other again one day.

SwornInByOath.name: Sworn in by Oath
SwornInByOath.def: Someone joins an organization by reciting an oath, typically which outlines their new role and how they should conduct themselves within it.

VowOfCelibacy.name: Vow of Celibacy
VowOfCelibacy.def: A promise not to have sex.

FrequentlyBrokenUnbreakableVow.name: Frequently-Broken Unbreakable Vow
FrequentlyBrokenUnbreakableVow.def: A promise that circumstances force the character to break. Repeatedly.

ReleasingFromThePromise.name: Releasing from the Promise
ReleasingFromThePromise.def: The character who received a promise releases the promise-maker.
